jobs.title: Communications and Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
## **Who We Are**

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on [Mac](https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/), [Windows](https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/), [iOS](https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/), and [Android](https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/), our [search engine](https://duckduckgo.com/), and the [DuckDuckGo subscription](https://duckduckgo.com/pro). We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including [Duck.ai](https://duck.ai/), which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

Our [culture](https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work) of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

## **Your Team and Role**

Working on the Marketing and Communications Functional Team, you'll help shape how millions of people hear about DuckDuckGo, lead projects, and own key ongoing work.

As a Social Media And Communications Manager, you'll write social media copy, manage social media mentions and communities, coordinate proactive announcements, manage incoming press requests, regularly report out and keep track of key performance metrics and work on related projects. You'll be the directly responsible individual (DRI) on your own projects from scoping through postmortem, collaborating closely with product, design, legal, support, and leadership.

Example projects include:

- Announcing DuckDuckGo products and features, across press, social, and community channels.

- Running a multi-week social campaign to raise awareness of a product area, from measuring the baseline and planning content through weekly reporting and recommendations.


## **About You**

- 6+ years in communications, including PR and social media, ideally in tech.

- Excellent writing skills, with the ability to explain products clearly, without jargon.

- Hands-on social media experience, including content development and community management on X, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, and Bluesky.

- Media relations experience, including pitching journalists, handling inquiries, and building press relationships.

- Experience measuring social media and earned media reach, engagement, sentiment, and campaign impact and turning results into insightful reports.

- Fluency in online culture, with strong judgment about when to join a conversation and when not to.

- Ability to run multiple campaigns, content calendars, and approval cycles with cross-functional team members at once.

- Proven ability to manage projects from kickoff through delivery.


## **Compensation**

This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:

- **United States**: $129,000 USD annually

- **United Kingdom**: £97,300 GBP annually

- **Canada**: C$183,200 CAD annually

- **Europe/Rest of World**: €113,750 EUR annually


In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

Our [Team Member Support Guide](https://duckduckgo.com/assets/hiring/team_support_guide.pdf) explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including **paid parental leave, office setup,** and **co-working allowances.**

## **Hiring Process**

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about [how we hire](https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-hire).

## **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to [careers@duckduckgo.com](mailto:careers@duckduckgo.com) to let us know the nature of your request.

## **Please note that:**

- You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing.

- Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

- While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

- A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

- By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.


**Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process**

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

**Key Principles:**

- **Data Privacy:** All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our [Recruiting Privacy Policy](https://duckduckgo.com/static-assets/files/pages/careers/DuckDuckGo-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-effective-September-30-2025.pdf). We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

- **Human Oversight and Accountability:** The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

- **Transparency:** We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.


By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at [careers@duckduckgo.com](mailto:careers@duckduckgo.com). Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer, Tier 2 (Windows)
jobs.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.
About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 
JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.


About the Role:
 As a Customer Support Engineer - Tier 2 you will be responsible for providing world-class technical support to JumpCloud’s customers. We are looking for a highly technical self-starter that is driven to exceed customer expectations across JumpCloud’s various support channels.  This position will resolve high priority and mission critical customer issues in a fast-paced environment. As a Technical Support Engineer- Tier 2 you will apply your technical knowledge to resolve customer issues, and regularly interface across Support and Engineering to ensure the timely resolution of defects.

What you'll be doing:
Provide technical support, troubleshooting and issue resolution to our customers via email, telephone, chat or remote web session.


Manage a queue of support tickets for high priority and complex technical issues


Reproduce issues in-house and respond to customers in a timely manner.


Collaborate with peers, escalation points, mentors, our knowledge base, community forums and other internal tools to provide the most effective, world-class solutions for our customers.


Collaborate with Product and Learning teams to ensure customer education programs are accurate and up to date


Maintain a technical understanding of the entire JumpCloud Platform 


Collaborate with Account Manager and Implementation Engineers to ensure the success of our new customers as they transition into the day to day use of our product


Develop and maintain internal knowledge base articles to increase shared knowledge among the entire support engineering team


Collaborate with peers on projects aimed at improving the customer and support engineer experiences


On-call rotation required. Duties include monitoring of status updates and external customer responses to incoming cases during outage.

We're looking for:
Minimum of 5 years of experience in a technical, customer-facing position, preferably in a SaaS environment


Minimum of 2 years of experience working with mission critical customer issues and customer and technical escalations


In-depth knowledge of the Windows platform - Registry Hives, LGPOs, PowerShell and CMD, Windows Credential Manager (WCM), Event Logging, Windows Home/Pro/Server Experience


Strong understanding of the Active Directory platform - Domain Forests, GPOs, Azure Active Directory (AAD), User/Group Management.


Experience with configuring & troubleshooting Single Sign-on (SAML+ SCIM)


Good experience with configuring & troubleshooting RADIUS


General Networking understanding


Excellent interpersonal communication


Strong oral and written communication skills


Understanding of user onboarding and offboarding practices.


Understanding of Information security best practices


Passion for learning new technologies


Enthusiasm for collaborative working


Ability to thrive in a rapidly changing environment 


Bilingual - English and Portuguese, written and verbal


Shift: Monday-Friday 06:00-15:00 MT

Preferred Qualifications:
Knowledge of the macOS platform - FileVault, Keychain, Apple Mobile Device Management (MDM) + DEP, and overall system management.


Experience supporting and troubleshooting one or more Linux distros: Ubuntu, Debian, RHEL, or CentOS.


Non-Windows Directory Services (G Suite, AWS, LDAP)


REST APIs


Scripting (Powershell, CMD, BASH)


Using AI to enhance your productivity


AI Prompt Engineering skills


Full-time remote working and self-motivated productivity.


Using macOS hardware as your primary work-device

#LI-JR1


Where you’ll be working/Location:
JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 
You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role. 
 
Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.
 
Language: 
JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 
Why JumpCloud®?  
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 
One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 
JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 
Scam Notice:
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"
 
#LI-Remote #BI-Remote

jobs.title: Customer Experience Analyst II
jobs.description:
#### Company description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

#### Job description

**Job description**

If you are looking for a career opportunity at an innovative, market-leading company that respects the individual values of its employees, Serasa Experian is the right place for you.

We are looking for professionals to work in our Professional Service area, where you will have contact with our differentiated technologies and methodologies, as well as great challenges and career growth opportunities.

The Professional Service team is focused on delivering solution projects in Fraud and Risk (Document verification, Biometrics, SDKs, APIs), and the professional must have these skills to be part of this PS Team.

In the implementation projects for these platforms, the solutions are adapted to the needs of clients through the necessary parameterizations and customizations of technical and functional aspects, with different levels of complexity.

The mission of this professional will be to work with the project implementation teams at clients, in a high-performance environment, producing high-quality results within the established deadlines.

What will your main deliverables be?

- Work in multidisciplinary teams (from intake of demands, requirements analysis, deployment and sustainment);
- Gather business, technical and functional requirements to meet client needs;
- Track demands end-to-end;
- Document and map the squad's flows/processes;
- Customer at the center;
- Prioritize deliverables using a business and value perspective;
- Ensure that deliverables meet the initial request;
- Act as liaison and be responsible for an anti-fraud product management squad

#### Qualifications

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems or related areas
- Proven experience (1 to 3 years) in project coordination, product operations or implementation in fintechs, analytics or fraud/risk areas
- Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Customer Experience (CX) and technical teams
- Knowledge of fraud detection processes, risk models or decision systems
- Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements and coordinate deliveries across teams
- Analytical skills to interpret application results, KPIs and customer impact metrics
- Experience with continuous product evolution (improvements, adjustments and increments in a production environment)
- Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, aligning priorities across different areas
- Organization to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously

**Desirable qualifications**

- Experience with anti-fraud platforms, decision engines or risk scoring systems
- Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Agile) and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
- Knowledge of customer journey mapping and experience improvement (CX)
- Experience working with data (SQL, dashboards or tools such as Power BI/Tableau)
- Background in financial services, credit bureaus or payments
- Knowledge of A/B testing, experimentation and performance optimization
- Certifications in project management (PMP, Scrum Master or similar)

**Key competencies**

- Performance and influence in multidisciplinary teams
- Analytical profile and solution-oriented problem solving
- Data-driven decision making
- Customer focus

**Qualifications**

- Agile (Agile methodologies)
- Fraud
- Product management
- Project management

#### Additional information

Serasa Experian is much more than you imagine. With the purpose of creating a better future by expanding opportunities for people and businesses, in Brazil we are more than 4,000 people working in various teams and specialties. Here, every skill and diversity complements each other, and you can work on what you love most. We are committed to building an inclusive culture and an environment where people can balance their careers with their commitments and personal interests, valuing well-being.

We work hard to be one of the best and most innovative companies to work for in the country, enabling amazing experiences and careers for our people. Our strong people-first approach is recognized externally through several market certifications: we were awarded by Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries and by the international Top Employers certification, in addition to being recognized as one of the best companies for young professionals and having a 4.6 rating on Glassdoor. Each recognition tells us we are on the right path, providing an increasingly better work environment for our talent.

Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together

[Find out what its like to work for Experian by clicking here](https://www.experian.com/careers/)

jobs.title: Senior Sales Variable Compensation Analyst
jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company that drives opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate in many markets, such as financial services, healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, among others. Experian invests in people and in new advanced technologies to unleash the power of data. We have an incredible team of 25,200 employees in 32 countries.

Our uniqueness is valuing yours. Experian's culture, centered on people, inclusive and driven by purpose, is recognized by several awards, including World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25) and Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries, among others. Check out Experian Life on social media or explore our careers site to understand why. Experian also takes pride in being an employer that promotes equal opportunity and affirmative action.

#### Job Description

We are looking for a person to act in the strategic management of the sales force's variable compensation models. This person will be responsible for diagnosing and monitoring the health of the models, assessing whether their indicators, rules and incentives are aligned with the business's challenges and priorities.

The position will combine data analysis, business vision and communication. Your role will be to transform information about the models into diagnoses, recommendations and materials that support decisions and help different audiences understand the logic of the programs.

**Main responsibilities**

- Diagnose and monitor sales variable compensation models, assessing their alignment with business priorities and challenges.
- Analyze health and effectiveness indicators of the models, identifying trends, distortions, risks and opportunities for evolution.
- Develop analyses and simulations to evaluate the effects of rules, metrics and incentive mechanics on expected results and behaviors.
- Design and evolve monitoring dashboards and reports, translating data into useful information for leaders and partner areas.
- Contribute to the governance of the models, supporting the organization of rules, criteria, documentation and review cycles.
- Prepare and conduct training on the different models, adapting communication to audiences and the needs of each context.
- Work in partnership with areas such as Sales, Finance and Business Intelligence to understand challenges and support incentive-related decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
## **Who We Are**

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on [Mac](https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/), [Windows](https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/), [iOS](https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/), and [Android](https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/), our [search engine](https://duckduckgo.com/), and the [DuckDuckGo subscription](https://duckduckgo.com/pro). We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including [Duck.ai](https://duck.ai/), which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

Our [culture](https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work) of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

## **Your Team and Role**

In this role, you will collaborate with team members at all levels to identify and solve problems across our current product offering, as well as helping to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the Internet. You'll have the opportunity to level up our products through exploring and testing concepts that improve overall experience and increase delight while appealing to a broader audience.

Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: [https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/](https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/)

## **About You**

- 6+ years of experience in product design roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands.

- Proficiency in managing projects of varying complexity, from proposal, through execution and release, all while working transparently and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and contributors.

- A knack for pushing creative limits while solving challenging design problems and delivering on delight, craft and exceptional quality.

- Ability to communicate visual and interaction recommendations with high-quality mockups, prototypes, and rationale.

- Accustomed to applying agentic solutions into every day project management and design execution workflows to both accelerate and raise the quality of your work.

- Ability to write creative briefs that clearly define and communicate project goals, rationale, and success metrics with stakeholders.

- Proficiency in research and experimentation — you can leverage both qualitative and quantitative data in driving decisions forward.

- Skills to manage ambiguity and wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a focus on metrics.

- Ability to take initiative in generating ideas and carrying them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly and collaboratively.

- A willingness to apply your experience and expertise in educating, guiding, and supporting others, while serving as a steward to maintain quality of execution across designated areas of design.

- Experience participating in multiple areas of the product process including prioritization, strategy, and user testing.


## **Compensation**

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation, plus stock options:

- United States: $190,500 USD

- United Kingdom: £134,600 GBP

- Canada: CA$253,500 CAD

- All other regions*: €157,350 EUR


*Team members outside the US, UK and Canada are currently paid $178,500 USD. Pay converts to the EUR amount above on January 1, 2027 for Spanish team members, and approximately February 1, 2027 in all other regions.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

Our [Team Member Support Guide](https://duckduckgo.com/assets/hiring/team_support_guide.pdf) explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including **paid parental leave, office setup,** and **co-working allowances.**

Our [Team Member Support Guide](https://duckduckgo.com/assets/hiring/team_support_guide.pdf) explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including **paid parental leave, office setup,** and **co-working allowances.**

## **Hiring Process**

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about [how we hire](https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-hire).

## **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to [careers@duckduckgo.com](mailto:careers@duckduckgo.com) to let us know the nature of your request.

## **Please note that:**

1. You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

2. Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

3. While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

4. A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

5. By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.


## **Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process**

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

**Key Principles:**

1. **Data Privacy:** All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our [Recruiting Privacy Policy](https://duckduckgo.com/static-assets/files/pages/careers/DuckDuckGo-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-effective-September-30-2025.pdf). We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

2. **Human Oversight and Accountability:** The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

3. **Transparency:** We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.


By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at [careers@duckduckgo.com](mailto:careers@duckduckgo.com). Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

jobs.title: Commodity Associate Program (Spring 2027)
jobs.description:
## **About the Role:**

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

08

**Commodity Associate Program – Spring 2027**

**The** **Role:** The S&P Global Energy Commodity Associate Program is a seven-month rotational development program with intake cohorts in **March and September 2027**. The program begins with one month of structured training, followed by two three-month rotations across different commodity sectors, providing participants with broad exposure to energy and commodity markets before transitioning into a permanent role.

We are seeking candidates who will have completed their undergraduate degree by **February 2027** for the March 2027 intake, or by **August 2027** for the September 2027 intake. Postgraduate students are also encouraged to apply.

**The Location:** Sao Paulo

**The Team/The Business:** You will be part of the Platts price reporting team and will be considered as a specialist in the market(s) you will be working in. We are looking for genuinely curious and motivated graduates that are passionate about the commodities market, reporting and want to develop their career in a dynamic, high performing and diverse team.

**The Impact:**

Our real-time news, pricing and analytical services help markets operate with transparency and efficiency.

- Be part of a global company with a strong history of growth and a globally diverse workforce with 20 offices spanning six continents.
- Be known as a respected source of essential information and part of a renowned brand.
- Get the best of both worlds: a nimble, highly specialized company and a business casual culture with the benefits and backing of S&P Global – a company that fosters development and growth, as well as work-life balance.
- We are looking for critical thinkers to join our team at S&P Global Energy, the principal provider of commodity price assessment and information to more than 10,000 customers in over 190 countries. The content you generate and the relationships you build are essential to the markets.
- Price reporters provide insightful market commentaries that demonstrate Energy thought leadership in the market, demonstrating our ability to spot key trends that help customers better anticipate market-moving events.


**What’s In It For You** You will be gathering qualitative data and intelligence from market participants as well as conducting price assessments guided by our methodologies. You will also be exposed to a number of market topics including supply and demand, infrastructure issues, geopolitical issues, transportation and regulation, and how these subjects impact respective markets. You will get an opportunity to learn about different aspects of Oil, Power, Natural Gas, LNG, Coal, Petrochemicals, Metals, Agriculture and Shipping markets.

During the programme, you will be fully trained in all the foundational skills and topics needed to succeed in the role of a price reporter. This includes writing market commentaries and news pieces which informs our pricing benchmarks and analytics.

You will receive four weeks of comprehensive training followed by two three-month rotations in different commodity sectors – preparing you to move into a permanent price reporting role in one of our commodity teams.  Should you meet expectations and perform well, you will be offered full time permanent employment at the end of the programme. Rotations and final placements are based on business needs.

You will be entrenched in S&P Global’s truly diverse and inclusive culture where you will have the opportunity to thrive as you bring your true, whole, human self to work.

**Responsibilities**

- Monitor commodity and energy markets to identify key trends, developments, and pricing drivers.
- Gather, validate, and analyze market intelligence from industry participants and public sources.
- Support the creation of market reports, news content, and pricing-related commentary.
- Contribute to the price assessment process by applying established methodologies and editorial standards.
- Build professional relationships with market participants to enhance market coverage and insight gathering.
- Maintain accurate records of market information and support data quality initiatives.
- Collaborate with editorial, analytics, and research teams on market-focused projects and deliverables.
- Complete training programs to build expertise in commodity markets, price reporting, and market analysis.
- Leverage approved AI and digital tools to improve research efficiency, knowledge discovery, and workflow effectiveness.
- Identify opportunities to streamline routine tasks through automation and AI-enabled solutions while maintaining accuracy and compliance.

**What We’re Looking For**

- Students from all academic backgrounds are welcome. Degrees in Journalism, Communications, Business, Economics, English Literature, English Language, Data Analytics, Sciences, Engineering, Energy Studies, Finance, or commodity-related disciplines are particularly valued.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and accurate market-focused content for a global audience.
- For APAC-based roles, proficiency in Mandarin is required.
- Demonstrated curiosity about energy, commodities, sustainability, and financial markets, with an interest in understanding market fundamentals and price movements.
- Ability to learn quickly, prioritize competing deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced news and market intelligence environment.
- Strong relationship-building skills, with the confidence to engage professionally with market participants, industry stakeholders, and internal teams.
- Excellent analytical thinking, problem-solving, time management, attention to detail, and organizational abilities to efficiently gather, validate, and interpret market information.
- Comfortable working with data and digital tools, including Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint).
- Ability to assess information critically, identify market trends, and synthesize insights from multiple sources while maintaining high editorial standards and data integrity.
- Familiarity with Generative AI technologies and the ability to leverage AI-powered tools responsibly to enhance research, content creation, workflow efficiency, and process optimization.
- Proactively seeks opportunities to integrate AI-driven solutions into day-to-day processes, improving productivity, data analysis, source management, and content workflows.
- Demonstrates a commitment to accuracy, transparency, independence, and ethical standards that underpin the Platts price reporting and editorial methodology.

**About S&P Global Market Intelligence**

At S&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S&P Global we understand the importance of accurate, deep and insightful information. Our team of experts delivers unrivaled insights and leading data and technology solutions, partnering with customers to expand their perspective, operate with confidence, and make decisions with conviction.

For more information, visit [www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence](http://www.spglobal.com/marketintelligence).

**What’s In It For** **You?**

**Our Mission:**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**Our People:**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

**Our Values:**

**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

**Benefits:**

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

Our benefits include:

- Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.

- Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.

- Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.

- Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

As a Technical Support Specialist, you will be a vital member of our Global Customer Support organization—serving as a trusted product expert, primary point of contact for inbound questions, and owner of complex technical cases. You’ll diagnose and fix issues, answer product questions, and guide best practices, ensuring fast, accurate help and an exceptional customer experience.

In this role, you will:

- **Customer Inquiry Ownership:** Own customer inquiries end-to-end (how-to questions, technical break-fix issues, integration/configuration help, and best practice guidance), providing timely, insightful, and technically sound resolutions.

- **Product Expertise:** Become a trusted product expert—mastering the Braze dashboard, integrations, troubleshooting steps, and operational best practices.

- **Product Adoption & Value:** Drive increased platform adoption by enabling customers to effectively utilize Braze features to achieve their desired business outcomes.

- **Cross-Functional Alignment:** Collaborate with team members, Customer Success, Account Managers, Product, and Engineering to deliver seamless customer experiences and resolve technical escalations.

- **Process Improvement & Enablement:** Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer satisfaction while actively documenting and sharing knowledge to elevate teammates and customers.


_Please note: This job description covers core responsibilities, and you may be asked to handle other reasonable duties commensurate with the role._

**WHO YOU ARE**

- **Technical Support Experience:** Demonstrated experience supporting technical products, ideally within SaaS, mobile applications, or high-volume tech support environments.

- **Education & Foundation:** Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university, technical boot camp certification, or equivalent practical experience.

- **Technical Skills & Tools:** Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, APIs, and/or SQL. Familiarity with case management tools (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk) is required.

- **Bonus Technical Tools:** Experience with tools such as Postman, Snowflake, Datadog, and/or Kibana is a plus.

- **Domain Knowledge:** Understanding of two or more of the following domains: SaaS, Mobile Technology, APIs, Marketing Automation, Direct Marketing, Marketing Analytics, or basic programming.

- **Communication & Soft Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts clearly for diverse technical and non-technical audiences.

- **Problem-Solving & Resilience:** Analytical, curious, and resourceful troubleshooter skilled at managing and prioritizing a high volume of time-sensitive inquiries under pressure.

_Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at [here](https://www.braze.com/company/careers/how-we-hire#benefit-section). More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment._

Trust Wallet is the secure, self-custody Web3 wallet that empowers people to own and control their digital assets. The Trust Wallet Management Trainee Program is a selective, fast-track start to a career in Product, Marketing or Business Development in Web3. You’ll join a small cohort and work on live products used by millions of people from day one. You’ll work directly with senior leaders across product, engineering, marketing, BD and the wider business.

We’re looking for early-career talent who question assumptions and bring fresh perspectives to self-custody, payments and the agentic AI economy.

Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone.

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:

- Ranked **#10 of 250** on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of [America's Top WorkTech Companies](https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-hr-named-10-of-americas-top-worktech-companies-of-2026-by-time)

- The only **B Corp-certified** global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023


Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

### The Role

**Location:** While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote and you can work from home. Forever. To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires you to be based within UTC−6 to UTC+3.

_**All applications will be reviewed after the submission deadline on Nov 6th, and we’ll be in touch with next steps shortly after. We appreciate your patience and interest in joining the team**_ **.**

**Role Summary**

Oyster is looking for a Partner Marketing Manager to build a scalable engine that creates demand and pipeline through our partner ecosystem. You will inherit an active portfolio, keep important commitments moving, and decide what to continue, improve, or retire using performance and cost data. Working across Channel and Marketing, you will design and execute programs that market to partners, with partners, and through partners—turning partner strategy into repeatable go-to-market motions with clear measurement. This is a high-autonomy individual-contributor role with global remit, budget ownership, and direct partnership with the Director of Demand and Growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Design, orchestrate, execute, and measure partner marketing programs across the ecosystem.

- Build programs that market to partners, with partners, and through partners.

- Protect existing partner commitments during handover while reviewing the portfolio for performance, cost, and strategic fit.

- Own and allocate the partner marketing budget, including co-marketing and MDF, and defend investment decisions with return data.

- Develop partner segmentation, positioning, messaging, and repeatable operating models.

- Create joint programs across partner types, including technology partners.

- Enable partners to take Oyster’s message and value proposition to their audiences.

- Align Channel, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Content, Sales, and Revenue Operations around integrated plans.

- Establish credible reporting for partner-sourced pipeline, partner-influenced pipeline, engagement, and program ROI.

- Apply AI and automation processes to improve segmentation, personalization, program development, execution, and insight generation.


**Core Requirements**

- Demonstrated ownership of measurable partner or ecosystem marketing programs from strategy through execution and reporting.

- Strong understanding of marketing to, with, and through partners.

- Ability to connect marketing activity to sourced or influenced pipeline and explain attribution trade-offs.

- Strong cross-functional collaboration across partnerships, channel, marketing, sales, and revenue operations.

- Experience managing a program portfolio and making evidence-based choices about what to continue, change, or stop.

- Ability to adapt messaging and motions across partner types, incentives, audiences, and regions.

- Sound budget judgment and confidence allocating spend against expected return.

- AI-native working style, with evidence of rebuilding marketing workflows around AI while managing quality and privacy risks.

- Comfort operating independently in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.


**Bonus / Nice-to-Have Experience**

- Experience in B2B SaaS, HR technology, global employment, or another partner-led ecosystem.

- Experience marketing with technology partners.

- Experience building a partner marketing function, measurement model, or operating cadence from an early stage.

- Familiarity with PRM, marketing automation, CRM, attribution, and analytics tools.

- Experience supporting global programs across regions and time zones.


**This might not be right for you if...**

- You rely on manual workflows and are not motivated to adopt AI-enabled ways of working.

- Sustained alignment across Channel, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and external partners feels like overhead rather than core work.

- **WFH stipend:** Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.


### **✨ The best jobs should be available to everyone**

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.

Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email [jobs@oysterhr.com](mailto:jobs@oysterhr.com) with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.

Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @ _oysterhr.com_ email, and **we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer.** If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than [www.oysterhr.com/careers](http://www.oysterhr.com/careers), please report it via our [Compliance and Ethics Helpline](https://faceup.com/c/8tpzyyye).

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Turso
jobs.description:
#### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

#### **About the Role**

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our **Turso core database team** and help bring forward the future of agentic databases. Turso is both an Open Source database that replaces SQLite—with an ongoing project to also support the Postgres interface—and a Cloud offering where users can create databases on demand. You’ll work closely with customers and other teams at Supabase to build the future of what databases look like in a world where users and agents are creating millions of databases a day.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building database technology tools that scale to billions.

#### **What You’ll Be Responsible For**

- Driving the progress of the Turso Open Source database, in particular the Postgres compatibility layer.

- Making sure code _works_, and never breaks, and putting the systems and guarantees in place for that to happen.

- Maintaining the Turso Cloud operations, including the Cloud API and data plane operations.

- Improving the scalability of the Turso Cloud operations to support a 100x larger number of databases


#### **You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

- Have written databases before, and/or other high-stakes low-level systems like Hypervisors, OS Kernels, storage devices, etc.

- Have experience working with remote teams and Open Source communities.

- Have a passion and experience for correct systems that work, and have the experience in the tools to make that happen: Deterministic Simulation Testing, formal verification methods, fuzz and differential testing, etc.

- Have experience deploying, operating and debugging large scale software systems in production in cloud environments such as AWS & Kubernetes

- Have experience improving the observability, reliability and performance of complex cloud systems.

- Are comfortable working in Rust.

- Are comfortable with LLM-assisted development and evals.

- Are comfortable working with Embedded databases.

- Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers

- Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

### **About the Role**

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

We are seeking a dynamic Workplace Experience professional to support the daily operations of our São Paulo office and play a key role in its ongoing growth and development. In this role, you will not only support our local team but also collaborate with colleagues across Braze to drive global workplace and employee experience initiatives.

As our São Paulo office expands, we’re looking for builders - resourceful, hands-on individuals who thrive in ambiguity and can create structure where needed. This position sits within the People Team and reports to the Regional Manager, Workplace Experience - AMER.

Braze is a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, and we need a self-starter who exercises sound judgment, takes initiative, and proactively enhances the employee experience. You’ll maintain a strong pulse on the needs of our employees and be adaptable to evolving global conditions and workplace dynamics. This role will be required to be in-office 5 days per week.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

- Deliver exceptional customer service to all who enter the São Paulo office, upholding Braze’s high standards of hospitality, including onboarding support to new hires

- Support the planning and execution of local events and activations, including holiday celebrations, mixers, ERG events, and employee engagement programming, collaborating with the local culture committee to ensure a high-quality and consistent employee experience
- Balance multiple priorities with ease, responding to urgent needs while keeping day-to-day tasks running smoothly and on schedule

- Support compliance with health and safety requirements, working closely with external providers, building management, and internal stakeholders to maintain a safe and compliant workplace
- Be a flexible team player, jumping in to support the Workplace team with ad-hoc tasks, PTO coverage, and operational needs as they arise

**WHO YOU ARE**

- Demonstrated experience in a similar role; experience in customer service a plus
- Ability to work on-site, Monday to Friday, maintaining a full-time, in-office schedule
- Someone who is confident, positive, and comfortable being in a highly visible role that will define the reputation of the Braze Workplace Team
- Passion for best-in-class workplace experience and customer service
- A strong communicator with excellent grammatical skills
- A sharp eye for detail and good organizational skills
- Proactive and self-motivated with the ability to set own priorities
- A creative problem-solver, bringing innovative ideas and solutions to the table
- An awesome can-do attitude - no task is too big or too small
- Ability to physically stand, bend, squat, and lift up to 25 to 30 pounds
- Familiar with Mac computer and GSuite

**WHAT WE OFFER**

_Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at [here](https://www.braze.com/company/careers/how-we-hire#benefit-section). More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment._

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

- Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
- Flexible paid time off
- Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
- Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
- Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
- A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
- Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching
- Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
- Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

**ABOUT BRAZE**

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

**OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS**

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

**The Opportunity (Brazil)**

We are seeking a hands-on Sr. Business Systems Analyst at **Brazil** to support new projects, enhancements, and continuous improvement across end-to-end sales systems. This role will partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Field Operations, Compensation, Finance, and Engineering teams to translate business needs into scalable solutions spanning Salesforce, quoting, Aviso, forecasting, reporting tools, and related integrations.

A key focus of this role will be strengthening forecasting processes and improving confidence in pipeline, forecast, and revenue data. The analyst will support Aviso administration, forecast views, inspection workflows, dashboards, data synchronization, reporting, and user adoption while helping ensure that forecasting information is accurate, timely, consistent, and actionable for sales leaders and executives.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable managing multiple initiatives from discovery through implementation. This person will evaluate business processes, define requirements, coordinate testing and deployment, resolve system and data issues, and drive adoption of solutions that improve sales productivity, forecast accuracy, data quality, and operational visibility.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis and Project Delivery

- Partner with stakeholders to understand business objectives, processes, pain points, and system requirements.

- Lead or support initiatives from discovery and requirements definition through design, testing, deployment, and post-launch support.

- Translate business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, and solution documentation.

- Evaluate current-state processes and recommend improvements that enhance efficiency, scalability, controls, and user experience.

- Coordinate across business, systems, engineering, and implementation teams to deliver projects and enhancements on time.

- Support prioritization, scope management, risk identification, status reporting, and stakeholder communications.

- Facilitate workshops, process reviews, design sessions, and requirements validation meetings.


Sales Systems and Process Support

- Support end-to-end sales processes, including lead and opportunity management, account and territory structures, forecasting, quoting, approvals, order handoff, renewals, and reporting.

- Analyze and resolve system, workflow, data, integration, and user-access issues across Salesforce, quoting platforms, Aviso, and related tools.

- Maintain and improve data quality, business rules, field definitions, ownership structures, hierarchies, and system controls.

- Partner with system administrators and technical teams to design and implement Salesforce enhancements, workflows, automation, reports, dashboards, and integrations.

- Support quoting and related processes, including product, pricing, discounting, approval, configuration, and downstream data requirements.

- Monitor system integrations and data synchronization, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate root-cause resolution.

- Support user access, role-based visibility, permissions, and security requirements as needed.


Aviso, Forecasting, and Reporting

- Support the operational use and continuous improvement of Aviso or comparable forecasting and revenue intelligence platforms.

- Help define and improve forecast views, inspection workflows, dashboards, rules, and reporting.

- Support pipeline inspection, revenue reporting, and data-reconciliation processes.

- Build and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, scorecards, and executive-ready summaries.

- Consolidate information from multiple systems into concise insights, trends, and recommended actions.

- Ensure reporting requirements are clearly defined, validated, documented, and aligned with business definitions.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Spark
jobs.description:
### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for **Engineering Managers** to lead engineering effort on Supabase Spark. Supabase Spark is an initiative to build the next frontier of agentic databases, supporting billions of databases, with millions of databases created every day.

Although we don’t require managers to contribute to code directly, we do expect you to participate in design discussions and to be involved in setting the bar for engineering quality and best practices.

### What You’ll Be Responsible For

**Team & People**

- Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

- Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

- Handle people admin (leave, time off, etc.) for your team.


**Hiring**

- Own the hiring plan for your team and act as Hiring Manager. First round of interviewer for all roles on the team.

- Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates.

- Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.


**Delivery & Roadmap**

- Own the team's roadmap and project management (Linear), driving accountability and clear milestones.

- Manage workflow intake and Slack triage. These are the team’s primary inboxes for cross-team requests. You decide what gets routed where, prioritized, or pushed back on.

- Own the team's weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating overhead.

- Organize effort against support tickets and maintain the team's SLO.

- Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and clearly to leadership.


**Incident Commander**

- Train as an Incident Commander. Drive coordination, resolution, and post-incident follow-up.

- Lead blameless post-incident reviews


### **You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

- Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

- Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

- Have managed engineering teams at a cloud, SaaS, or developer tools company.

- Experience with developer tools or databases, plus if that includes both SQLite and Postgres ecosystems.

- Strong technical credibility in backend and database systems: APIs, auth, and Postgres access control (roles, grants, RLS) etc.

- Has led a team shipping a developer facing API or platform product from early stage to production.

- **Have managed remote, globally distributed teams** that work **asynchronously** across disparate time zones.

- Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but **genuinely passionate about people management.** This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for.

- Build psychological safety and a feedback culture: you give feedback often and in the moment, ask for it back, and create space for the team to do the same.

- Operate as a **multiplier.** Focused on helping individuals achieve more than they could alone, not on being the best technical voice in the room.

- Coach rather than direct. Remove blockers, connect people to context and resources, and trust your engineers to own how the work gets done.

- Have a real track record of **performance management** and can speak to specific examples of difficult conversations and how you navigated them.

- Are comfortable with ambiguity and capable of building structure where there isn't much.

- Communicate clearly and write well. You're default async, default written, set context proactively, and surface risks early.

- Are collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable. You thrive working with high-autonomy, senior ICs who have strong technical opinions and don't need to be the smartest person in the room.

- Are comfortable with aggressive scoping and eval driven development.


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Automation, Integration & AI Technology Consultant
jobs.description:
#### Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

#### Job Description

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Technical Consultant (IC4)** to join our team in Brazil. This role requires a strong technical background across the ServiceNow platform, with particular depth in **Integrations, Robotic Process Automation (RPA), App Engine, portals, and core platform development**.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical expertise with strong consulting and governance skills, and has demonstrated knowledge of **Artificial Intelligence capabilities and Now Assist implementation**.

**What you will do**

- Design and deliver scalable solutions on the **ServiceNow platform**, following platform architecture and development best practices.
- Lead the technical design and implementation of complex **integrations** between ServiceNow and enterprise systems.
- Develop and implement solutions leveraging **App Engine**, workflow automation and **RPA** capabilities.
- Support the design and development of **portals and user experiences** within the ServiceNow ecosystem.
- Provide strong expertise in **core ServiceNow platform development and configuration**.
- Design and implement **AI-enabled solutions**, with particular focus on **Now Assist** use cases and adoption.
- Translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, considering scalability, maintainability and platform standards.
- Provide **technical governance**, ensuring solution quality, architectural consistency and adherence to ServiceNow best practices.
- Work closely with customers, architects, developers and business stakeholders to guide technical decisions and resolve complex implementation challenges.
- Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers maximise the value of their ServiceNow investment.

#### Qualifications

**Required Qualifications**

- Solid experience working with the **ServiceNow platform** in technical consulting, development, architecture or implementation roles.
- Strong hands-on experience with:
  - **Integrations and APIs**
  - **RPA / automation**
  - **App Engine**
  - **Portal development / user experiences**
  - **ServiceNow core platform development**
- Strong understanding of **technical governance**, development standards and scalable solution design.
- Demonstrated knowledge of **Artificial Intelligence applied to enterprise workflows**.
- Experience with or strong knowledge of **Now Assist implementation and use cases**.
- Ability to navigate complex technical environments and engage effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
- Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
- **Advanced English**.
- **Portuguese fluency**.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- **Spanish** language skills.
- ServiceNow certifications or relevant technical certifications.
- Experience working on complex enterprise implementations involving multiple systems and integrations.
- Experience advising customers on platform architecture, governance and adoption.

#### Additional Information

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. [Learn more here](https://careers.servicenow.com/life-at-servicenow#workpersonas). To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact [globaltalentss@servicenow.com](mailto:globaltalentss@servicenow.com) for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
