jobs.description:
### **✨ One platform, a whole world of opportunity**

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:

- Ranked **#10 of 250** on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of [America's Top WorkTech Companies](https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-hr-named-10-of-americas-top-worktech-companies-of-2026-by-time)

- Named one of [America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026](https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-2026-newsweek-award) by Newsweek

- A [G2 Spring 2026 Leader](https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-named-best-roi-for-any-global-employment-platform-for-g2-spring-2026) across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

- The only **B Corp-certified** global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023


Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

### The Role

**Location:** While this position is posted in a specific location, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote and you can work from home. Forever. To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires you to be based within UTC−6 to UTC+3.

**Role Summary**

Oyster is hiring an Integrated Campaign Manager to lead the planning and execution of integrated growth campaigns for global prospective customers, turning target accounts into pipeline and accelerating open opportunities. Reporting to the Director of Demand Generation and Growth Marketing, you'll partner closely with our Product Marketing, Brand, Digital, Events, Ops, and Sales teams to deliver one coherent buyer journey across every channel.

This is a role for a marketer who wants their work measured in pipeline, not page views. You’ll own Oyster’s integrated campaigns end to end. Deciding the strategy, the channel mix and the spend, and you’ll see directly how your work drives revenue. You’ll sit at the centre of Marketing and Sales, with the scope to shape how we reach companies hiring across borders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand Generation & Campaign Execution**

- Develop, execute and optimize multi-channel demand generation campaigns. Including content syndication, webinars, virtual events, email nurtures, direct mail, referral programs, and demo programs: to drive net-new pipeline and accelerate open opportunities.

- Build quarterly campaign plans that balance always-on programs with high-impact moments for the full prospect lifecycle, modeled backward from pipeline goals to determine program mix and spend.

- Partner with Product Marketing and Brand to turn positioning into campaign messaging, offers, and content that is tested and refined based on results.

- Build campaign enablement (talk tracks, email templates, one-pagers) and align with BDRs on follow-up expectations so campaign interest converts into meetings.

- Manage timelines, budget, and resources to ensure successful campaign delivery with ROI accountability.


**Cross-Functional Partnership & Continuous Improvement**

- Partner closely with stakeholders in marketing, sales, operations and external vendors to ensure consistent, aligned campaign execution across the business.

- Optimize campaigns and refine strategies based on data-driven results, including A/B testing and performance reporting.

- Identify opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve research, segmentation, personalization, campaign development, content distribution, analysis, and execution.

- Facilitate retrospectives and turn performance findings into optimized campaigns and repeatable playbooks.


**Core Requirements**

- 6+ years in B2B integrated or demand generation marketing, including substantial ownership of demand generation, integrated campaigns, growth marketing, or account-based marketing.

- A track record of building campaigns that tie directly to pipeline coverage and revenue outcomes, not just engagement metrics.

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Data-driven, with working knowledge of attribution and pipeline measurement.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools for campaign planning, content acceleration, or workflow automation.

- Experience with Salesforce and HubSpot, or equivalent CRM/MAP platforms.

- Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting strategy and results to senior stakeholders.


**You'll also need**

- A reliable home internet connection and fluency in both written and spoken English.


### **How we work together at Oyster**

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the [Oyster Public HQ](https://oysterhr.notion.site/Welcome-to-The-Reef-Oyster-s-Open-Source-Employee-Guide-fc482e3f107c4afd8c85ed217f1d0c1d) so other global teams can learn from us.

### **How YOU work**

With diverse locations, cultures, and needs, we created [How YOU Work;](https://oysterhr.notion.site/How-YOU-work-ac16c1932e314ffd8cb693e332458395) a program supporting your whole human experience at Oyster:

- **Work from anywhere:** Oyster has no borders or HQ. As long as work is timely, your team is supported, and you're authorized to work where you live, you can work from anywhere.

- **Paid time off:** Enjoy 40 days off per year (including holidays and vacation), or more if required by your country.

- **Mental health support:** Access [Plumm](https://oysterhr.notion.site/Plumm-3b5e7e70dec6428e975f68f25972cfb7), our mental well-being service.

- **Wellbeing allowance:** Each month, receive a wellbeing allowance in your ThanksBen wallet to spend on a wide range of options.

- **Flexible parental leave:** All new parents are eligible for at least three months’ paid leave, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required locally.

- **WFH stipend:** Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.


### **✨ The best jobs should be available to everyone**

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.

Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email [jobs@oysterhr.com](mailto:jobs@oysterhr.com) with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.

Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @ _oysterhr.com_ email, and **we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer.** If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than [www.oysterhr.com/careers](http://www.oysterhr.com/careers), please report it via our [Compliance and Ethics Helpline](https://faceup.com/c/8tpzyyye).

- **Regional Escalation Management:** Act as the first line of escalation for platinum partner issues in LATAM, resolving regional matters locally and escalating global decisions appropriately.

- **Pipeline Visibility & Performance Tracking:** Utilize Salesforce, Crossbeam, and Clari to track platinum partner performance across LATAM and contribute to global reporting.


**WHO YOU ARE**

- **Proven track record in partner sales, alliances, or SI/agency ecosystem roles in B2B SaaS**, with direct experience managing senior relationships with global SIs or agency holding companies (Deloitte, Accenture, WPP, Publicis, Merkle or equivalent) at a regional level.

- **Execution & Regional Judgement:** Comfortable executing global strategies while making critical regional judgement calls tailored to local markets.

- **Enablement & Delivery Standards:** Experience with partner certification, enablement, or practice-quality models, with a clear view of delivery quality and capability.

- **Matrix Collaboration:** Skilled at operating effectively in a matrix environment, collaborating across central Delivery leadership and regional Partner Sales teams.

- **Ecosystem Expertise:** Deep knowledge of MarTech or adjacent SaaS ecosystems, with a strategic view on how composable tech stacks create delivery opportunities for SIs and agencies.

- **Technical & Mapping Tools:** Proficient in using account mapping tools such as Crossbeam or equivalent to track regional partner engagement, as well as CRM/reporting tools (Salesforce, Clari).

- **Languages:** Business-level fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is essential for regional execution.

As a **Staff / Specialist II** level position, we expect a high degree of autonomy, technical depth, and the ability to influence engineering and architecture decisions across different teams and contexts.

Main responsibilities

- Act as a technical reference for **Product Security**, supporting Engineering and Product teams in identifying and mitigating risks.

- Assess security aspects related to **Identity & Access Management (IAM), authentication, authorization, APIs, tokens, and sessions**.
- Perform technical assessments and support **security reviews** of components and implementations of highest criticality.
- Identify risks and vulnerabilities, recommending controls and technically following mitigation strategies.
- Work with Engineering to turn security requirements into **scalable, reusable, and, whenever possible, automated solutions**.
- Contribute to reducing vulnerabilities and security debt through structural engineering improvements.
- Work in partnership with other Security, Engineering, and Architecture areas to evolve security controls and practices.
- Share knowledge and best practices, helping increase teams' autonomy in security-related decision-making.

At this level, the person should:

- Act autonomously on complex, ambiguous, and highly critical problems.
- Be recognised as a **technical reference** in their area of expertise.

- Act as a mentor to other professionals and contribute to raising the organisation's technical maturity.
- Contribute to standards, practices, and technical direction with impact beyond a single product or team.

#### Qualifications

- Extensive professional experience in technology, including at least 5 years in Product Security, Application Security, Security Engineering, or related areas.
- Experience with application security and/or Identity & Access Management (IAM), including authentication, authorization, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, API security, Threat Modeling, and Secure by Design.
- Experience working directly with Engineering and Architecture teams, evaluating architectures, technical risks, and implementations, and translating security requirements into scalable solutions.
- Experience exercising technical leadership, leading complex and cross-functional initiatives, defining technical standards, and influencing engineering decisions without direct hierarchical authority.
- Experience collaborating with global and multicultural teams, including interaction with stakeholders from different areas, geographies, and levels of seniority.
- Advanced or fluent English

**GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Senior** **Backend Software Engineer**for our **Marketing Engineering & Platform (MEP)** team in **Brazil - Remote**! This is a **Remote – Brazil** position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

You will join the **B2B Acquisition squad**, part of the Marketing Engineering & Platform (MEP) Focus Area inside Wellhub's Product Development organization. We own the entire SMB customer acquisition journey: from the initial lead capture and self-service buy flows, through pricing and dynamic quotation rules, to the final onboarding handover into Wellhub for Companies. Our domain operates on a polyglot, event-driven backend—primarily built with **Kotlin/Spring Boot** and **Go** communicating via **Kafka**, complemented by a GraphQL BFF and direct integrations into enterprise platforms like Salesforce, HubSpot, and Segment. In this role, you will partner daily with Product, Marketing, and Sales to build scalable architecture, optimize conversion funnels, and solve core business challenges with high autonomy.

**YOUR IMPACT**

- Own critical SMB acquisition funnel services end to end, designing, deploying, and maintaining high-throughput backend applications in Kotlin and Go.
- Drive event-driven architecture and asynchronous messaging patterns using Kafka, ensuring data consistency, idempotency, and resilience across multiple services.
- Harden and scale direct integrations with business-critical platforms, collaborating closely with marketing and sales systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, and Segment.
- Establish robust observability and reliability practices across all owned services, defining meaningful SLOs and alerts with Datadog and OpenTelemetry to catch issues proactively.
- Partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders to translate business goals into well-architected technical solutions with transparent trade-offs.
- Collaborate actively across engineering teams to continuously evolve architecture, conduct thorough code reviews, and mentor peers through shared technical ownership.
- Leverage AI-assisted development workflows and engineering productivity tools to accelerate feature delivery, test coverage, and documentation.
- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- A skilled backend engineer with hands-on experience designing, building, and operating distributed systems in production environments.
- A versatile developer with solid production experience in Kotlin and Go, or extensive background in modern Java with strong enthusiasm to work primarily with Kotlin and Go.
- An experienced practitioner in event-driven systems and asynchronous processing, with practical knowledge of Kafka (or equivalent message brokers) and resilient API design.
- A cloud-oriented software engineer with practical experience managing containerized microservices deployed on AWS and Kubernetes.
- A pragmatic developer with solid experience in data modeling and database management across relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (Redis, DynamoDB) datastores.
- An inquisitive technologist who actively leverages AI coding assistants and modern development tools to optimize daily workflows and engineering efficiency.
- An effective team communicator with fluency in Portuguese for daily squad interactions, and comfortable working proficiency in English for cross-team documentation and occasional stakeholder alignment.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in backend software engineering with Kotlin, Go, or Java, experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka), and professional working proficiency in English are mandatory requirements

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

**WELLZ:** A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTHCARE:** Health, dental, and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

**PAID TIME OFF:** It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

**CAREER GROWTH:** Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

**CULTURE:** You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. [Learn more about our shared culture and values here.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/)

jobs.title: SDK Engineer - Python
jobs.description:
### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a **SDK Engineer - Python** to join our **SDK team** and own how developers talk to Supabase from Python. You'll work closely with the rest of the SDK team, our Auth, Realtime, Storage, PostgREST, Functions, CLI and Docs teams, and the open-source community, helping us make the Python SDK a library Python developers genuinely enjoy using.

Python developers reach Supabase from backend services, data pipelines, notebooks, and a growing number of AI agents and agent frameworks. The Python SDK is how all of them talk to the platform: database queries, auth, storage, realtime and edge functions, in both sync and async flavors.

This is a library-authoring role, and the work happens in the open: public repos, public issue trackers, and API decisions whose consequences last for years. If you get satisfaction from a type checker that catches the bug before your users do, from an async client that cleans up after itself, and from an issue tracker that isn't a graveyard, you'll like it here.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

### What You'll Be Responsible For

- **Build and evolve our Python SDK** across database, auth, storage, realtime and functions, with both sync and async APIs that feel natural in Python.

- **Start new things.** Alongside the maintenance work, find what's missing, make the case for it, and build it. Nobody will hand you the list.

- **Work in the open.** Triage inbound issues, review and shepherd outside contributions, keep CI and release automation healthy, and hold a clear, kind line on scope.

- **Own the typing experience.** Make the SDK fully typed and checker-friendly, so autocomplete and static analysis stay correct in real codebases.

- **Keep us honest across environments.** Multiple Python versions, sync and async frameworks, workers, serverless and notebooks — with dependency ranges that don't fight our users' projects. Test it, don't assume it.

- **Work on realtime.** Long-lived websocket connections, reconnection, and subscription and presence semantics.

- **Track the platform.** When auth, realtime, storage, postgrest or edge functions ship a change, make sure the SDK reflects it, and that we say so in the changelog.

- **Design in public.** Write the RFCs, migration guides, release notes and docs. Treat a breaking change as a deprecation path plus a migration story, not a version bump.

- **Make our SDK legible to AI coding agents**, which are now a major consumer of it.


### **You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

- **Know modern Python typing deeply.** You use generics, protocols, overloads and `TypedDict` as design tools, run strict type checking, and fix type errors without reaching for `Any`.

- **Have authored or maintained a published library** with a public API and users outside your own company. You know what it costs to change something people depend on.

- **Know the maintainer side of open source.** Issue triage at volume, reviewing outside PRs, release automation, changelogs and semver, security reports, and saying no to a feature request without losing the person who asked.

- **Are fluent in asyncio** and have opinions on how a library should serve both sync and async callers.

- **Know Python packaging** for libraries: `pyproject.toml`, wheels, modern tooling, version support policy, and why libraries shouldn't pin their dependencies tightly.

- **Test as a habit:** unit, type-level and end-to-end against a real stack. Every fix comes with a regression test.

- **Write well.** Design docs, changelogs and issue replies are a large part of the output here, much of it public, and we're async by default.

- **Have real autonomy:** you find the important work, scope it, ship it, and say what you didn't do.

- Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences

- Have experience in async or globally distributed teams

- Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers

- Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly


**Bonus points if you:** have run a major-version migration for a public package, know your way around JWT/OAuth, have built integrations for AI agent frameworks, or have generated idiomatic clients from a schema.

#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

#### About Logos (λ)

[Logos (λ)](https://logos.co/) is a movement of technologists, creatives, strategists, and activists working together to build a sovereign, people-owned technology stack that revitalises civil society and protects digital liberties at scale.

This position is within the IFT Technical Services (IFT-TS) Distributed Systems Testing (DST) Team, a team that primarily supports Logos, while also contributing to other IFT projects.

#### The role

We are seeking an experienced Distributed Systems Evaluation Engineer to join the Institute of Free Technology - Technical Services, on the Distributed Systems Testing (IFT-TS DST) team. This role focuses on rigorously assessing the performance and reliability of IFT projects at scale, where Logos (λ) is one of them.

Logos (λ) technology stack is composed of 3 main components:

- **Logos (λ) Blockchain**: Advanced privacy for a new era of decentralised applications and social institutions.
- **Logos (λ) Messaging**: Private peer‑to‑peer communication that resists surveillance and censorship.
- **Logos (λ) Storage**: Secure decentralised storage enabling fully decentralised apps and file sharing.

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic DevOps Engineer to join our Distributed Systems Testing (DST) team.

You’ll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive evaluation strategies, leveraging both large-scale lab deployments and protocol behavior modeling scripts. Your expertise will be crucial in analyzing these complex distributed systems, automating intricate test scenarios, and providing in-depth insights into system behaviors.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll troubleshoot complex issues and translate technical data into actionable recommendations. Proficiency in containerization, cloud technologies, and distributed systems principles is essential.

#### Key responsibilities

- Design, configure, and optimize Kubernetes clusters to support large-scale experiments and benchmarks of P2P technologies.
- Continuously improve cluster scalability and resource utilization, enabling increasingly complex deployments and experiments.
- Set up, maintain, and optimize supporting infrastructure such as monitoring, logging, and observability stacks (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, etc.).
- Collaborate with DST researchers and engineers to streamline experimentation workflows and make analysis easier and more reproducible.
- Automate infrastructure and deployment workflows to increase reliability and reduce overhead.
- Troubleshoot, profile, and tune distributed workloads to ensure accurate and performant benchmarking.
- Identify, reproduce, and debug complex issues in distributed systems, working closely with Logos development teams.

#### You ideally will have

- Strong experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production or research environments.
- Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure, Linux systems, and networking (especially relevant to distributed/P2P systems).
- Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Grafana, Prometheus, VictoriaLogs, etc.).
- Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, Helm, etc.).
- Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (ideally Python).
- Interest in or experience with distributed systems, P2P networks, or blockchain technologies.
- Experience with networks and systems programming.
- Excellent written and conversational communication skills.
- Alignment with our core values and principles.

#### Bonus points

- Hands-on experience with libp2p or projects in the Logos collective.
- Background in performance benchmarking, scalability testing, or systems research.
- Contributions to open source projects.
- Experience working for an open-source organization.

#### Interview Process

- Interview with our POps team
- Interview with team member from the IFT-TS DST team
- Pair programming & discussion of results
- Interview with IFT-TS team lead

We are hiring an **Client Sales Account Executive** to our **Wellz** team in **Brazil**!

Operating regionally as an individual contributor, this role develops active prospecting strategies, cultivates relationships with C-level and HR stakeholders, and executes consultative discovery sessions to design tailored value propositions. The position directly impacts revenue predictability, market authority, and customer lifetime value through rigorous pipeline management and seamless cross-functional collaboration.

[Wellz by Wellhub](https://www.wellz.com/pt-br/) is our corporate mental health platform, delivering measurable, science-backed results for companies and their employees. **YOUR IMPACT**

- Execute the full B2B sales cycle for high-complexity corporate accounts, from initial prospecting and discovery to final negotiation and deal closure.
- Develop continuous active outbound and inbound prospecting strategies targeted at Enterprise companies to maintain a healthy sales pipeline volume.
- Independently initiate and cultivate purposeful relationships with multiple key stakeholders and decision-makers (e.g., HR Directors, Benefits Managers, C-Level) within target accounts.
- Conduct strategic and consultative discovery meetings using complex B2B sales methodologies to diagnose hidden organizational challenges like absenteeism, turnover, and healthcare costs.
- Design customized technical-commercial value propositions that connect clinical data intelligence to the client's specific financial and operational challenges.
- Develop data-driven business cases and ROI analyses to demonstrate the business impact of Wellhub and support client purchasing decisions.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with BDRs, Wellhub Account Executives, and Client Success teams to unlock cross-selling opportunities and market intelligence.
- Ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation of accounts, contacts, and deal stages in the CRM platform to guarantee reliable weekly and monthly forecasting data.
- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

- Experience in Strategic or Enterprise Sales roles or revenue-generating B2B roles with a proven track record of navigating complex sales cycles.

- Proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce and Pipedrive), executive prospecting, and commercial workflow optimization using AI tools (Claude, Gemini, or Sales AI).
- Fluent English with strong communication skills and a background in Corporate Wellness or SaaS environments.

jobs.title: General Manager, LATAM (Sales & Partners)
jobs.description:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at [amplitude.com](http://amplitude.com).

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

#### **About the Role & Team**

Latin America is one of Amplitude's largest regions, with more than $20M in customer ARR across leading digital businesses in Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Chile and Colombia. We go to market with a hybrid model: our team sells directly to our largest customers, and we sell with and through regional partners who help us reach new markets and serve customers in their language. As General Manager, you'll own the full LATAM business, direct and partner, and lead the team that grows it. You'll be based in São Paulo and report to VP Americas.

#### **As General Manager, Latin America, you will:**

- Own the LATAM go-to-market strategy and results across direct, sell-with and sell-through motions, including clear rules of engagement between our sellers and partners.

- Lead and grow the regional team of Account Executives and a Partner Sales Manager, and work closely with and dotted line lead the Customer Success, Solutions Consulting and Sales Development teams who support LATAM; hire, coach and develop leaders in-region.

- Build a partner ecosystem that scales: select, sign and enable reseller, referral, consulting and agency partners, and work with our cloud and data platform partners.

- Serve as executive sponsor for our largest customers, driving retention, expansion and long-term value.

- Forecast accurately across the direct and partner business and run a disciplined operating cadence.

- Be the voice of LATAM inside Amplitude, partnering with Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product and Deal Desk on localized programs, events and pricing.

- Drive a culture of urgency and high standards in the region - hiring top talent and coaching and driving high performance and continuous improvement.


#### **You'll be a great addition to the team if you have:**

- Experience on both sides of the ecosystem, at a software company and at an agency, consultancy or partner.

- A background in analytics, martech, data or digital experience software.

- Relationships with digital-native, fintech and retail leaders in Latin America.

- Experience launching a region or building a partner program from an early stage.

- Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales methodology, and with cloud marketplaces or distribution partners.


#### **At a minimum, you need to have:**

- 8+ years in B2B software sales, including 5+ years leading sales teams.

- Experience leading a business with both direct and partner (indirect) revenue in Latin America.

- Experience forecasting and managing a multi-country business.

- Professional fluency in Portuguese, Spanish and English.

- Based in, or willing to relocate to, São Paulo, Brazil, with regular travel across Latin America.


### Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

- **Humility:** We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

- **Ownership:** We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

- **Growth Mindset:** We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

- **Customer Centricity:** We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.


**We care about the well-being of our team:** We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

- Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

- 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

- Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

- Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

- Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

- Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

- Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)


**Other fun facts about Amplitude:**

- Our customers love us! They've said we're the [#1 product analytics solution](https://www.g2.com/categories/product-analytics/enterprise) for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

- We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

- We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

- We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.

- We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.

- We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.

- Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer – GPU & AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Senior Solution Engineer – GPU & AI Infrastructure

About Civo:

Civo is a high-performance neocloud provider purpose-built for the demands of modern AI, high-performance computing (HPC), and cloud-native infrastructure. We eliminate legacy cloud overhead to deliver ultra-low-latency compute, bare-metal GPU performance, and streamlined Kubernetes orchestration at scale.

Purpose-designed for AI engineering teams, enterprises, and research institutions, Civo delivers direct access to cutting-edge NVIDIA GPU clusters, high-speed fabrics, and parallel storage systems required to train, fine-tune, and deploy foundation models efficiently. We combine high-density infrastructure with predictable pricing and maximum compute throughput, empowering organizations to scale AI workloads without the complexity or cost bloat of traditional hyperscalers.

About the Role:

As a Senior Solution Engineer – GPU & AI Infrastructure, you will serve as the primary technical architect for Civo's large-scale AI and high-performance computing (HPC) customer initiatives. You will act as the critical technical bridge partnering with the Sales team across both pre-sales discovery and post-sales implementation phases.

During the pre-sales cycle, you will bridge the gap between customer business objectives and ultra-high-performance hardware execution by translating complex AI workload requirements into production-ready High-Level Designs (HLD), Low-Level Designs (LLD), and detailed Bills of Materials (BOM). Post-sales, you will guide customers through successful deployments, ensuring that the architectures you designed are effectively operationalized on Civo’s platform.

Your expertise will span bare-metal and Kubernetes-based orchestrations across cutting-edge NVIDIA architectures (including the Blackwell platform) using ultra-low-latency InfiniBand and high-speed RoCE networking fabrics.

Responsibilities:

Pre-Sales: Solution Design & Architecture

- System Design Documents: Author comprehensive High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) documentation for enterprise-scale GPU supercomputing clusters based on customer requirements.

- Bill of Materials (BOM): Generate detailed BOMs covering compute nodes, NVLink switches, network fabrics, transceivers/cabling, liquid/air cooling requirements, power distribution, and high-performance storage.

- GPU Cluster Topology: Architect scale-up (NVLink/NVSwitch) and scale-out network topologies (Fat-Tree, Rail-Optimized) for advanced NVIDIA platforms.

- Fabric & Networking Engineering: Design high-throughput, low-latency networking architectures utilizing InfiniBand and RoCE / RoCEv2 with lossless Ethernet mechanisms (PFC, ECN, Adaptive Routing).

- Multi-Tenant & Deployment Models: Deliver tailored architectures for both Bare-Metal (Slurm, OpenMPI) and Cloud-Native / Kubernetes environments (NVIDIA GPU Operator, Network Operator, KubeFlow).

- Technical Proposals: Produce precise technical proposals and lead technical responses to complex RFPs/RFIs regarding AI infrastructure.


Pre-Sales & Post-Sales: Customer Engagement & Validation

- Sales Partnership: Act as the primary technical partner to the commercial team, utilizing structured engagement frameworks (e.g., MEDDPIC) to drive high-value AI infrastructure opportunities.

- Executive Consultation: Engage directly with customer CTOs, Chief AI Officers, infrastructure leads, and ML engineers to evaluate technical requirements, compute sizing, and fabric choices.

- Proof-of-Concept (PoC): Architect and oversee PoC deployments to validate real-world performance for customer workloads prior to full commitment.

- Post-Sales Implementation Guidance: Serve as the technical continuity lead post-sale, ensuring customer workloads successfully transition from the PoC/design phase into production deployment.

- Performance Benchmarking (Post-Sales): Guide the benchmarking of cluster performance during deployment using industry-standard tools (NCCL tests, GPUDirect RDMA latency/bandwidth) and address network or thermal optimization issues during validation.


Product & Ecosystem Collaboration

- Vendor Alignment: Serve as the bridge between enterprise AI clients, hardware vendors (NVIDIA, network OEMs), and Civo's internal platform engineering team.

- Product Feedback Loop: Provide continuous feedback from customer engagements to product teams regarding market trends, hardware platform demands, and feature requirements for AI/GPU orchestration.


Key Results/Objectives:

- Technical Wins: Achieve high technical win rates on large-scale AI/GPU cluster sales opportunities through exceptional architectural design.

- Delivery Excellence: Successfully deliver complete, peer-reviewed HLDs, LLDs, and BOMs within target deal timelines.

- Successful Onboarding: Achieve successful PoC completion and sign-off for enterprise clients, and maintain technical oversight through initial post-sales deployment.


Requirements:

Experience & Core Qualifications

- 5+ years in a Solution Architecture, Systems Engineering, or Technical Pre/Post-Sales role focused on high-performance cloud, HPC, or AI infrastructure.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise customers through the full lifecycle of complex technical sales, from initial discovery to deployment execution.


Technical Expertise

- NVIDIA GPU Architecture: Deep hands-on knowledge of NVIDIA HGX/DGX platforms, NVLink/NVSwitch fabrics, and Blackwell architectures.

- High-Speed Networking: Expert-level knowledge of cluster fabric topologies across InfiniBand (Quantum/Subnet Management) and RoCE / RoCEv2 (Spectrum Ethernet, PFC, ECN).

- GPU Direct Technologies: Familiarity with GPUDirect RDMA (GDR) and GPUDirect Storage (GDS).

- Orchestration & Platforms: Proficiency in deploying and optimizing GPU workloads on Kubernetes (CNI, NVIDIA GPU Operator) and Bare-Metal (Slurm, PyTorch/NCCL tuning).

- Documentation Skills: Demonstrated experience creating enterprise-grade HLDs, LLDs, network rack diagrams, and itemized BOMs.

- Power & Thermal Awareness: Familiarity with high-density datacenter environments and liquid cooling technologies.


Soft Skills

- Strong technical leadership and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex network and hardware tradeoffs to executive stakeholders.

- Problem-solving mindset capable of diagnosing complex hardware-software interaction bottlenecks in distributed training/inference setups.


Nice to Have:

- NVIDIA Certified Professional: AI Infrastructure (NCP-AII)

- NVIDIA Certified Professional: AI Networking (NCP-AIN)

- NVIDIA Certified Professional: InfiniBand (NCP-IB)

- NVIDIA Certified Associate / Professional: AI Workload Deployment & Cloud Native


Why Join Civo?

- Competitive compensation and benefits package.

- 4-day work week company (unless attending an event).

- Uncapped holiday.

- Remote work environment with flexibility and autonomy.

- Collaborative and inclusive culture that values diversity and creativity.

- Opportunity to work with a dynamic and innovative team in the fast-growing cloud industry.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Gameplay
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

**About You**

You love to play chess and want to help others discover that same passion. You understand the full user journey of being a chess player, and different types of players need to experience to find joy in the game. You are intimately familiar with the Chess.com experience and want to help further build out the Gameplay ecosystem.

You have extensive experience as a product manager shipping delightful consumer-facing products. You have worked deeply with design and engineering teams to define what great looks like and you communicate regularly and successfully to executive stakeholders.

**What you'll do**

- **Shape the Gameplay roadmap and vision.** In close partnership with leadership, shape both the near-term roadmap and the long-term vision for Gameplay at [Chess.com](http://Chess.com). From live games, to daily, to bot play, you will own the gameplay experience.
- **Bring ideas and sharpen them with the team.** Come with your own point of view on what's worth building and why. You don't wait to be told. At the same time, engage seriously with feedback from leadership and peers: internalize it, push back where you disagree, and use it to make the work better. The vision is built together; you're a strong, informed voice in it.
- **Operate in public.** As a globally remote company spanning many time zones, async slack communication is how decisions get made. Work out loud in channels: brainstorm openly, pose sharp questions, make decisive small calls with reasoning attached, and be explicit on what's urgent vs. not. Engage with depth and without ego, pull the right people in by name to build alignment. Make the most of sync meeting time by taking on the biggest questions.
- **Define success and hold the bar velocity and quality.** Frame the problem, partner deeply with engineers and designers, work through what "good enough to ship”. Get product scope first-time right.
- **Use AI to prototype, de-risk, and accelerate.** Build mocks, test flows, and pressure-test ideas yourself. Bring working artifacts into discussions, not just decks. Run AB tests with velocity and build with foresight on configurability.

**Required Skills**

- **7+ years in product management, 4+ shipping consumer-facing products at scale.** You've shipped consumer-facing products to large user bases. You know how to balance a quantitative understanding of funnels, metrics, and experimentation with a qualitative feel for what makes a delightful user experience.
- **Excellent product taste, especially in the chess context.** You know what feels good and what doesn't. You know what users with different levels of chess skill and experience are looking to get out of gameplay.
- **AI-native.** You already use AI daily to prototype, explore ideas, and accelerate execution. You build working prototypes as the basis for discussion.
- **High-velocity communicator.** You communicate clearly and concisely at speed and across many projects. You act as the focal point across design, engineering, stakeholders, product peers, and executives, digging into engineering specifics in one thread then zooming out to exec-level outcomes in the next.
- **US time zone overlap.** This role will have most of it’s key stakeholders across the US. While we are flexible with your location, we would require clear and substantial overlap with Eastern US hours.

**About the Opportunity**

- This is a full-time opportunity
- We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!)
- This role is open to candidates who can work with at least 4 hours of overlap with Eastern US hours.

---

You can learn more about us here:

- [Chess Is For Everyone!](https://www.chess.com/everyone)
- [Our Values](https://www.chess.com/jobs#values)

jobs.title: Senior Director, Partner Engagement & CRM (Global)
jobs.description:
**Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Senior Director, Partner Engagement & CRM (Global)**  to our **Partner Marketing** team in **Brazil**!

As Senior Director of Partner Engagement & CRM, you will own the global partner lifecycle: the engine that takes a partner from first sign-up to sustained, long-term business growth. You will lead a global team spanning lifecycle and CRM including partner enablement and education, as well as partner GTM motions, with a remit that covers every market Wellhub operates in.

This is explicitly not a "keep the campaigns running" role. We’re looking for a stand-out marketer who is able to elevate our partner experience, bringing both technical and creative skillsets to design, architect and lead a high performing team.

You will also be one of the most consequential AI builders in our marketing organisation. Partner lifecycle is the most agent-amenable surface in Partner Marketing, and it is where Wellhub expects AI to deliver visible, measurable leverage rather than incremental productivity. You will be expected to support the design and build of agentic systems and AI-driven decisioning into the lifecycle itself, not simply adopting tools others have built.

You will become a strategic partner to leaders across Partnerships, Partner Experience, Marketing, Product Development and MarTech, and will present regularly to VP and Executive Leadership Team audiences. Success in this role depends as much on your ability to build alignment and bring people with you as it does on the quality of the system you build.

The ideal candidate is a genuinely senior CRM and lifecycle marketer — someone who has built the function, not just run it — with a sophisticated broader marketing background, a proven record of driving reachability and engagement in a B2B or B2P audience, and the leadership presence to hold their own in an executive room.

**YOUR IMPACT**

- **Own the Partner Lifecycle CRM:** Define and own the end-to-end partner lifecycle strategy globally — driving reachability and activation through to sustained adoption
- **Architect compelling GTMs:** Turn new products and features into moments of delight for partners through carefully designed and orchestrated multi-channel marketing campaigns
- **AI Builder:** Design and build AI-driven decisioning, agentic workflows and automation into the lifecycle engine. Set the standard for what AI-first execution looks like in Partner Marketing, and raise the AI fluency of the team around you
- **Team Leadership & Design:** Lead, develop and grow a global team of high specialists and managers across lifecycle/CRM, enablement and partner advocacy. Shape the structure itself — defining the roles the new model needs, hiring into them, and building a culture of ownership and measurable impact
- **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work hand-in-hand with Partnerships, Partner Experience, Product Development, MarTech, Content, PMM and the regional Partner Marketing leads to deliver a coherent partner experience
- **Executive Presence:** Represent the function to VP and ELT-level stakeholders — setting direction, defending prioritisation, and translating a complex operational system into a clear commercial story
- **Live the mission**: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- Strong marketing experience, with deep specialist expertise in CRM and lifecycle marketing with a track record of driving reachability, engagement and retention in a B2B or B2P audience at scale
- Strong technical fluency with the modern martech stack (CRM platforms, Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, CDP/data tooling) and comfort working closely with Product and Data teams
- Sophisticated general marketing background beyond CRM — strategy, positioning, GTM and campaign craft — and the business acumen to connect marketing activity to commercial outcomes
- High AI adoption and fluency, with genuine appetite and capability to _build_ — designing AI-driven systems and agentic workflows, not only using off-the-shelf tools
- Strong analytical skills and a genuinely data-driven approach — comfortable defining metrics, designing tests, and being held to measurable lift
- Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex, technical systems accessible to non-specialist and senior audiences
- Based in Brazil, preferably with easy access to our São Paulo office to meet with stakeholders and team members.
- Fluent English - our business language

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

**WELLZ:** A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTHCARE:** Health, dental, and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

**PAID TIME OFF:** It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

**CAREER GROWTH:** Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

**CULTURE:** You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. [Learn more about our shared culture and values here.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/)

**Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on** [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/) **@lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on** [**YouTube**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgIPiszTVm4) **!**

**Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub**

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. [Read more about it here.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/wellhub_fairpay-syndio-activity-7407826561531363328-wbN_?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAzHQWABKsRqcpvxy4QpDCJNe_szRdC4hgY)

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our [Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice/#:~:text=Aviso%20de%20Privacidade%20para%20Candidatos)

jobs.title: Project Management Officer (PMO) - Web3
jobs.description:
**About the company**

Trust Wallet is the secure, self-custody Web3 wallet that empowers people to own and control their digital assets. Whether you're new to crypto or an experienced user, Trust Wallet makes it easier, safer, and more convenient to explore Web3, securely access dApps, manage your crypto, and buy and sell digital assets, all in one place.

#### The Role

We’re looking for a PMO to be the bridge between Product and Engineering. You’ll keep complex, fast-moving projects on track, make sure teams are aligned and unblocked, and build the trusted relationships that make delivery happen.

This role is equal parts delivery driver and team connector. You hold people accountable to timelines, and you do it with warmth, empathy, and genuine care for the team.

#### Job Scope:

- Bridge Product and Engineering: translate priorities, surface dependencies, and keep both sides aligned on scope, trade-offs, and timelines

- Drive ETAs and results: own project plans, track milestones, and push initiatives to completion on time

- Partner closely with PMs and engineering leads: run planning cadences, sprint reviews, and cross-team syncs that actually move work forward

- Spot and clear blockers early: identify risks, escalate the right issues to the right people, and drive resolution

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Metabase is the easiest way for people to get insights from their data, from tiny startups who get up and running quickly to major corporations with tens of thousands of users. That's why people love us.
 
We bring data tools with the elegance and simplicity of consumer products to the crufty world of enterprise business intelligence. We provide an opinionated open source starting point for how companies should measure, analyze and share their data, which is used by tens of thousands of companies.

About the Role
We’re looking for a Security Engineer with deep expertise in source code analysis and offensive product security research. You’ll dig into complex software architectures, trace how code behaves at runtime, uncover subtle vulnerabilities, and address the systemic flaws behind them.
Embedded in our core engineering team, you’ll help shape security decisions from early design through release and adoption. This is a hands-on engineering and research role: you’ll combine your security expertise with frontier AI tools to find vulnerabilities, develop fixes, and make Metabase secure by default across its product, dependencies, and runtime.

Things you’ll do
Partner with engineers throughout feature development, bringing security expertise to design, implementation, release, and adoption.
Build security-focused features, lead security improvements across the codebase, and implement fixes that address root causes.
Use and evaluate advanced AI tools to scale code analysis, vulnerability research, and secure engineering practices.
Conduct offensive research into Metabase, develop proofs of concept, and validate vulnerabilities.
Assess findings based on exploitability and real-world impact, define clear remediation criteria, and verify that fixes are effective.
Turn individual findings into broader improvements that prevent entire classes of vulnerabilities.

What you bring
A demonstrated track record of finding and exploiting application vulnerabilities through source code analysis and hands-on research.
The ability to independently navigate unfamiliar codebases, understand complex architectures, and reason about runtime behavior and trust boundaries.
Experience with application security challenges, including authentication, authorization, injection, and unsafe handling of untrusted data.
Sound judgment about exploitability and real-world impact, and the ability to communicate findings and remediation options clearly.
Strong software engineering skills, including the ability to implement durable security fixes. Experience in Clojure, or a strong desire to learn.
A thoughtful approach to AI-assisted security work, using these tools to extend your expertise while independently validating their output.
Ownership and curiosity: you pursue difficult questions, collaborate closely with engineers, and follow findings through to resolution.

Compensation
The US base salary range for this role is $160K–$225K annually, plus equity and benefits.
Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual qualifications, including skills, experience, and scope of responsibility. Pay may vary by geographic location and other job-related factors.

Benefits
We offer meaningful equity and a comprehensive US benefits package, including fully employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (with 75% coverage for dependents), a 401(k) with employer match available to enroll after the first 30 days, flexible and unlimited paid time off including sick time, and an asynchronous, remote-first environment.


We're a global team (50% outside the US), fully distributed (from Thailand to California), who get things done asynchronously, with plenty of uninterrupted time, supporting each other to do the best work of our careers. We offer flexibility (define your own schedule and work from wherever you want), autonomy, and an environment that fosters growth, learning, and development. We're relentlessly user-focused and believe in building long-term value, not short-term hacks. And we raised a $30M Series B to take our approach to the next level for years to come.
 
For U.S. applicants: Metabase participates in the federal E-Verify program, which confirms employment authorization of newly hired U.S. based employees. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates and is only initiated upon hire.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a FinOps Data Engineer to help drive cost optimization and cloud financial governance across our AWS infrastructure and GCP footprint. You'll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, and Product to find and ship savings, build the tooling necessary to maximize efficiency of every dollar spent in the cloud, and cultivate a culture of cost awareness across engineering teams. This role owns the data side of that mission: the models, pipelines, and analysis that make cost, usage, and margin numbers trustworthy across the company.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not an analyst seat. You'll do the schlep work other teams don't have time for, digging into a bucket's access pattern, writing the dbt model or Python pipeline that ships the fix, building the cost-vs-revenue mart that answers a margin question once instead of every time, and chasing a number until it reconciles. Strong communication matters as much as technical depth, you'll regularly explain a savings case or a data model's implications to an engineering team, a finance stakeholder, and a leadership audience in the same week.

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

In this role, you'll:

- **Find and ship savings across AWS and GCP:** Analyze billing, usage, and cost trends to identify opportunities, rightsizing, storage lifecycle policies, data transfer, and spot/auto-scaling. Take ideas from identification through to a realized dollar figure, not just a recommendation.

- **Build and maintain the FinOps data pipeline:** Design and run the BigQuery/dbt models that turn raw billing and usage data (CUR, Storage Lens) into reconciled, trustworthy mart tables, the foundation everything else in FinOps is built on.

- **Build cost-vs-revenue and customer segmentation models:** Model unit economics and margin by product line and customer segment, and extend coverage as new products and segments come online.

- **Apply data science to cost and usage data:** Build forecasting models, detect anomalies statistically rather than by threshold alone, and quantify savings opportunities (e.g. storage lifecycle, request-cost patterns) with rigor a spreadsheet can't match.

- **Build and maintain cost attribution:** Tagging policies, cost allocation, and chargeback/showback so engineering teams can see and own their own spend. This is foundational work other savings work depends on.

- **Automate cost governance:** Build automated cost reporting, anomaly detection, and alerting. Write the scripts and infrastructure-as-code (Python, Terraform, Lambda) that enforce cost policy rather than relying on manual review.

- **Partner with engineering on architecture decisions:** Bring cost into the room early, cost-efficiencies are cheaper to get right at design than to retrofit.

- **Work with Finance on forecasting and reporting:** Support budget tracking and financial KPIs; build dashboards and self-serve analytics engineering and finance can both read.


**You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

- Have strong AWS expertise and working GCP knowledge, including pricing models, billing structures, and cost optimization mechanics.

- Have data engineering depth: dbt, BigQuery (or an equivalent modern warehouse), SQL at scale, and data modeling for analytics (dimensional modeling, incremental models, testing).

- Have data science fundamentals: statistical forecasting, anomaly detection, and experimentation, and know when a rigorous model beats a rule of thumb.

- Have automation and scripting skills: Python, Terraform/ pulumi, Lambda, or Bash.

- Are comfortable with cost/billing tooling: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost & Usage Reports, GCP Billing Reports, and BI/dashboarding (we use Hex).

- Have experience with, or are comfortable picking up, Linear and Notion as the system of record for tracking and documenting FinOps work.

- Experience with a dedicated cloud cost management platform (e.g. CloudZero, Vantage, or similar) is a plus, not required.

- Can analyze cost data and present it clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Have prior experience spanning data analytics, data engineering, or data science in a FinOps, cloud cost management, or cloud governance context.

- Are energized by doing the unglamorous, high-leverage work (the schlep) that unblocks other teams, and by working cross-functionally without positional authority.


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Senior GPU Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior GPU Infrastructure Engineer

About Civo:

Civo is a high-performance neocloud provider purpose-built for the demands of modern AI, high-performance computing (HPC), and cloud-native infrastructure. We eliminate legacy cloud overhead to deliver ultra-low-latency compute, bare-metal GPU performance, and streamlined Kubernetes orchestration at scale.

Purpose-designed for AI engineering teams, enterprises, and research institutions, Civo delivers direct access to cutting-edge NVIDIA GPU clusters, high-speed fabrics, and parallel storage systems required to train, fine-tune, and deploy foundation models efficiently. We combine high-density infrastructure with predictable pricing and maximum compute throughput, empowering organizations to scale AI workloads without the complexity or cost bloat of traditional hyperscalers.

About the Role:

As a Senior GPU Infrastructure Engineer, you will serve as the technical authority owning the reliability, performance, and automated orchestration of Civo’s AI and GPU platform layer. You will bridge the boundary between deep server hardware/firmware telemetry, high-bandwidth interconnect fabrics, and cloud-native orchestrators.

In this role, you will lead complex escalation responses, build platform observability, drive blameless post-mortems, and engineer automated tooling to eliminate hardware entropy at scale. You will collaborate closely with hardware OEMs, NVIDIA engineering, and Civo’s core software teams to ensure maximum cluster uptime for large-scale training and inference workloads.

Responsibilities:

GPU Fleet Telemetry & Hardware SRE

- Deep Root-Cause Analysis: Act as the highest internal technical escalation point for persistent or intermittent hardware, PCIe bus, GPU memory (ECC double-bit errors), and XID driver faults across the fleet.

- Automated Diagnostics: Build and maintain automated pre-job and post-job health check frameworks utilizing NVIDIA DCGM, NCCL test suites, and custom telemetry agents.

- Firmware & Driver Lifecycle: Manage automated rollout pipelines for GPU VBIOS, system BIOS, BMC firmware, and NVIDIA CUDA driver stacks across live production clusters.


High-Performance Networking & Storage Integration

- Fabric Engineering Support: Diagnose performance bottlenecks, packet drops, and link degradation across InfiniBand (Quantum-2/X800) and RoCEv2 (Spectrum-X) interconnects.

- Parallel Storage SRE: Optimize data paths for GPUDirect Storage (GDS) and parallel file systems (VAST Data) to prevent GPU starvation during multi-node training runs.


Orchestration & Platform Automation

- Kubernetes & Slurm GPU Stack: Maintain and tune the NVIDIA GPU Operator, Network Operator, KubeFlow, and Slurm plugins across bare-metal and containerized environments.

- Automated Remediations: Design automated node-cordoning, pod eviction, and repair workflows triggered by real-time hardware telemetry alerts.

- Infrastructure-as-Code: Drive full-stack automation using Terraform, Ansible, and Python to streamline fleet expansion and region bring-ups.


Incident Management & Operational Excellence

- Major Incident Response: Lead war-room technical resolution during critical platform outages and manage complex vendor escalations with NVIDIA and OEM support teams.

- Blameless Post-Mortems: Conduct deep-dive post-incident reviews, author detailed root-cause documents, and implement preventative engineering fixes.


Key Results/Objectives:

- Fleet Availability: Maintain >= 99.9% platform availability across production GPU compute nodes.

- Automated Node Recovery: Automate detection and cordoning of degraded hardware to reduce Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) by 40%.

- Zero-Downtime Upgrades: Execute driver, firmware, and orchestration updates with zero unannounced impact to customer workloads.


Requirements:

Experience & Core Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in SRE, Systems Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering supporting high-density, production-scale Linux environments.

- 3+ years of hands-on experience managing and troubleshooting data center class NVIDIA GPUs (H100, B200, or newer) in distributed environments.


Technical Expertise

- NVIDIA Stack: Deep expertise in CUDA runtime drivers, DCGM metrics, NVLink/NVSwitch topologies, and troubleshooting XID errors.

- Orchestration: Advanced proficiency in Kubernetes administration (CKA level) including CNI, Device Plugins, and Slurm workload manager.

- High-Performance Fabrics: In-depth knowledge of InfiniBand subnet management, RoCEv2 lossless Ethernet mechanisms (PFC, ECN), and NCCL communication tuning.

- Automation & Scripting: Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or Bash, along with hands-on experience using Terraform and Ansible.

- Observability: Experience deploying and scaling Prometheus, Grafana, and vector-based telemetry stacks for hardware monitoring.


Soft Skills

- Strong technical leadership during high-pressure incidents.

- Excellent technical writing skills for post-mortems, architectural runbooks, and cross-team documentation.


Nice to Have:

- NVIDIA Certified Professional certifications in AI Infrastructure or InfiniBand (NCP-AII, NCP-IB).

- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Security Specialist (CKS).

- Experience with liquid-cooled rack architectures (Direct-to-Chip, CDU setups).


Why Join Civo?

- Competitive compensation and benefits package.

- 4-day work week company (unless attending an event).

- Uncapped holiday.

- Remote work environment with flexibility and autonomy.

- Collaborative and inclusive culture that values diversity and creativity.

- Opportunity to work with a dynamic and innovative team in the fast-growing cloud industry.

GPU Infrastructure Support Engineer

About Civo:

Civo is a high-performance neocloud provider purpose-built for the demands of modern AI, high-performance computing (HPC), and cloud-native infrastructure.
