We combine high-density infrastructure with predictable pricing and maximum compute throughput, empowering organizations to scale AI workloads without the complexity or cost bloat of traditional hyperscalers.

About the Role:

GPU Infrastructure Support Engineer, you will serve as the frontline operational defense for Civo’s global GPU and AI infrastructure fleet. You will handle day-to-day customer tickets, platform alerts, hardware fault triage, and initial incident response across GPU nodes, high-speed networking fabrics, and Linux systems.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role requiring strong technical curiosity and structured troubleshooting discipline. You will own incidents end-to-end, conduct initial hardware diagnostics, coordinate smart-hands activities in our data centers, and ensure clean, evidence-rich handovers when escalating complex issues to Senior GPU Infrastructure Engineers.

Responsibilities:

24/7 Operations & Ticket Triage

- Incident Triage: Monitor platform dashboards and queue systems to acknowledge, prioritize, and triage customer-reported issues within strict SLA targets.

- Customer Communication: Provide clear, professional, and technical status updates to enterprise clients via ticketing channels and status pages.

- Shift Handovers: Maintain accurate event logs and execute clean, detailed shift handovers to ensure continuous operational coverage.


GPU Node & Hardware Triage

- First-Line Diagnostics: Execute runbooks to inspect node health using nvidia-smi, NVIDIA Data Center GPU Manager (DCGM), and system event logs (dmesg, journalctl).

- Out-of-Band Management: Access and manage bare-metal host BMCs via IPMI or Redfish to perform power cycles, remote console inspections, and system event log extractions.

- RMA Preparation: Gather diagnostic logs and serial numbers to build complete, evidence-rich vendor RMA submission packages for failed GPUs, DIMMs, or storage drives.


Data Center & Field Support Coordination

- Smart-Hands Coordination: Act as the primary technical contact for local data center facility technicians, directing physical component reseats, optic replacements, and cable testing.

- Asset Tracking: Maintain absolute data integrity across Civo’s DCIM and IPAM systems (e.g., NetBox) during hardware swaps or maintenance.


Platform & Environment Troubleshooting

- User Support: Assist customer teams with basic SSH access, GPU device passthrough checks, Slurm job queue status, and container runtime issues.

- Runbook Execution & Improvement: Follow operational runbooks for routine maintenance and propose incremental updates based on real-world incident trends.


Key Results/Objectives:

- SLA Adherence: Maintain >98% compliance on initial response and update SLAs across all priority tiers.

- First-Contact Resolution: Resolve >= 60% of tier-1 platform and access tickets without requiring L3 escalation.

- RMA Processing Speed: Package and submit verified RMA evidence to hardware vendors within 4 hours of fault confirmation.


Requirements:

Experience & Core Qualifications

- 2–4+ years of technical experience in an IT infrastructure support, service desk, or data center operations role within a structured, customer-facing environment.

- Demonstrated hands-on experience troubleshooting server hardware and Linux operating systems.


Technical Expertise

- Linux Administration: Strong CLI proficiency with systemd, file permissions, storage mounts, and network diagnostic utilities (ip, ping, traceroute, netstat).

- GPU & Hardware Diagnostics: Working knowledge of NVIDIA GPU server architectures, including command-line tools like nvidia-smi and basic DCGM health checks.

- Hardware & Out-of-Band: Familiarity with server architecture (PCIe, NVMe, memory topology) and Out-of-Band management (iDRAC, iLO, BMC via IPMI/Redfish).

- Ticketing & ITIL: Working understanding of incident management workflows, prioritization, and ticket lifecycle tracking.


Soft Skills

- Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to summarize complex technical logs into clear customer updates and internal escalation notes.

- Strong organizational discipline and a methodical approach to step-by-step technical isolation.


Nice to Have:

- Experience with Slurm workload manager or Kubernetes (kubectl basics).

- Basic awareness of high-performance networking concepts (InfiniBand, RoCEv2, RDMA).

- Linux certifications (RHCSA, CompTIA Linux+) or Kubernetes foundations (CKA/KCNA).


Why Join Civo?

- Competitive compensation and benefits package.

- 4-day work week company (unless attending an event).

- Uncapped holiday.

- Remote work environment with flexibility and autonomy.

- Collaborative and inclusive culture that values diversity and creativity.

- Opportunity to work with a dynamic and innovative team in the fast-growing cloud industry.

Technical Project Manager – GPU & AI Infrastructure

About Civo:

Civo is a high-performance neocloud provider purpose-built for the demands of modern AI, high-performance computing (HPC), and cloud-native infrastructure. We eliminate legacy cloud overhead to deliver ultra-low-latency compute, bare-metal GPU performance, and streamlined Kubernetes orchestration at scale.

Purpose-designed for AI engineering teams, enterprises, and research institutions, Civo delivers direct access to cutting-edge NVIDIA GPU clusters, high-speed fabrics, and parallel storage systems required to train, fine-tune, and deploy foundation models efficiently. We combine high-density infrastructure with predictable pricing and maximum compute throughput, empowering organizations to scale AI workloads without the complexity or cost bloat of traditional hyperscalers.

About the Role:

As a Technical Project Manager – Customer AI Infrastructure Deployments, you will be the primary customer-facing operational leader responsible for the end-to-end delivery of enterprise GPU clusters. You will own the entire lifecycle of a customer deployment—from the moment a contract is signed through to procurement, physical build-out, technical validation, and the final hand-off to the customer at the contracted Ready-For-Service (RFS) date.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role requiring strict project governance. You will act as the central point of coordination between Civo’s enterprise customers, internal procurement, network engineering, platform SREs, hardware OEMs (e.g., NVIDIA, Supermicro), and third-party Data Center (DC) operators. You must manage complex supply chain logistics, mitigate live environment risks, and ensure that massive GPU capacity is delivered on time, to specification, and seamlessly handed over for customer "go-live."

Responsibilities:

Customer Engagement & Delivery Ownership

- End-to-End Customer Delivery: Own the successful delivery of dedicated GPU compute clusters to enterprise clients, acting as the primary customer-facing project lead post-sale.

- RFS Accountability: Ensure all deployments meet strict, contracted Ready-For-Service (RFS) dates and final "go-live" milestones.

- Customer Communication: Lead regular cadence meetings with internal & customer stakeholders, providing transparent deployment status reports, risk logs, and timeline updates.


Supply Chain & Vendor Management

- Procurement & Logistics: Project manage the entire hardware supply chain lifecycle, from initial BOM approval and procurement to staging and final site delivery.

- Supplier & OEM Coordination: Direct day-to-day coordination with server OEMs, networking vendors, and logistics partners to manage equipment lead times and resolve supply chain bottlenecks.


Data Center Build-Out & Integration

- DC Operator Management: Coordinate directly with third-party Data Center operators and facility engineers on physical readiness, including space, power provisioning (PDUs), rack layout, and liquid cooling (CDU) integration.

- Physical Deployment: Oversee the smart-hands and field engineering teams during the physical racking, stacking, and high-speed fiber cabling (InfiniBand/RoCE) of GPU chassis.


Testing, Validation & Go-Live

- Test Phase Orchestration: Coordinate with Civo Network and Platform SRE teams to execute rigorous pre-flight checks, burn-in testing, and NCCL performance benchmarks prior to customer handover.

- Issue Resolution: Proactively identify technical blockers, thermal/power constraints, or cabling mismatches during the deploy-and-test phase and drive immediate cross-functional resolutions.

- Change Control: Coordinate scheduled infrastructure changes within live DC environments, maintaining strict risk logs and backout plans to ensure safety and stability.


Key Results/Objectives:

- On-Time Delivery: Achieve 100% on-time delivery of customer GPU clusters against contracted RFS dates.

- Customer Satisfaction: Maintain high customer satisfaction scores during the onboarding and deployment phase through transparent communication and flawless execution.

- Deployment Accuracy: Achieve zero customer-impacting deployment delays caused by physical setup errors, cabling, or failed technical validations.


Requirements:

Experience & Core Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical project management experience leading complex IT infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC), or large-scale data center deployment projects.

- Proven track record in a highly customer-facing role, managing enterprise client expectations and delivering against strict contractual deadlines.

- Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-vendor supply chains and coordinating directly with hardware OEMs and DC operators.


Technical Expertise

- Data Center Physical Layer: Practical knowledge of data center operations, including rack power allocation, airflow management, liquid cooling setups, and fiber optic cabling protocols.

- Hardware & Infrastructure: Familiarity with high-density server hardware (GPU chassis, PCIe devices) and high-speed network topologies (InfiniBand/Ethernet switches).

- Project Tooling: Advanced proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Gantt/roadmap tools, and risk log management frameworks.


Soft Skills

- Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to maintain clarity, momentum, and confidence during complex physical deployments.

- Solution-oriented, proactive mindset capable of resolving supply chain bottlenecks or data center facility constraints under tight deadlines.


Nice to Have:

- Project management certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum Master).

- Technical understanding of NVIDIA GPU server topologies (HGX, DGX, NVLink racks).

- Familiarity with DCIM tooling and hardware inventory practices.


Why Join Civo?

jobs.title: Senior C++ Engineer
jobs.description:
## **Who We Are**

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on [Mac](https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/), [Windows](https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/), [iOS](https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/), and [Android](https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/), our [search engine](https://duckduckgo.com/), and the [DuckDuckGo subscription](https://duckduckgo.com/pro). We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including [Duck.ai](https://duck.ai/), which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

Our [culture](https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work) of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

## **Your Team and Role**

Working on the C++ Functional Team, you'll build the high-performance code at the core of DuckDuckGo's browser using modern C++ and Chromium, and work on related projects.

You can expect to work on projects like:

- Implement tracker blocking that stops hidden trackers on every site without slowing page loads.

- Bring VPN and Personal Information Removal into the browser through the DuckDuckGo subscription.

- Catch startup and responsiveness regressions automatically, so the browser stays fast as it grows.


As a Senior C++/Chromium Engineer, you'll lead complex projects from proposal through post-mortem. You'll turn vague problems into clear plans, build them in a large modern C++ codebase, and use metrics to show they worked. Some days that means low-level systems work. Others, it means architecture decisions the whole team builds on. You'll collaborate with design and product, mostly asynchronously, to build features people use to protect their privacy.

## **About You**

- Ability to lead and collaborate on high-impact, complex projects from proposal through post-mortem

- Skills to wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a strong focus on metrics

- 7+ years of software engineering experience

- Advanced modern C++ expertise (C++23 or newer), including memory management, concurrency, and performance profiling

- Experience driving technical work end-to-end on large-scale C++ codebases

- Comfort with large build systems, debuggers, and profilers

- Experience shipping software to a large consumer audience

- Solid computer science foundation (algorithms and data structures)

- Bonus: Windows development experience

- Bonus: experience with browsers (Chromium, WebKit, WebView), game engines, or large desktop applications


## **Compensation**

This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:

- **United States**: $190,500 USD annually

- **United Kingdom**: £134,600 GBP annually

- **Canada**: C$253,500 CAD annually

- **Europe/Rest of World**: €157,350 EUR annually


In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

Our [Team Member Support Guide](https://duckduckgo.com/assets/hiring/team_support_guide.pdf) explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including **paid parental leave, office setup,** and **co-working allowances.**

## **Hiring Process**

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about [how we hire](https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-hire).

## **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to [careers@duckduckgo.com](mailto:careers@duckduckgo.com) to let us know the nature of your request.

## **Please note that:**

- You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

- Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

- While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

- A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

- By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.


**Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process**

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

**Key Principles:**

- **Data Privacy:** All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our [Recruiting Privacy Policy](https://duckduckgo.com/static-assets/files/pages/careers/DuckDuckGo-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-effective-September-30-2025.pdf). We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

- **Human Oversight and Accountability:** The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

- **Transparency:** We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.


By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at [careers@duckduckgo.com](mailto:careers@duckduckgo.com). Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
### Work from anywhere, impact everywhere

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.

We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.

To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.

We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.

We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position

Work from anywhere!

### Position overview

As Financial Controller, you will own the integrity of financial reporting across the Xapo group, a Bitcoin-first, regulated credit institution headquartered in Gibraltar.

Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will lead the Financial Controlling and Regulatory Reporting teams and take each cycle from first draft to sign-off: consolidated and entity financial statements under IFRS and FRS 102, the multi-entity close, regulatory returns to the GFSC and FCA, and the external audit.

You will apply IFRS to crypto assets, shape our accounting positions and policies, and work with our finance transformation team to build AI and automation into the close and reporting process.

### Responsibilities

**Financial reporting and control**

- Prepare the group’s consolidated and entity financial statements under IFRS and FRS 102, from first draft to sign-off.
- Run month-end and year-end close for a multi-entity group in Gibraltar and the UK, including consolidation and intercompany eliminations.
- Oversee the statutory accounts of each group entity.
- Make sure the internal control system stays accurate and keeps its integrity.

**Regulatory reporting**

- Lead regulatory reporting to the GFSC and FCA, including prudential returns on capital and liquidity and periodic management accounts.
- Work with Data, Operations, Compliance and other teams to prepare client asset reporting.
- Keep up with regulatory change and update reporting when requirements change.

**External audit**

- Run the group external audit from planning through fieldwork, queries and sign-off.
- Be the main contact between Xapo and the auditors, answering technical questions and keeping the audit on timetable.

**Technical accounting**

- Support the Director of Finance on technical accounting, including the treatment of crypto assets under IFRS.
- Write technical accounting positions and contribute to decisions on finance systems and infrastructure.
- Help draft accounting policies, memos and decision records.

**Tax**

- Own tax compliance and manage the external tax advisors, including the tax treatment of crypto assets.

**Systems, process and automation**

- Improve finance processes and NetSuite reporting.
- Work with the finance transformation team to build AI and automation into close and reporting, and adopt new tools as they roll out.
- Manage the existing close and regulatory reporting review process and look for ways to improve it.

**Team management**

- Lead and develop the Financial Controlling and Regulatory Reporting teams, fostering strong performance, accountability, and collaboration.
- Drive a high-performance culture by setting clear objectives, developing future leaders, and ensuring the team has the skills to support evolving business and regulatory requirements.

### Skills needed

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
- Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) preferred.
- At least 5 years as a Controller leading an accounting function.
- Experience in a bank, fintech or crypto business.
- Strong technical knowledge of IFRS and FRS 102, with experience preparing financial statements under both.
- Crypto asset accounting under IFRS, including fair value revaluation and on-chain reconciliations, backed by a working understanding of blockchain.
- Regulatory reporting experience, including Basel capital and liquidity returns (e.g. COREP). GFSC or FCA exposure is preferred.
- External audits experience.
- NetSuite proficiency is essential.
- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets. SQL or BI tools (e.g. BigQuery, Looker) are an advantage.
- Has used AI tools in previous finance roles and is comfortable working alongside AI-driven automations and checking their output.
- Experience leading and developing a finance team.
- Clear writer, able to explain complex numbers to non-finance colleagues and handle regulator and auditor correspondence in a fully remote team.
- Strong analytical skills, sound judgement and high standards of integrity.

### Other requirements

- A dedicated workspace.
- A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
- Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

### Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

- **Shape the Future**

Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

- **Great work-life balance** Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.

- **Expect Excellence** Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.


At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. Pinterest is looking for a Sr. SMB Program Manager to help shape and scale how our LATAM SMB Sales organization operates. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Analytics Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

**The Community You Will Join:**

- The Analytics Infrastructure team’s mission is to enable universal data-informed decision-making at Airbnb. We achieve this by providing an integrated suite of analytics frameworks, services and applications. We’re infrastructure and full stack engineers with a human focus: customer-centric, quality driven, helpful and empathetic.
- As a backend / fullstack software engineer on the Analytics Products team (which is part of Analytics Infrastructure) you will have the opportunity to build data tools which enable data practitioners to efficiently explore and analyze data to create insights. The team manages data products used by 7,000 monthly active users, including [Apache Superset](https://medium.com/airbnb-engineering/supercharging-apache-superset-b1a2393278bd), Notebook tool and AI for Data chat product and their integrations within the Data Platform tooling, like Airbnb’s in-house build [Metric system](https://medium.com/airbnb-engineering/how-airbnb-achieved-metric-consistency-at-scale-f23cc53dea70) which enables metric consistency at scale.

**The Difference You Will Make:**

- Shape up the future of Apache Superset through open source collaboration, internal user engagement and direct code contributions. By plugging into the open source community - Superset  releases, roadmap and operational processes, you will help shape and drive new Apache Superset improvements and features and ensure they scale for Airbnb’s user base.
- Collaborate with other data platform teams to build integrations of our data tools with Airbnb's data platform’s ecosystem, like the [metric infrastructure](https://medium.com/airbnb-engineering/metis-building-airbnbs-next-generation-data-management-platform-d2c5219edf19) which enables metric consistency at scale, [data management platform](https://medium.com/airbnb-engineering/metis-building-airbnbs-next-generation-data-management-platform-d2c5219edf19) which enables data discovery and data management, data warehouse infrastructure and services, and more.
- Continue to hold high quality bar for our data tools, to ensure high stability and reliability for Airbnb’s data practitioners.

**A Typical Day:**

- Build new features to support user’s workflows, within our data products (Superset, AI for Data Chat, Notebooks) and integrations of our tools within the Data Platform’s ecosystem
- Collaborate with Apache Superset open source community and make contributions to the Apache Superset project
- Prepare, test and release Superset OSS official releases internally for Airbnb
- Collaborate with teams within Airbnb’s data platform on integrations of our data products within the data platform’s infrastructure.
- Engage with users of products our team owns - we expect all engineers to be able to drive projects end to end, gather user feedback or collaborate with product managers, create and manage feature roll out plans and migrations.
- Contribute to maintaining a high technical quality bar by identifying quality or architecture improvements projects, improving testability, observability, and reviewing other’s code and technical designs.
- Support the team’s operations via lightweight on-call support.

**Your Expertise:**

- 5+ years of full-time, relevant industry experience, with expertise in building backend services in Python.
- Expertise with frontend development - HTML, CSS, Typescript, Javascript and modern front-end frameworks such as React is a plus.
- Hands-on experience with data (SQL, Data Engineering) or big data technology is a plus, e.g: Airflow, Spark, Trino, etc.
- Experience in some combination of internal application development, data infrastructure, and analytics engineering is a plus.
- Appetite for high quality code and robust systems, including observability, and reliability.
- Ability to drive cross functional projects or migrations - including alignment, collaboration and roll out with partner teams and users.
- **Passion for building interactive and delightful user experiences and engaging with users** **_._**

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:**

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: [reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com](mailto:reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com). Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

**Reasonable Accommodations:** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

**A Note on Recruiting Scams:** Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ [airbnb.com](http://airbnb.com) or @ [ext.airbnb.com](http://ext.airbnb.com) email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Compute
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

We are seeking a platform engineer to join our Compute team. This team owns the critical systems that power project provisioning, scaling, and the compute that our users rely on every day.

You’ll work on the core platform that ensures Supabase can seamlessly scale

across multiple regions, handle high-volume workloads, and provide

low-latency, highly available compute services.

You'll design, build, and operate systems that are both robust and highly

automated — enabling us to provision new projects reliably at scale,

optimize resource utilization, and deliver a seamless experience to the

millions of databases which we manage.

#### What You’ll Be Responsible For:

- Help build and maintain the Supabase Cloud offering;

- Design and implement systems to provision, scale, and manage the multi-region compute workloads powering Supabase projects;

- Own the full lifecycle of compute orchestration: project creation, warm pools, autoscaling, resizing, and resource optimization;

- Improve automation and observability across the compute stack to ensure high availability and performance;

- Improve our system architecture to reduce costs while balancing security, reliability, and performance;

- Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to help leverage compute as a core platform offering;

- Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews;

- Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform.


#### You Might Be A Good Fit If You:

- Have strong software engineering skills (Go and Typescript required);

- Experience building and operating cloud infrastructure or distributed systems at scale;

- Have 5+ years experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS required, additional experience with GCP and Azure is a plus) - particularly compute, networking, and storage services;

- Have 3+ years experience working with building custom Kubernetes controllers, and operating large-scale (tens-to-hundreds of thousands of pods) clusters;

- Are knowledgable about networking and multi-region infrastructure design;

- Are familiar with Postgres;

- Have experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Pulumi highly preferred, Terraform/CDK etc acceptable)

- Have experience working with QEMU, KVM, and NAS is a plus;

- Have experience with being part of on-call rotations for large production system;


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members

jobs.title: Software Architect, InsuranceSuite Practice
jobs.description:
**Summary**

Guidewire’s Professional Services InsuranceSuite Practice partners with P&C insurers across the Americas to implement our cloud, digital, and core applications so they can modernize, scale, and serve their customers with confidence.

As an Architect in the InsuranceSuite Practice based in LATAM, you will act as a lead technical authority on complex InsuranceSuite implementations, combining deep product expertise with hands-on design and technical leadership across architecture, integration, performance, and cloud delivery. You’ll work closely with customers, partners, and internal teams across LATAM to define implementation patterns, reduce delivery risk and effort, and drive measurable business value from Guidewire’s platform.

**Job Description**

#### What you’ll do

- Lead end-to-end solution and technical architecture for complex Guidewire InsuranceSuite programs (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter) in LATAM, from inception through go-live and stabilization.
- Translate customer business requirements into scalable, maintainable implementation designs spanning configuration, integration, data, and cloud operations.
- Own critical design decisions (data model, integration patterns, performance and resiliency approaches, extensibility) and ensure alignment with Guidewire best practices and reference architectures.
- Guide and review detailed technical designs, configuration approaches, and integration specifications produced by project teams and partners, ensuring consistency and quality.
- Provide hands-on technical leadership: troubleshoot complex issues across application, integration, and data layers; perform design and code reviews; mentor consultants.
- Define and champion reusable patterns, accelerators, and implementation best practices that reduce effort and improve quality across InsuranceSuite implementations in the region.
- Collaborate with Product, R&D, and Cloud teams to provide field feedback, influence roadmap, and align customer solutions with Guidewire Cloud Platform capabilities.
- Proactively manage technical risks and non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, resilience, security) throughout the delivery lifecycle.
- Contribute to estimation, scoping, and planning for proposals and delivery engagements, including effort, risk, and dependency assessment.
- Act as a trusted advisor to customer and partner technical leaders, facilitating architecture workshops and clearly documenting decisions and rationale.

#### What you’ll bring

Required

- Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and data-driven insights to improve how you design, build, and troubleshoot complex systems.
- 10+ years of experience in enterprise software implementation or architecture, including several large-scale transformation or core system projects.
- 2+ years of hands-on Guidewire InsuranceSuite implementation experience (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter), including configuration and integration is a plus.
- Strong expertise in at least one of: Gosu, Java, or similar object-oriented languages, plus solid understanding of REST/SOAP integrations, messaging, and batch processing.
- Proven experience designing end-to-end architectures covering configuration, integrations, data migration considerations, and non-functional requirements.
- Experience working with cloud platforms (ideally Guidewire Cloud Platform, AWS or Azure), including environments, deployments, and operational concerns.
- Strong understanding of P&C insurance concepts (policy, billing, claims) and how they map into InsuranceSuite.
- Excellent communication and consulting skills: able to lead technical workshops, explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and document decisions clearly.
- Experience working in Agile/Scrum or hybrid delivery environments on distributed teams.
- Advanced English communication skills (written and spoken); ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders.
- Based in Brazil with the ability to work remotely and align to LATAM customer time zones; occasional travel for customer or internal workshops as needed.
- Spanish and Portuguese language skills in addition to English.

Preferred

- 4+ years of hands-on Guidewire InsuranceSuite implementation experience (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter), including configuration and integration.
- Prior experience in an Architect role on multi-year, multi-vendor core system or large program implementations.
- Guidewire certifications (InsuranceSuite, Integration, Cloud) and/or cloud certifications (AWS, Azure).
- Experience with performance tuning and scalability for InsuranceSuite (profiling, query optimization, batch performance, environment sizing).
- Experience defining and/or building reusable accelerators, frameworks, or tools for Guidewire implementations.
- Experience coaching and mentoring architects/consultants and providing feedback on design quality and implementation approaches.
- Exposure to AI-assisted development, knowledge tools, or automation to accelerate design, analysis, or troubleshooting.

#### Your impact

In your first 6–12 months, you will lead architecture for one or more strategic InsuranceSuite programs in LATAM, de-risking critical design decisions, improving solution quality, and accelerating time-to-value. Over time, your patterns, assets, and mentorship will uplift the broader InsuranceSuite Practice and partner ecosystem, directly supporting Professional Services’ goals of reducing implementation effort, scaling cloud adoption, and delivering measurable value for our customers.

**About Guidewire**

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

Guidewire is proud to be a disability inclusive employer. We are committed to providing individualized accommodations and support to candidates for any part of our hiring process. If you think you may need disability-related accommodations, please email EmployAbility at accommodations-gw@employ-ability.org.uk, our disability partner, or [schedule a call with an EmployAbility expert](https://calendar.app.google/Pz47ZoQHihFTJugX8) (calendar booking slot) for a confidential conversation.

jobs.description:
## **About the Role:**

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

10

**Customer Success Manager**

S&P Global Energy is seeking a Customer Success Manager who is responsible for an assigned client portfolio across LatAm. The role involves client support, onboarding and relationship building.  The Customer Success Manager is engaged with Commercial and Client Development to seek client solutions and provide value-add services.

This is an opportunity for you to take ownership of your accounts and nurture the client relationship with our diverse clientele.  It also is an opportunity to learn more about energy commodities, price assessments and new industries such as Energy Transition.  You can build a personal network with commodity analysts, traders and high-level executives.

Other responsibilities include on-site support, product training and integration of Platts services within customer workflows. The goal is to facilitate excellent customer service as a value differentiator.  Salesforce documentation is required for all value-add services (cases/activities).

**Responsibilities and Impact:**

- On-site support, product training and integration of Platts services within customer workflows. The goal is to facilitate excellent customer service as a value differentiator.  Salesforce documentation is required for all value-add services (cases/activities).
- Become upskilled on current commodity news and channel partner platforms.  Serve as team champion.
- Strategize with Commercial and other teams to discuss client needs, deliverables and feedback.
- Assist in growing the S&P Global Platts business by collaborating with Commercial.
- Responsible for client onboarding, product training, relationship building and client deliverables.  Seek client solutions by partnering with Client Service, Editorial, Product, Marketing, etc., globally
- Travel and meet with clients to understand their view; share feedback internally as necessary.  Collaborate with global Client Service teams on best practices, lessons learned, etc.

**What We’re Looking For:**

**Basic Required Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s Degree.
- 3+ years of related work experience industry related work experience is required (finance, banks or trading).
- English, Portugues and Spanish command written and oral.

**Additional Preferred Qualifications:**

- Previous client support and/or Sales interaction.
- A self-starter who’s organized and willing to own a portfolio of clients.
- Time management and prioritization – managing multiple client requests, including product demonstrations, product training, and engagement documentation.
- Ability to lead individual and group trainings effectively and succinctly, at all levels within a company.
- Knowledge of energy, commodities and financial markets.
- Ability to travel.  ~40% travel time and meet with clients.
- Experience with CRMs (Salesforce), Excel, Quip, Zoom, Teams
- API and Technology understanding.

**PLEASE SUBMIT RESUME IN ENGLISH**

**About S&P Global Energy**

At S&P Global Energy, our comprehensive view of global energy and commodities markets enables our customers to make superior decisions and create long-term, sustainable value. Our four core capabilities are: Platts for news and pricing; CERA for research and advisory; Horizons for energy expansion and sustainability solutions; and Events for industry collaboration.

S&P Global Energy is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global enables businesses, governments, and individuals with trusted data, expertise, and technology to make decisions with conviction. We are Advancing Essential Intelligence through world-leading benchmarks, data, and insights that customers need in order to plan confidently, act decisively, and thrive economically in a rapidly changing global landscape. Learn more at [www.spglobal.com/energy](http://www.spglobal.com/energy).

**What’s In It For** **You?**

**Our Mission:**

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

**Our People:**

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

**Our Values:**

**Integrity, Discovery, Partnership**

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

**Benefits:**

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

Our benefits include:

- Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.

- Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.

- Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.

- Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.

- Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.

- Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.


For more information on benefits by country visit: [https://spgbenefits.com/benefit-summaries](https://nam11.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fspgbenefits.com%2Fbenefit-summaries&data=05%7C02%7Clauren.washington%40spglobal.com%7C2110bb7975e647763da908dc57fae79d%7C8f3e36ea80394b4081a77dc0599e8645%7C1%7C0%7C638481982335774379%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=MLyuUlul44KSiQWXG3isvYhaT7f6JLL5jLpgtgOcHyE%3D&reserved=0)

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

*****Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.  _#LI-MM1_**

**_Disclaimer:_** _We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication._

**A day in the life:**

The Social Commerce Strategist plays a pivotal role in driving revenue and optimizing affiliate and social commerce strategies through data-driven, AI-enhanced processes. This position manages affiliate and social ambassador partnerships across platforms like TikTok, Meta, and Amazon affiliate, ensuring alignment with brand objectives and maximizing partnership profitability. Daily responsibilities include overseeing affiliate production and outreach, optimizing social shops, and refining commission strategies based on GMV and engagement metrics. In this fast-paced role, the Social Commerce Strategist also serves as a key client liaison, delivering actionable insights and recommendations to sustain and strengthen client relationships. Always forward-thinking, this strategist keeps pace with industry trends, continuously integrating innovative tactics to elevate social commerce results.

**Responsibilities:**

- **TikTok Shops & Affiliate Management**: Execute a TikTok Shop affiliate strategy and/or social ambassdor aligned with brand objectives, focusing on maximizing partnerships and revenue, including daily affiliate outreach through the TikTok Shop Affiliate center
- **Affiliate Outreach and Onboarding:** Management of affiliate messaging system and discord communities to encourage ongoing partnerships that are mutually beneficial
- **Commerce Optimization:** Manage social commerce initiatives across platforms like TikTok and Meta, including the setup and continuous optimization of social shops to enhance conversions and drive revenue for clients
- **Data-driven Reporting and Analytics:** Track and report key metrics, including GMV, response rate, and program growth; provide affiliate commission strategies and analyze overall profitability. Develop forecasts and goals for clients based on historical data.
- **Client Communication:** Maintain clear and effective communication with clients, providing regular updates on campaign performance, insights, and recommendations for optimization to ensure client satisfaction and retention
- **Continuous Learning and Innovation:** Stay abreast of industry trends and platform updates, actively seeking out new opportunities and innovative strategies to enhance the performance of influencer campaigns and social commerce initiatives
- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

**Role Requirements:**

- 2+ years of experience in social media (agency experience preferred)
- **Industry Expertise:** Proactive in staying current with the latest trends, algorithm changes, and platform updates in the social media landscape, must have examples of applying this knowledge to enhance strategies
- **Proficiency in TikTok Shop Seller Center:** Comfort and familiarity with navigating and utilizing the various TikTok tools within their commerce suite. Must have experience in the Affiliate management system
- Affiliate & Ambassador Program Experience: Understanding of the social ambassador ecosystem and proven experience in at least one sub-affiliate program; bonus points for Impact experience
- **Client Variety:** Proven track record of successfully managing social media strategies for multiple clients spanning various industries, demonstrating adaptability and versatility
- **Strong Analytical Skills:** Ability to analyze campaign data effectively, derive actionable insights, and make data-driven decisions to optimize campaign performance and achieve client goals
- **Commerce Management Experience:** Previous experience managing social commerce initiatives, including setting up and optimizing social shops on platforms like TikTok and Meta, to drive revenue and conversions
- **Performance Influencer Management:** Demonstrated proficiency in managing influencer campaigns focused on driving specific performance metrics such as conversions, click-through rates, and ROI
- **Autonomous Workflow Capability:** Highly self-motivated and capable of working independently to develop, execute, and manage social media strategies while delivering exceptional results

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

- REP Goal of $26,0000
- Hitting within 15% of target forecast OR having key recommendations in place to hit goals
- Below 10% Client Churn Rate
- Understands all strategies of department and can execute on 100%
- Can navigate 100%+ difficult probing questions on performance

**Most Important Things (MITs)**

- Client Performance and Sentiment
- Autonomous workflow management and account ownership
- Department Support

_Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility._

All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at [https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/](https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/)_ _[.](https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/) If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at_ [_recruiting@powerdigital.com_](mailto:recruiting@powerdigital.com) _before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence._

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

*****Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.**

**_***_ This job application is for a role at one of Power Digital's partner companies. Power Digital is assisting this partner company with its recruiting efforts. If you are selected for this position to interview, please make note of the above statement.**

**_Disclaimer:_** _We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication._

**A day in the life:**

As a Paid Media Supervisor, you’ll own the performance, strategy, and growth of major multi-channel paid media accounts. You’ll partner closely with the Associate Media Director on strategic direction and planning, while fully owning execution, testing, and reporting. Your day includes reviewing pacing and KPIs, identifying optimization opportunities, and designing tests that push performance forward across the full funnel. You’ll lead client conversations as the subject-matter expert, guide a growing team of Media Managers, and confidently recommend (and defend) strategies that drive real business impact. In a remote-first environment, you’ll operate with autonomy, accountability, and a constant drive to raise the bar.

**Responsibilities:**

- Own end-to-end management and strategic oversight of assigned paid media accounts.
- Drive performance against pacing, KPIs, and efficiency goals—continually raising expectations.
- Lead paid media strategy, road-mapping, testing frameworks, and campaign ideation.
- Manage and mentor a team of 1–2+ Media Managers, supporting their strategic and technical growth.
- Partner with Account Managers and the Media Director to align media strategy with client goals and business outcomes.
- Serve as the primary internal and external point of contact for owned accounts.
- Lead client communication, reporting, insights, and strategic recommendations.
- Oversee ongoing account maintenance: optimizations, structure updates, bidding strategies, conversion tracking, and copy revisions.
- Design and deploy monthly and quarterly testing plans across structure, targeting, creative, messaging, and conversion strategy.
- Drive full-funnel strategy development, validation, and continuous improvement.
- Identify opportunities to expand media spend, channels, and account scope.
- Stay ahead of industry trends, testing new platforms, and expanding Cardinal’s paid media offerings.

**Role Requirements:**

- 6–10+ years of paid media experience.
- Proven experience managing multiple accounts with monthly budgets ranging from $100K–$1MM+.
- Strong background in paid media strategy, media planning, testing frameworks, and performance measurement across channels.
- Hands-on experience across platforms, including Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta, Google Display, Programmatic Display, and paid social (LinkedIn, TikTok a plus).
- Experience with full-funnel strategy, video campaigns, and lead generation.
- Strong knowledge of Google Analytics, GTM, conversion tracking, and optimization strategy (GA4 a plus).
- Ability to write ad copy, guide creative strategy, define asset needs, and lead creative testing cadences.
- Client-facing experience with confidence, presenting insights, and defending strategy.
- Team management and mentorship experience.
- Strong critical-thinking skills, ownership mindset, and comfort working autonomously in a remote environment.

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

- Continually audits account to identify winning ads, present data to client, and dictate hypotheses and test strategy via monthly roadmaps
- Writes strategic consumer-centric, direct response copy and messaging strategy
- Manages requests and output with production team using Asana
- Reviews video/image assets and provides clear and actionable feedback to editors
- Leads productive internal creative team syncs and brainstorms
- Works alongside client management team as client POC for all things creative strategy
- Understands scope of requested edits, reshoots, and other deliverables
- Pushes back on client on matters of timeline, scope, feedback, and direction to drive performance based on creative best practices
- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

- Technically skilled at pulling and using creative performance data to analyze trends, insights, and inform creative roadmaps
- Understanding of best practices for performance-driven creative & ability to apply these insights in work
- Ability to write effective ad copy, structure a script, and see through on the execution with corresponding visuals
- Ability to communicate and collaborate with clients, production, and post-production teams to deliver best possible creative output
- Ability to yield strong campaign results for clients through strategizing top performing creative

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Growth
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

##### **About the Role**

As a Senior Product Designer in Connect, you’ll lead the design of high-impact experiences for some of our most important and visible features like Home, Profile, Notifications, Widgets, Friends, Messages, Sharing, and more.

Your work will span cross-functionally where different features meet and overlap and you will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and other Product Designers to craft an engaging and cohesive experience across web, iOS, and Android for millions of players across the world.

You'll identify opportunities beyond the brief, and influence product and design decisions while helping raise the craft quality bar across the team.

##### **About You**

You’re an experienced Product Designer with strong visual craft, product judgment, and the confidence to influence how a product takes shape. You think beyond the feature in front of you, considering how decisions connect across product experiences. You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and competing perspectives, present your thinking with clarity and composure, and help other designers improve through thoughtful critique.

You’re interested in how people connect and find joy in designing fun and healthy ways for them to build relationships and feel like part of a global community.

##### **What You’ll Do**

- Lead the end-to-end design of high-impact product experiences across Chess.com’s web, iOS, and Android apps, and deliver polished, production-ready UI designs.
- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other stakeholders to shape requirements, clarify ambiguity, and influence product and design direction.
- Design how players connect, socialize, and feel like they’re part of a global community on key features like Home, Profile, Friends, Messaging, Notifications, Leaderboards, and more.
- Think horizontally across features and the broader design system, identifying opportunities to improve consistency, usability, and quality across the product.
- Raise the craft bar through strong UI design, thoughtful interactions, and sound product judgment grounded in context, heuristics, and user insight.
- Proactively identify meaningful product opportunities beyond the immediate brief and help move them from idea to well-articulated design direction.
- Present your design proposals and clearly articulate your decisions, navigate differing perspectives, and help cross-functional partners align to reach strong decisions.
- Build and iterate on high-fidelity prototypes using our Design System, using tools like Cursor and Claude, to explore directions and accelerate decision making.
- Contribute to design critiques, provide constructive feedback to other Product Designers, and help strengthen the quality of the team’s work without direct people-management responsibility.
- Maintain design ownership through implementation and help ensure strong design-to-code alignment across platforms.

##### **Skills / Qualifications**

- 5+ years of experience working as a Product Designer on a consumer-facing product or game.
- A portfolio of polished web and mobile UI design work that demonstrates excellent craft, strong product thinking, and accountability.
- Mastery of UI design fundamentals, including typography, color, layout, visual hierarchy, alignment, contrast, interactivity, user experience heuristics.
- Experience using agentic tools like Cursor and Claude to build shareable prototypes and quickly iterate on different ideasDemonstrated experience owning complex product work from early problem definition through implementation.
- Strong Design system fluency, including the ability to use established patterns while thinking across features and identifying opportunities to improve consistency.
- A track record of influencing product and design decisions, presenting proposals clearly, and navigating cross-functional disagreement or competing priorities.
- Familiarity with frontend development and how design translates into code across web and mobile platforms.
- Strong written and verbal communication, proactive remote collaboration, and the judgment to operate effectively with autonomy and ambiguity.

##### **Preferred / Nice to Haves**

- A love for chess and knowledge of Chess.com and its product experience.
- Experience designing social features for mobile games or consumer products.
- Motion design experience, with strong product and UI design craft as the foundation.
- Design engineering or frontend development experience on web, iOS, or Android.

##### **About the Opportunity**

●  This is a full-time position.

●  We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!).

●  This position is open to applicants globally and requires at least 3 hours of overlap with U.S. working hours.

You can learn more about us here:

[Chess is for everyone!](https://www.chess.com/everyone)

[Our values](https://www.chess.com/jobs#values)

We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.description:
(Salary Range: ₹18–24 LPA fixed based on experience + incentives)

We are seeking an early-career sales professional who is highly motivated, coachable, and eager to build a long-term career in consultative enterprise technology sales. This individual will directly support North American and European business development efforts and should be capable of growing into a quota-carrying account executive within 12 months.

#### Key Responsibilities

1. 2-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or client-facing roles within a digital agency, web development firm, SaaS company, or CMS-driven environment
2. Prior experience selling CMS-based websites or digital platform solutions required
3. WordPress experience strongly preferred; other CMS platforms acceptable if the candidate demonstrates strong technical curiosity and ability to learn
4. Experience engaging with marketing teams, digital leaders, or technology stakeholders is preferred
5. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field; relevant experience may substitute

#### Must Have

1. Excellent communication and presentation skills.
2. Ambitious and motivated to grow within a structured sales organization
3. Comfortable discussing web technologies, digital platforms, and marketing-driven business objectives
4. Organized and process-oriented, with CRM discipline and attention to follow-through
5. Collaborative mindset, able to work effectively within a distributed US and India team

#### Good to Have

1. Prior experience working in close collaboration with cross-functional groups, including external channel partners, internal delivery and engineering functions, to win new business.
2. Experience working in a consulting agency, primarily in DXP and web development space. Huge bonus for experience with CMSs such as WordPress, Drupal, AEM, Sitecore
3. Actively maintaining a blog/journal. Even better if you use WordPress for it.

#### Working Requirements

1. Full-time employee (base salary + incentives)
2. Comfortable working in US-aligned time zones and standard US business hours.
3. Comfortable operating in a fully remote environment

#### Growth Potential

This role is designed for someone who wants to build a career in enterprise digital sales. The ideal hire sees this as a stepping stone toward becoming a Senior Account Executive or Strategic Business Development leader within rtCamp.

We are looking for a **Young Apprentice** to support our operations in Brazil, contributing directly to the continuity, efficiency and safety of activities that are fundamental to onshore and offshore operations.

At DOF, you will be part of a solid global organization, recognized for its strong HSEQ culture, well-structured processes and a genuine commitment to people. We value professionals in training who have curiosity, initiative, a willingness to learn and the ability to work collaboratively with different areas.

**Location:**

This position will be based in Macaé.

Diversity expands our access to the best talent, because **there are no limits for those who have passion for what they do!**

- Relentless, respectful follow-up; comfortable holding senior stakeholders to commitments
- Advanced spoken and written English (C1+ or higher) and availability during US business hours, and after-hours availability on short notice

- Follow-Through – 90%+ of action items closed by their due date; 100% of overdue items escalated with a recommendation within 2 business days

- Reporting Cadence – Weekly Technology status report delivered every Friday and monthly executive summary delivered by the 3rd business day; zero missed cycles per quarter

- Vendor & Renewal Management – 100% of contract renewals surfaced to the CTO at least 60 days before term; zero unintended auto-renewals.

- The CTO's time goes to strategy and leadership, not operational follow-up

- One source of truth for what Technology is working on, why, and where it stands

- Proactive communication: stakeholders hear from you before they have to ask

- Judgment on what to handle directly, what to escalate, and when
