jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer – AI Safety
jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company that drives opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate in diverse markets such as financial services, healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and more. Experian invests in people and advanced new technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an incredible team of 25,200 employees in 32 countries.

Our uniqueness is valuing yours. Experian's people-centric, inclusive, and purpose-driven culture is recognized by numerous awards — including World’s Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune's Top 25 global) and Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries, among others. Check out Experian Life on social media or explore our careers website to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an equal opportunity employer and an affirmative action employer. If you have a disability or need that requires accommodation, please let us know as soon as possible.

#### Job Description

We are looking for an experienced, proactive Senior ML Engineer to join Experian’s AI Safety team. You will lead the design, implementation, and governance of safety-critical GenAI systems across the business, partnering with senior engineers, security, risk, compliance, legal, and product stakeholders to ensure AI systems are robust, explainable, fair, auditable, and aligned with regulatory and ethical standards. As a senior contributor, you will mentor engineers, shape technical strategy, and help drive adoption of AI safety best practices across the organisation.

**Key responsibilities**

- Lead the design and implementation of Responsible AI frameworks, governance policies, and safety guardrails for GenAI systems.


- Define and own AI safety evaluation pipelines, including red-teaming, adversarial robustness testing, jailbreak and prompt injection assessments, and automated safety benchmarks.


- Develop explainability and interpretability tooling to support model audits, regulatory reviews, and clear communication of model behaviour and limitations.


- Partner with risk, compliance, legal, privacy, security, product, and engineering teams to embed safety requirements into scalable GenAI solutions.


- Lead incident response and root cause analysis for AI-related safety issues, including post-incident reviews and remediation playbooks.


- Contribute to GenAI-powered solutions in fraud detection, credit risk, customer service automation, and platform initiatives while ensuring alignment with AI risk appetite.


- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and represent AI Safety in cross-functional forums.


#### Qualifications

**Required qualifications**

- Experience in machine learning, data science, or software engineering, including focused on AI safety, alignment, Responsible AI, or model governance.


- Strong Python skills and proficiency with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, or equivalent tooling.


- Hands-on MLOps experience, including MLflow, Kubeflow, CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, versioning, and reproducible deployment practices.


- Demonstrated knowledge of AI safety techniques including red-teaming, adversarial testing, fairness metrics, interpretability methods, and alignment approaches.


- Strong understanding of AI governance, model risk management, and regulatory expectations in financial services, with practical experience preparing documentation for audit or regulatory review preferred.


- Excellent written and verbal English skills, with the ability to translate complex safety concepts for non-technical audiences.


**Nice-to-have**

- Experience designing or running automated benchmark suites for LLMs or other GenAI systems.


- Familiarity with bias detection, harm classification, content safety tooling, or policy evaluation frameworks.


- Experience with regulated financial services use cases such as fraud detection, credit risk, customer service automation, or model risk management.


- Experience influencing engineering standards or mentoring engineers in AI safety, Responsible AI, or production ML practices.


#### Additional Information

At Serasa Experian, we believe that diversity is essential for a healthier and more innovative work environment, where everyone can share experiences and express their ideas. That’s why we promote several initiatives to support inclusive recruitment and the professional development of our people.

We also have our affinity groups, created to empower and support individuals from underrepresented groups: ExperianPride (LGBTQIAPN+ community), Ubuntu (racial equity), Women in Experian (gender equity), Aspire (people with disabilities), and Connecting Generations (generations).

Come be part of this transformation!

jobs.title: Global Value & Access Senior Manager
jobs.description:
### **Career Category**

Value and Access

### **Job Description**

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Global Value & Access Senior Manager (Flexible Location: Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Mexico City)**

TheValue and Access Senior manager for LATAMregion will be a **strategic member of Global Operational Pricing (GOP) team,** reporting to the **LATAM Regional Value and Access Lead (RVAL).**

This role serves as a **strategic value and access (V&A) partner for LATAM affiliates and Distributor Markets**, tailors **HTA & reimbursement strategy** and **drives seamless launch execution for key product launches in LATAM**, with the goal of **optimizing patient access and pricing**. The role also supports and leads regional and global initiatives, to ensure consistent application of pricing governance and continuous improvement of processes in Global Operational Pricing.

**What you will do**

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

- Creating and maintaining strong collaborative relationships with **global, regional, and local affiliate teams** to align with pricing, access and global evidence strategies. Close collaboration with relevant advisors from functions such as **IAS, HEOR, Supply, Legal, Marketing, and Medical** is essential to gather insights and ensure that pricing recommendations are well-informed and aligned.

Supporting affiliates with RTQ management, data, modelling inputs and provide continuous support along the **payer engagement/negotiation process**. Transferring learnings between affiliates.
- Offering strategic insights and support to affiliates to develop robust business cases and managing pricing governance. Supporting the implementation of **payer and policy-related innovation initiatives** that meet both payer and Amgen’s needs in the region, including **innovative pricing schemes**.
- Collaborate to **drive the price governance across the region**, ensuring a unified "One Amgen" approach. This involves conducting comprehensive, end-to-end assessments of affiliate business cases for price changes, ensuring they align with strategic objectives, comply with pricing policies, and remain consistent with regional pricing bands. Additionally, **evaluate risks related to International Reference Pricing (IRP),** cross-border implications, and the **financial/P&L impact** of various scenarios, ensuring that decisions are informed and made at the appropriate leadership level within the organization.
- Ensuring affiliate business cases align with strategic objectives, comply with pricing policies, and remain consistent with regional pricing bands. Additionally, evaluating risks related to IRP, cross-border implications, and the financial/P&L impact of various scenarios, ensuring that decisions are informed and made at the appropriate leadership level within the organization.

- Collaborate with RVAL to develop and enhance VA&P capabilities within the sub-region by sharing best practices and ensuring quality execution at both the sub-regional and affiliate levels.
- Closely monitoring access status of Amgen brands and major competitors in LATAM and ensure up to date access information is included in GOP systems like ACT, BET etc.
- **Leading the sharing of best practices and key learnings across affiliates** to develop and enhance VA&P capabilities within the sub-region.
- **Leading and contributing to global initiatives** to enhance and continuously improve Global Value & Access systems and processes such as GOP CoEs and Taskforces.

**What we expect of you**

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The vital attribute professional we seek is a type of person with these qualifications.

**Basic Qualifications:**

- Doctorate degree and 4 years of Market access and/or HEOR and/or Marketing experience OR

- Master’s degree and 6 years of Market access and/or HEOR and/or Marketing experience OR
- Bachelor’s degree and **8 years of Market access and/or HEOR and/or Marketing experience.**
- **Advanced English is a mandatory requirement for this position and will be assessed throughout the interview process.**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- **In-Depth Knowledge of Payer and Government Landscape:**

  Extensive understanding of regional healthcare environment including key areas such as **reimbursement, pricing and contracting, value drivers, formulary management, Health Technology Assessment (HTA), government affairs, policy, and advocacy**
- **Analytical and Situational Awareness:**

  Ability to conduct comprehensive situation analyses of the external environment, synthesizing relevant information to inform regional strategies and support the development of country-specific strategic plans
- **Financial Acumen and P&L Management:**

  Solid understanding of financial principles, including profit and loss (P&L) management. Ability to assess financial implications of pricing and access strategies, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivering financial performance in line with regional and global goals

**What you can expect of us**

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

jobs.description:
**Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.**

## **GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub, we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

**This is an affirmative position for People with Disabilities.**

**Why do we have affirmative positions?**

We believe in fostering diversity and nurturing an inclusive workplace where everyone has equal access to opportunities to reach their full potential. For us to succeed in our mission, diverse perspectives are essential. We want every person at Wellhub to feel welcomed, valued, and empowered.

## **THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Talent Acquisition Analyst - Affirmative position for People with Disabilities (PwD/PcD)** to our  **Global** **Talent Acquisition** team in **Brazil**! **This is an affirmative job opportunity for** **People with Disability**

- All candidates who self-identify as **People with Disabilities (PwD/PcD Pessoas com Deficiência)**, according to applicable Brazilian legislation, may be evaluated for this role.

This role is part of our Talent Acquisition team within the People department, dedicated to attracting, engaging, and hiring top-tier talent globally. As a Talent Acquisition Analyst, you will directly impact our company's growth by managing full-cycle recruitment for non-technical business roles, partnering closely with hiring managers, and driving innovative sourcing and diversity strategies to build a high-performing, inclusive workforce.

**YOUR IMPACT**

- Execute the end-to-end recruitment process for global non-technical business roles across various levels, leading job briefings, candidate sourcing, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding coordination with PeopleOps and PeopleBPs.
- Partner closely with Hiring Managers by leading kickoff meetings to align on hiring needs, evaluation criteria, and timelines, while ensuring hiring teams adhere to SLAs and scorecard submissions.
- Develop and implement innovative sourcing strategies to build diverse candidate pipelines, elevate candidate quality, and optimize overall hiring effectiveness.
- Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion by actively sourcing from underrepresented talent pools and mitigating biases throughout the recruitment cycle.
- Ensure full compliance with local labor laws, regulations, and country-specific recruitment guidelines across all hiring activities.
- Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through timely communication, constructive feedback, and professional representation of Wellhub’s brand and culture.
- Identify recruitment process bottlenecks and propose continuous improvements to boost team efficiency and meet or exceed Wellhub TA OKRs.
- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

## **WHO YOU ARE**

- A talent acquisition professional with previous experience in full-cycle recruitment across non-technical or business disciplines.
- Advanced English communicator (both written and verbal) who can partner seamlessly with global candidates, hiring managers, and cross-functional teams.
- A strategic and analytical thinker with strong business acumen and HR expertise, capable of turning talent insights into actionable hiring strategies.
- A relationship builder with solid negotiation skills and a focus on delivering against SLAs in a fast-paced environment.
- An advocate for diversity and inclusion who brings a thoughtful, unbiased approach to candidate evaluation and pipeline building.
- Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), particularly Greenhouse, to manage candidate pipelines efficiently is a plus.
- A professional holding a Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that **prior experience in full-cycle recruitment** and **advanced level of English** are mandatory requirements.

## **WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

**WELLZ:** A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTHCARE:** Health, dental, and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

**PAID TIME OFF:** It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

**CAREER GROWTH:** Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

**CULTURE:** You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. [Learn more about our shared culture and values here.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/)

**Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on** [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/) **@lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on** [**YouTube**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgIPiszTVm4) **!**

## **Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub**

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. [Read more about it here.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/wellhub_fairpay-syndio-activity-7407826561531363328-wbN_?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAzHQWABKsRqcpvxy4QpDCJNe_szRdC4hgY)

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our [Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice/#:~:text=Aviso%20de%20Privacidade%20para%20Candidatos)

Experian is a global data and technology company that empowers people and businesses around the world. Check out Experian Life on social media or explore our careers site to understand why. Experian also takes pride in being an employer that promotes equal opportunity and affirmative action.

- Structure AI initiatives focused on governance issues.

- Implement and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and value metrics related to AI governance projects.
- Map, assess and mitigate risks related to the use of Artificial Intelligence, including ethical aspects, privacy, security and compliance.
- Prepare presentations, executive reports and materials for committees, governance forums and leadership.
- Monitor market trends, emerging technologies and best practices related to Artificial Intelligence applied to Governance, Risk and Internal Controls.

#### Qualifications

- Completed higher education in Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Economics or related fields.
- Postgraduate degree or MBA in Project Management, Digital Transformation, Governance, Data or related areas will be considered a differentiator.
- Experience in corporate governance, project management or digital transformation. Experience implementing and monitoring multidisciplinary projects. Experience in initiatives related to Artificial Intelligence, Automation, Analytics or Data & AI. Experience interacting with different organizational levels.
- Project management (PMBOK, Agile, Scrum, Kanban or hybrid methodologies). Corporate governance and risk management. Generative Artificial Intelligence (Copilot, ChatGPT or similar). AI governance, Responsible AI and regulatory frameworks.
- Data analysis and performance indicators. Collaboration and productivity tools (Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Power BI, Jira, Azure DevOps or similar). Preparation of presentations and executive materials.
- Certifications in Project Management (PMP, CAPM, Scrum Master, PMI-ACP). Certifications in Cloud and AI (Microsoft Azure AI Engineer, Azure Fundamentals, AI Fundamentals, Copilot, AWS or Google Cloud). Experience in Generative AI adoption programs in corporate environments. Knowledge of Data Governance and LGPD. Advanced English.

Serasa Experian is much more than you imagine. jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
## Who We Are:

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

#### **A day in the life:**

As a Systems Administrator, you keep Power Digital's core platforms running and well-governed. Reporting to the Sr. Manager, IT, you are the hands-on administrator for Google Workspace, Okta and Slack, and you support Power Digital's (PDM) internal business functions as we integrate newly acquired companies into our systems. Your days blend hands-on admin work (provisioning, policy configuration, integrations, escalations from the IT Helpdesk) with documenting standards and automating repetitive tasks so the team scales cleanly. You work Pacific Time business hours alongside a distributed IT team.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

- Administer Google Workspace end to end: users, groups, shared drives, security and DLP settings, retention, and third-party app access
- Administer Okta as a primary admin: application integrations (SSO/SCIM), groups and group rules, lifecycle automation, MFA and sign-on policies
- Administer Slack: workspace and user settings, app approvals, channel governance, retention, and integrations
- Support PDM business functions with system configuration, integrations and Tier 2 troubleshooting escalated from the IT Helpdesk, and lead the systems workstreams (tenant consolidation, migrations, app onboarding) for acquisition integrations
- Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
- Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department
- Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

#### **Role Requirements:**

- 3+ years administering SaaS platforms for a company of 1000+ people
- Hands-on Google Workspace administration experience (super admin or delegated admin)
- Hands-on Okta administration experience: app integrations, SSO/SCIM, group rules, lifecycle policies
- Slack administration experience (Business+) [Confirmed license tier]
- Scripting or automation experience, e.g., Okta Workflows, Google Apps Script,
- Vendor management experience is a plus.
- Clear written documentation habits; able to explain technical changes to non-technical teammates
- Advanced spoken and written English (B2 or higher) and availability during Pacific Time business hours

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

- Tier 2 Resolution SLAs – 90% of escalated systems tickets resolved within SLA (P1 in <4 hours, P2 in <1 business day, P3 in <3 business days)
- Joiner/Mover/Leaver – 100% of access provisioning completed within 1 business day of request; 100% of leavers deprovisioned in Okta within 24 hours (same day for involuntary terminations)
- Change Hygiene – Zero unplanned, admin-caused outages in Google Workspace, Okta or Slack; 100% of production configuration changes logged in the change log with rollback notes
- Automation – At least 2 recurring manual admin workflows automated and documented per quarter (e.g., Okta Workflows, Apps Script)
- Acquisition Integration – 90%+ of assigned integration milestones (tenant migrations, Okta app onboarding, Slack consolidation) delivered on the agreed date

**Most Important Things (MITs)**

- Keep Google Workspace, Okta and Slack secure, consistent and documented
- Be the reliable Tier 2 escalation point behind the IT Helpdesk
- Automate the repetitive so the team scales without adding headcount
- Make acquisition integrations predictable: on time, low drama, no surprises
- Communicate clearly with non-technical teammates and stakeholders

_Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility._

_Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at [https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/](https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/)_ _[.](https://powerdigitalmarketing.com/company/careers/) If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at_ [_recruiting@powerdigital.com_](mailto:recruiting@powerdigital.com) _before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence._

jobs.title: Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.description:
### About the role

Mission: Emulate the full kill chain of the real-world adversaries that target our business. As our Red Team Expert, you plan and execute full-scope, objective-driven operations from external initial access through phishing, C2, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and Active Directory domain compromise, all the way to actions on objective against our most critical assets. You operate covertly against a mature, monitored environment, defeat modern EDR/XDR and detection controls, and prove exactly how far a determined attacker could get. You then turn every operation into concrete detection engineering wins and defensive improvements alongside our Blue Team.

### What you'll be doing

- Scope, plan, and execute full-scope red team engagements and long-horizon adversary emulation campaigns mapped to real threat-actor TTPs and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
- Execute the complete attack chain: OSINT and reconnaissance, initial access (phishing, payload delivery, public-facing exploitation), establishing and operating covert C2, persistence, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and domain/cloud takeover.
- Develop and deploy custom tooling, payloads, and C2 infrastructure; build and maintain resilient, OPSEC-safe redirector and command-and-control environments.
- Research and weaponize EDR/XDR evasion and bypass techniques — in-memory execution, process injection, AMSI/ETW tampering, and defense-evasion tradecraft — against CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, and Microsoft Defender XDR.
- Compromise Active Directory and hybrid/cloud identity: Kerberos attacks, ACL and delegation abuse, ADCS exploitation, and lateral movement across on-prem and cloud infrastructure (AWS).
- Run assumed-breach, insider-threat, and social-engineering scenarios, including physical and office-network intrusion paths where in scope.
- Work directly with the Blue Team to replay attack chains, validate and tune detections, and measurably close detection and response gaps.
- Document full attack narratives, kill-chain diagrams, and reproducible proof-of-concept steps that let defenders rebuild and detect every stage.
- Translate operational findings into prioritized, actionable remediation and detection-engineering guidance for IT, Network, and Security teams.
- Track operational metrics: objectives achieved, detection and response times, dwell time, evasion success rates, and remediation follow-through.
- Contribute to maturing Sporty's red team capability and threat-informed defense, sharing tradecraft with internal offensive and defensive staff.

### What you'll bring

#### Experience (required)

- **5+ years of hands-on experience** in offensive security, perimeter penetration testing, network security assessments, red teaming, or adversary emulation.
- Strong understanding of external asset discovery, DNS configuration vulnerabilities, and public IP network routing.
- Practical experience auditing and testing Linux and Windows environments and underlying network services.
- Proven ability to perform adversary emulation and bypass techniques against modern EDR/XDR solutions.
- Familiarity with testing physical office network hardware, routers, switches, firewalls, and workplace IT systems.
- Ability to turn external exposures and technical network risks into clear, actionable fixes for IT and Security teams.
- Experience with core web vulnerabilities and limited, scoped testing of modern API interfaces.
- Strong scripting ability in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar to automate perimeter mapping, emulation workflows, and asset discovery.
- Good understanding of scanning, reconnaissance, and interception tools.
- Strong documentation skills.

#### Certifications (one or more required)

- OffSec: OSCP / OSCP+, OSEP, OSWE, OSED, **OSCE3 (or legacy OSCE)**, OSWA, OSMR, OSEE
- Hack The Box: **CPTS**, CBBH, CWEE, CAPE
- Red Team / Active Directory: CRTO, CRTL (Zero-Point Security); CRTP, CRTE, CRTM (Altered Security)
- GIAC: GPEN, GXPN, GWAPT, GRTP, GCPN
- Other recognized: PNPT (TCM Security), eCPPT / eWPTX / eMAPT (INE), BSCP (PortSwigger), CREST CRT / CCT, CPTE

#### Community and competitive track record

- **Bug bounty recognition:** bounty awards, hall-of-fame listings, or published CVEs through HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti, YesWeHack, or vendor-run programs.
- **CTF achievements:** active player on a ranked CTFtime team, Hack The Box Hall of Fame or Pro Lab completions, or finalist/podium placements in recognized competitions (DEF CON CTF, Google CTF, HTB Business CTF, SANS Holiday Hack, and similar).

#### **What’s in it for you**

- Sporty is a remote first company in pursuit of sustainability
- A competitive salary + individual performance based bonuses every quarter
- 28 days paid annual leave
- Our core working hours are 10am-3pm in your local time zone with flexibility outside of this
- Referral bonuses & flash bonuses
- Top of the line equipment
- Annual company retreats to provide great internal networking opportunities

#### **Interview process**

- Remote video screening with our Talent Acquisition Team
- Offline Take home assignment
- Remote video interview with Team Members (60 Mins)
- Final discussion with the hiring manager (60 mins)

If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours. We are committed to maintaining a fair, secure and authentic recruitment process. Applications submitted using false, misleading or fraudulent information, including impersonated or fake profiles, will not be considered. Where reasonably necessary to protect the integrity and security of our recruitment process, we may verify a candidate’s identity and/or the _accuracy_ of information provided during the recruitment process. Any such checks will be carried out in a proportionate and appropriate manner and in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws.

jobs.title: Sales Processes Specialist - Salesforce
jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Serasa Experian is the first and largest Datatech in Brazil. A leader in intelligence solutions for risk and opportunity analysis, focused on the credit, authentication and fraud prevention journeys. With cutting-edge technology, innovation and the best talent, it turns the uncertainty of risk into the best decision, helping people achieve their dreams and companies of all sizes and segments thrive.

We have 22,000 people operating in 32 countries and every day we are investing in new technologies, talented professionals and innovation to help all clients maximize every opportunity. With corporate headquarters in Dublin, Ireland, Experian is listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN) and is a constituent of the FTSE 100 index.

#### Job Description

We are looking for a person to act as a **Sales Processes Specialist**, with a strategic role in evolving the experience of our SME sales channels.

This person will be responsible for **developing a deep understanding of the sales operation, mapping journeys and processes, identifying friction points and opportunities, and turning these diagnoses into concrete improvement actions**, following the process from identifying the problem through to implementation and measurement of results.

We are looking for someone with strong analytical capability, systemic vision and an execution orientation, who can move between **Sales, Operations, Technology, Products and other partner areas**, connecting business needs to simple, scalable and sustainable solutions.

What will your main responsibilities be

- Act as an **agent of transformation for the experience of the SME sales channels**, identifying opportunities and leading initiatives that make the sales journey simpler, more efficient and more productive.
- Develop a deep understanding of the sales channel operation, understanding its main pain points, needs, processes, tools, dependencies and friction points.
- **Map end-to-end sales journeys and processes**, structuring **AS IS and TO BE** scenarios and identifying opportunities for simplification, automation, standardization and efficiency gains.
- Identify and prioritize opportunities considering impact on **channel experience, productivity, conversion, quality, error reduction, risks and operational effort**.
- Investigate problems using **root cause analysis** methodologies, avoiding one-off fixes and acting on the structural causes of the main friction points in the operation.
- Transform Sales needs and pain points into **viable, scalable and measurable requirements and solutions**, ensuring alignment with the areas involved.
- Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on **reducing the operational burden on salespeople and simplifying the sales process from start to finish**.
- Identify improvement opportunities in the use of **tools, systems and technologies that support the sales operation**, including Salesforce.
- Lead multidisciplinary projects and initiatives involving Sales and partner areas, managing stakeholders, dependencies, risks, action plans and deliverables.
- Structure indicators to establish **baselines, targets and results tracking**, measuring the gains generated by implemented initiatives.
- Monitor the effectiveness of solutions after implementation, identifying adjustments and new opportunities for evolution.
- Build **reports, analyses and executive presentations**, translating complex data and information into insights, recommendations and clear direction for decision-making.
- Spread a culture of **continuous improvement and channel-centric thinking**, contributing to a sales operation that is increasingly simple, efficient and experience-driven.

What we look for in you

- Completed higher education in **Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Technology, Process Management or related areas**.
- Solid experience in **Processes, Projects, Commercial Transformation, Sales Operations, Business Operations, PMO or related areas**.
- Hands-on experience with **process mapping, analysis and redesign**, including building AS IS and TO BE scenarios.
- Knowledge of **continuous improvement and structured problem-solving methodologies**, such as PDCA, Kaizen, Lean, Lean Six Sigma, 5 Whys, Ishikawa Diagram or similar.
- Knowledge of **agile methodologies and project management**, with the ability to lead initiatives involving different areas and stakeholders.
- Strong analytical capability, able to **turn data into diagnoses, hypotheses, insights and recommendations that support decision-making**.
- Ability to build indicators and measure results, connecting initiatives to concrete business impacts.
- Excellent **communication, influence, negotiation, presentation and conflict management** skills, including in environments with multiple stakeholders.
- Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to navigate between different levels and areas of the organization.
- Ability to structure complex problems, set priorities and lead initiatives with **autonomy and a sense of ownership**.
- Experience preparing **reports and executive presentations**, with the ability to synthesize information and communicate recommendations objectively.
- **Advanced English**, given frequent interaction with global teams via email and meetings.
- Advanced knowledge of **Salesforce** and the commercial tools ecosystem.
- **Salesforce Administrator certification / a track equivalent to Ranger on Trailhead – mandatory requirement.**

#### Qualifications

We are looking for a person who combines **business vision + processes + data + channel experience**.

It will be important to have:

- **Customer/channel-centric vision:** ability to see processes from the perspective of the seller and identify friction that hinders their experience.
- **End-to-end vision:** understanding impacts and dependencies beyond a specific stage or area.
- **Problem solving:** investigating problems, identifying root causes and structuring solutions.
- **Data-driven mindset:** using data to prioritize problems, build hypotheses and measure results.
- **Influence without authority:** mobilizing different areas around a common agenda.
- **Execution:** turning diagnosis and recommendations into actions that are effectively implemented.
- **Continuous improvement:** questioning existing processes and constantly seeking simpler and more efficient ways of working.

#### Additional Information

Serasa Experian is much more than you imagine. With the purpose of creating a better future, expanding opportunities for people and companies, in Brazil we are more than 4 thousand people working in various teams and specialties. Here, each knowledge and diversity complements the other and you can work on what you love most. We are committed to building an inclusive culture and an environment in which people can balance their careers with their commitments and personal interests, valuing well-being.

We are dedicated to being one of the best and most innovative companies to work for in the country, enabling amazing experiences and careers for our people. Our strong people-first approach is recognized externally through several market certifications: we were awarded by Great Place To Work in 24 countries and by the international Top Employers certification, in addition to being recognized as one of the best companies for young professionals and having a 4.6 rating on Glassdoor. Each recognition tells us we are on the right track, providing an increasingly better work environment for our talent.

Experian Careers - Creating a better tomorrow together

[Find out what its like to work for Experian by clicking here](https://www.experian.com/careers/)

- Resolve straightforward technical issues and service requests.

- Escalate complex issues to specialist teams when required.
- Maintain accurate case records and ensure SLA targets are met.
- Communicate professionally with clients and internal stakeholders.
- Contribute to process improvements and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

- Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
- A problem-solving mindset with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

You'll be part of a collaborative technical support organization where you'll develop your technical expertise, gain exposure to a wide range of client challenges, and play an important role in ensuring a seamless support experience

We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Awin is part of the Axel Springer group.Learn more at [axelspringer.com/en/](https://www.axelspringer.com/en/), and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: [axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why](https://www.axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why)

jobs.description:
**Your well-being, our mission. Join a company that makes the world healthier.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

We are revolutionizing corporate well-being. Our platform connects employees around the world with the best partners in physical exercise, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition and sleep routines – all in a single subscription. Based in New York with teams in Europe, North America and South America, our mission is to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be rewarding, inspiring and balanced. Here, you will find a team that values well-being, collaboration and diverse perspectives, in a place where passion and creativity break barriers to create real impact. Your contributions will help build a healthier world, for you and millions of people globally.

**Why do we have affirmative action roles?**

This is an affirmative action role for **People with Disabilities.**

Because we believe in fostering diversity and nurturing an inclusive work environment, where everyone has access to equitable opportunities and can reach their full potential.

To achieve our mission, it is essential that there are diverse perspectives here and that all people feel welcomed, valued and empowered at Wellhub.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **CX Agent Analyst** to join our **Customer Experience** team in **São Paulo!**

**YOUR IMPACT**

- Ensure customer satisfaction by managing daily communications across service channels (email, chat, phone).
- Provide accurate and complete solutions to questions and requests, using established tools and processes.
- Build trusting relationships through empathetic, clear and objective communication, researching the customer's history and data to achieve the best resolution.
- Manage and update records in the system/CRM accurately, promptly categorizing tickets and following open issues through to final resolution.
- Follow all operational processes and guidelines, proactively escalating recurring or critical issues to leadership.
- Meet individual and team goals on quality and productivity indicators, collaborating with different areas to support operations.
- Handle additional operational routines of the area, such as day-to-day requests and approvals.
- Maintain a consistent standard of excellence, empathy and courtesy in all contacts.
- Commit to the training and development you receive to stay up to date on products and processes.
- Live the mission: inspire and empower Wellhubbers by prioritizing your own well-being and that of your colleagues. Be part of a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off and finding a balance between work and personal life.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- Live in São Paulo.
- High school diploma or technical education completed. A university degree will be considered a differentiator.
- Prior knowledge of CRM platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce or similar) and familiarity with tracking/metrics tools.
- Excellent written communication, good grammar and comfort with digital tools/computing.
- Knowledge of productivity tools (Google Workspace or Microsoft Office Suite) is a differentiator.
- Prior experience in customer service (CX), multichannel work and text/chat support.
- Native Portuguese. Intermediate or advanced English will be a differentiator.

Even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements, apply! We would be delighted to receive your application and assess your fit with our team.

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

We create a work environment for you to thrive in every dimension of your life. We do this through well-designed benefits, resources for emotional well-being and a culture that empowers each person to truly connect with their role here and take ownership of it, balanced with their own well-being.

Our flexible benefits program helps you customize them to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ plan, with access to thousands of gyms and studios, digital fitness programs and online resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, sleep routines and more. You can also add up to 3 family members to your plan, ensuring that those who matter most to you have access to well-being.

**WELLZ:** A unique and comprehensive resource for mental well-being. Wellz offers personalized journeys that combine weekly cognitive behavioral therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTH AND CARE:** Health insurance, dental plan and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** With a work arrangement that prioritizes flexibility, we offer hybrid and remote roles, so you have the freedom to work in the way that suits you best. The work model for this specific role can be discussed with the recruiter and leadership. When you join Wellhub, you can also use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office!

**PAID TIME OFF:** Disconnecting and recharging is very important. That is why we offer vacation after 6 months of work + 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year at the company (up to 5 days) + 1 day off in your birthday month!

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new member into the family is one of life's most special moments. We want every employee to be truly present and enjoy this time with family. That is why we offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Those who give birth are also entitled to extended leave (Citizen Company program) and a ramp-back period, during which they can work part-time until they adjust to the new routine.

**PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT:** Get access to learning platforms (including language learning), take part in interactive sessions and explore our internal opportunities. During your internship, you will also develop a project of your own, based on your area and specialties, and have a mentor to help you during your internship. At Wellhub, we focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your path toward success – both personal and professional.

**CULTURE:** You will join a team of dedicated people who come together to break barriers, support one another and create lasting impact on corporate well-being. We win together, cultivating trusting relationships through transparent communication and a culture where every perspective matters. [Learn more about our values and culture.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/)

**Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on** [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/) **@lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on** [**YouTube**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgIPiszTVm4) **!**

**Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging @ Wellhub**

We seek to create a collaborative, welcoming and inclusive environment, where everyone feels they belong.

Wellhub is an employer committed to promoting equitable opportunities. All qualified people who apply will be given equal consideration, without discrimination based on race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, nationality, veteran status or any other basis covered by applicable law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and compensate our people. We are proud to be a Syndio Fair Pay Certified company, a certification that reflects our ongoing dedication to fair and equitable pay practices across our global team. [Read more here.](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/wellhub_fairpay-syndio-activity-7407826561531363328-wbN_?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAAzHQWABKsRqcpvxy4QpDCJNe_szRdC4hgY)

Questions about how we handle your personal data? [See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/job-applicant-privacy-notice/#:~:text=Aviso%20de%20Privacidade%20para%20Candidatos)

jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company that drives opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate in many markets, including financial services, healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and more. Experian invests in people and in new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an incredible team of 25,200 employees in 32 countries.

Our uniqueness is valuing yours. Experian's culture, which is people-focused, inclusive, and purpose-driven, is recognized by several awards, including World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25) and Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries, among others. Check out Experian Life on social media or explore our careers site to find out why. Experian is also proud to be an employer that promotes equal opportunity and affirmative action.

#### Job Description

We are opening an Engineering Manager position to lead five platform domains: SDLC, Quality Engineering, Developer Experience, GenAI applied to engineering, and Observability. These are squads that build the technical foundation used by all engineering teams in the company, with internal products ranging from a developer portal and CI/CD pipelines to AI agents embedded in the development cycle and an observability platform.

The position reports to the Foundation Engineering Manager and leads coordinators with teams made up of Developers, QAs, and SREs.

The goal is to have a person capable of autonomously taking on a significant part of the technical and business decisions for the area, including representation in architecture forums, roadmap prioritization, and conversations with product, security, and infrastructure stakeholders.

**Scope of the domains**

•  **SDLC and Delivery Engineering:** standardization of CI/CD pipelines, branching and release strategy, code owners, DORA metrics, dependency management, base images, static security integrated into the pipeline, and engineering maturity per squad.

•  **Quality Engineering:** automated quality gates, testing strategy (contract, mocks, E2E in critical flows), coverage, database migration linters, and quality governance before merge.

•  **Developer Experience:** evolution of the internal developer portal (IDP), service catalog with ownership and operational health, self-service provisioning of cloud resources, golden paths, templates, and the technical onboarding journey for new people.

•  **GenAI applied to engineering:** AI agents for self-service provisioning, automatic code review with blocking of risks in pull requests, and knowledge bases that guide development. Includes agent architecture, quality evaluation of responses, and adoption by teams.

•  **Observability:** standards for logs, traces, and metrics, automated instrumentation from service creation, structured on-call, maturity scorecard per squad, and cost dashboards.

**Responsibilities**

•  Lead coordinators and engineers across the five domains, being accountable for technical results, roadmap delivery, and people development.

•  Build and defend the domains' roadmap tied to business and engineering metrics: change failure rate, lead time, test coverage, MTTR, adoption of internal platforms, and reduction of operational support.

•  Get into the technical merits of each domain's decisions: review architecture proposals, question assumptions, request data, and reject paths that add complexity without clear return.

•  Represent the area in architecture forums, security committees, and conversations with product and technology leadership, with autonomy to decide without escalating everything.

•  Translate internal customer pain (developers, QAs, SREs) into prioritized initiatives, with an explicit value hypothesis and a way to measure adoption.

•  Sustain the operation of what is already in production: reliability of internal platforms, technical debt, cost, and incident response involving the domains.

•  Coordinate initiatives that cut across domains and depend on product teams, negotiating timelines and scope without transferring friction to the squads.

•  Develop the leadership layer below: provide context, delegate decisions, calibrate performance, and build succession.

•  Define and track quarterly goals per domain, with objective success criteria.

#### Qualifications

•  Prior experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with enough depth to discuss code, architecture, and implementation trade-offs on equal footing with senior engineers.

•  Mastery of CI/CD practices at scale: branching and release strategies, quality gates, versioning, rollback, and pipeline standardization for multiple stacks.

•  Hands-on experience with public cloud (preferably AWS) and Kubernetes as the execution base for microservices, including deployment and security strategies.

•  Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and automation of build, release, and provisioning processes.

•  Applied observability: logs, metrics, and distributed tracing, instrumentation with OpenTelemetry, SLI/SLO definition, and an on-call culture.

•  Quality engineering as a technical discipline: test pyramid, contract testing, regression test automation, and use of quality data for decision-making.

•  Practical understanding of GenAI applied to engineering: agents, RAG, output quality evaluation, inference cost, and the limits of what makes sense to automate.

•  DevSecOps: static analysis, vulnerability and dependency management, governance of internal libraries, and security built into the pipeline instead of manual review.

•  Platform-as-a-product thinking: discoverability, adoption, consuming team autonomy, and usage metrics.

**Leadership expectations**

•  Real autonomy: ability to drive a topic end to end, decide with incomplete information, and own the consequences.

•  Critical thinking: question demand without clear value, including when it comes from above, and propose alternatives instead of simply refusing.

•  Direct and accessible communication, adjusting depth to the audience: engineers, product managers, or executives.

•  Consultative decision-making: listen to the team and seek consensus before deciding, without turning this into paralysis.

•  Managing conflict and expectations across areas without passing the cost on to the squads.

•  Focus on measurable results rather than delivery volume.

**Differentiators**

•  Experience leading an internal developer platform (Backstage or equivalent) with adoption metrics.

•  Prior experience in Site Reliability Engineering or operating high-volume critical systems.

•  Experience in a regulated or sensitive-data environment, with audit and compliance requirements.

•  Experience putting AI into production within the development cycle, not just in proof of concept.

•  Certifications in cloud, Kubernetes, or HashiCorp.

•  Participation in technical communities, conferences, or open source projects.

**Requirements**

•  Experience leading engineering teams, with at least one stint managing multiple squads or a leadership layer below.

•  Track record of ownership of platform, infrastructure, or development lifecycle, not only product teams.

•  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields, or equivalent experience.

•  English for technical conversations with global teams.

#### Additional Information

Serasa Experian is much more than you might imagine. With the purpose of creating a better future by expanding opportunities for people and businesses, in Brazil we are more than 4,000 people working across many teams and specialties. Here, every skill and diversity complements the others, and you can work on what you love most. We are committed to building an inclusive culture and an environment where people can balance their careers with their personal commitments and interests, valuing well-being.

We work hard to be one of the best and most innovative companies to work for in the country, enabling incredible experiences and careers for our people. Our strong people-first approach is recognized externally through several market certifications: we have been awarded by Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries and by the international Top Employers certification, and we are recognized as one of the best companies for young professionals and have a 4.6 rating on Glassdoor. Each recognition tells us we are on the right path, providing an increasingly better work environment for our talent.

jobs.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.
About JumpCloud®
JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 
JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.


About the role:
As an Implementation Consultant, you will guide our direct customers and partner organizations through scalable implementation and onboarding project plans. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Solutions Architects, you will act as a dedicated technology specialist who loves the challenge of consulting, planning, and assisting with all sizes of platform rollouts. You will leverage your technical background in identity and access management to ensure smooth product transitions, directly driving customer satisfaction, meeting strict implementation SLAs, and increasing the overall adoption and utilization of the JumpCloud platform.

Major Performance Objectives (KPOs):
Meet Implementation SLAs: Consistently meet or exceed all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) associated with customer implementations, ensuring timely rollouts and resolutions to technical onboarding issues via email or remote web sessions.


Increase Platform Adoption & Utilization: Drive a measurable increase in the adoption and utilization of the JumpCloud platform by ensuring successful knowledge transfer and demonstrating the full value of the product to technical audiences.


Achieve Strong Customer Satisfaction: Maintain high customer satisfaction (CSAT) ratings throughout the onboarding phase by providing excellent project and account management, regular follow-ups, and clear communication regarding environment changes.

What you'll be doing:
Guide direct customers and partnered organizations through scalable implementation and onboarding project plans.


Build custom onboarding plans based on the specific needs of the customer and the service offering they have purchased.


Consult, plan, and assist with all sizes of rollouts of JumpCloud in customers’ existing environments, including AD/LDAP, O365/G-Suite, and enterprise MDMs.


Resolve technical onboarding and API integration (OAUTH/SCIM) issues via email or remote web session.


Work hands-on in customer environments when applicable to execute complex migration or configuration tasks.


Collaborate with peers, mentors, and community forum leaders to provide the most effective solutions for partners and customers.


Communicate regularly with customers about action plans, recommendations, and new potential use-cases as they relate to JumpCloud.

LI-JR1


Where you’ll be working/Location:
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 
This role is remote in the country of Brazil. You must be located in and authorized to work in Brazil to be considered for this role. 
 
Language: 
JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 
Why JumpCloud?  
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 
One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 
JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. 
 
Scam Notice:
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

Trust Wallet is the secure, self-custody Web3 wallet that empowers people to own and control their digital assets. As a Senior Product Manager, you will drive the execution of new consumer trading products at Trust Wallet and help shape their strategy and vision. jobs.title: Customer Success Team Lead (APAC)
jobs.description:
### Work from anywhere, impact everywhere

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.

We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.

To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.

We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.

We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position

Work from anywhere!

### Position overview

The Customer Success Team Lead (APAC) is pivotal in ensuring the seamless delivery of customer support services, aligning with both departmental KPIs and company OKRs. This role emphasizes proactive leadership, strategic oversight, and continuous improvement to enhance customer satisfaction and retention.

### Responsibilities

- Team Leadership & Development:

  Supervise and mentor a team of customer support Advisors, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment.

  Conduct regular one-on-one calibration meetings to provide feedback, coaching, and development opportunities.

  Approve and manage schedule changes, including PTO, sick leave, and special leave requests, ensuring adequate coverage and adherence to policies and procedures.

- Recruitment & Staffing:

  Collaborate with HR to recruit and hire Advisors, ensuring alignment with business needs and time zone requirements.

  Assist in the onboarding process, ensuring new hires are effectively integrated into the team.

- Training & Performance Management:

  Develop and implement comprehensive training programs for new and existing Advisors.

  Track training progress and completion, ensuring all Advisors meet required competencies.

  Conduct probationary reviews and provide actionable feedback to support agent development.

- Quality Assurance (QA) Program:

  Establish and maintain a QA program, monitoring agent performance through regular evaluations of customer interactions.

  Set and track performance targets, aiming for a minimum of 95% QA compliance.

  Identify performance gaps and implement strategies for continuous improvement.

- Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) & Dissatisfaction (DSAT):

  Serve as the primary point of contact for escalated customer issues, providing timely and effective resolutions.

  Work the Complaints queue and present results to MLRO.

  Oversee the supervisor queue, ensuring complex cases are addressed promptly.

- Documentation & Compliance:

  Conduct audits on contact drivers, tags, and shortcuts every six months to ensure accuracy and compliance.

  Perform four-eye checks on manually created documents before they are sent to customers, minimizing errors.
- Collaboration with Technical CS Specialist:

  Work closely with the Technical CS Specialist to manage reporting processes, ensuring accurate and timely data collection.

  Work closely with Product Owners, Marketing, Team leads from different departments to work out together different improvements in processes.

  Utilize data insights to inform decision-making and drive performance improvements.

### KPI & OKR Achievement

- Quality Assurance (QA):

  95% → Regularly monitor and evaluate agent interactions to ensure adherence to quality standards. Provide constructive feedback and coaching to maintain high-quality service.

- Customer Satisfaction (CSAT):

  97% → Implement strategies to enhance customer interactions, ensuring that Advisors are equipped to meet customer needs effectively. Evaluate different methods like AI to improve our KPI on a regular basis.

- First Time Resolution in Chat:

  12 hours → Monitor chat interactions to ensure issues are addressed within the specified time frame. Identify areas of improvement to update processes on a regular basis.

- First-Time Resolution in Email:

  24 hours → Establish clear guidelines for email responses, ensuring that advisors provide timely and accurate solutions to customer inquiries.

- First Response Time in Chat:

  4 minutes → Encourage Advisors to respond to customer inquiries within the first four minutes. Implement training to improve response times and customer engagement.

- First Response Time in Email:

  6 hours → Set expectations for email response times, aiming to address customer emails within six hours. Monitor performance and provide feedback to maintain efficiency. Actively monitoring queues to address any incident/event in a timely manner.

### Daily Integration Strategies

- Performance Monitoring:

  Utilize dashboards and reporting tools to track team performance against KPIs. Regularly review metrics to identify areas for improvement.

- Coaching and Development:

  Conduct one-on-one sessions with team members to discuss performance, provide feedback, and set goals aligned with KPIs on a weekly basis.

- Process Optimization:

  Identify bottlenecks or challenges affecting KPI achievement and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency.

- Recognition and Motivation:

  Celebrate achievements and milestones related to KPIs to motivate the team and reinforce desired behaviors.

### Skills needed

- Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience working in Operations departments, ideally from a bank, fintech, Customer Success or any finance-related institution
- Proven experience in a customer service leadership role, with a strong track record of achieving performance targets.
- Excellent communication, coaching, and interpersonal skills.
- Strong analytical abilities, with experience in data analysis and reporting.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Familiarity with customer service software and tools.
- Knowledge of quality assurance processes and performance management
- The ability to speak Chinese is required.

### Other requirements

- A dedicated workspace.
- A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
- Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

### Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

- **Shape the Future**

Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

- **Great work-life balance** Build amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.

- **Expect Excellence** Collaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.


At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.
