jobs.title: Deal Desk & Contracts Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Duda**

Duda is a leading website platform for professionals, helping agencies, SaaS companies, and web teams build and manage high-quality websites at scale. Our flexible platform combines powerful design, collaboration, automation, and AI capabilities to help customers work faster and grow smarter. With teams across the US, Israel, Canada, Brazil, and the UK, we are building a collaborative, forward-thinking company focused on innovation, growth, and impact.

At our core, we embrace a collaborative and innovative culture that empowers teamwork, creativity, and ongoing learning. In Colorado, we provide a flexible hybrid work environment and are proud to have received multiple “Best Places to Work” awards.

**About the Role**

Our legal team supports a fast-moving commercial organization with customer contracts, vendor agreements, approval workflows, compliance documentation, sales operations support, and legal process management.

We are looking for a highly organized, tech-forward **Deal Desk, Legal Operations & AI Automation Coordinator** to support our VP, Legal and help keep commercial deals and legal operations moving to support our teams and business. This is an operations heavy role, not a legal counsel role. The right person is detail oriented, reliable, process minded, and excited to use AI tools to make repetitive work faster, cleaner, and more scalable.

This role is ideal for someone who likes structured workflows, clean trackers, organized contract records, accurate deal paperwork, and practical automation. You should be comfortable doing detailed administrative work, following process, collecting approvals, and using AI to reduce manual effort.

#### **What you will do**

- Own contract intake, routing, approval tracking, execution, filing, and follow-up.

- Review order forms, MSAs, DPAs, NDAs, vendor agreements, and related documents for completeness, accuracy, formatting, missing fields, inconsistent terms, signature readiness, and required approvals.

- Coordinate with Sales, Finance, RevOps, Security, Privacy, and business owners to collect approvals and resolve open items.

- Track deal status, blockers, contract versions, key dates, renewal dates, signature status, and follow-up items.

- Maintain accurate records in Duda’s contract repository, CRM, shared drives, e-signature tools, and related systems.

- Prepare first-pass contract packets for legal review, including a short summary of requested changes, commercial context, open approvals, missing information, and known deviations.

- Use AI tools to summarize agreements, compare versions, extract key terms, draft internal status updates, create checklists, organize contract data, and identify process gaps.

- Help build lightweight AI-assisted workflows for legal intake, approval tracking, contract summaries, renewal tracking, playbook use, and recurring legal operations tasks.

- Create and maintain templates, playbooks, approval matrices, clause libraries, trackers, SOPs, and process documentation.

- Support sales operations tasks tied to quote/order accuracy, customer contracting workflows, reseller/agency documentation, and internal handoffs.

- Send polished, professional follow-ups to internal teams and counterparties.

- Identify repetitive manual work and propose practical ways to automate or improve it using AI, workflow tools, templates, or better process design.


#### **AI and technology expectations**

You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be curious, resourceful, and comfortable learning tools quickly.

You should be able to:

- Use AI tools thoughtfully for drafting, summarizing, organizing, and quality-checking work.

- Understand when AI output needs human review, verification, or escalation.

- Create prompts, checklists, templates, and repeatable workflows that improve consistency.

- Use AI to help manage high-volume, detail-heavy work without sacrificing accuracy.

- Look for ways to reduce manual copy/paste work, missed follow-ups, and inconsistent process execution.

- Be comfortable working across tools such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, Salesforce, DocuSign or similar e-signature tools, CLM systems, ticketing tools, AI assistants, and workflow automation platforms.


#### **Required qualifications**

- 2+ years of experience in deal desk, sales operations, revenue operations, legal operations, contract administration, paralegal support, executive operations, business operations, or a similar process-heavy role.

- Strong attention to detail and comfort with repetitive, process-driven work.

- Excellent organization, follow-through, and written communication.

- Demonstrated comfort using AI tools, automation tools, or modern productivity tools to improve day-to-day work.

- Comfortable chasing approvals, reminding stakeholders, and escalating blockers.

- Experience working with contracts, order forms, vendor agreements, sales documentation, approval workflows, or business process documentation.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment with a set, reliable weekly schedule.

**Location & Work Model**

Candidates must reside in Florianópolis to align with our team collaboration needs and occasional in-person meetings.

**Application Instructions**

Please submit an English version of your resume when applying. Interviews will be conducted in English to align with our global communication standards.

**Why Duda?**

At Duda, we value creativity, innovation, and collaboration. You’ll have the opportunity to work with a dynamic, talented team, contributing directly to the success of our global support organization. We believe in empowering our people to achieve their best work and create exceptional customer experiences.

Duda is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other personal characteristic. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our careers site or to complete the application process, please contact accommodations@duda.co.

Want to learn more about Duda? Check us out [here!](https://www.duda.co/about)

jobs.title: Operations Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Partnering with stakeholders across the Technical Services (post-sales support) team, Analytics, Finance, and other teams around the business, this role surfaces key insights to drive business decision-making. The Business Analyst will own recurring business reporting cadences, support strategic and ad-hoc analysis, and help translate complex operational data into clear recommendations for leaders across the organization.

This role requires strong analytical and technical skills, operational rigor, an ability to work across multiple functional areas, and a data-first mindset in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is passionate about understanding and communicating customer experience and business performance through data, and is comfortable balancing repeatable operational reporting with deeper analytical work.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in the eastern timezone and ideally can go into the office for our hybrid working model.

#### **Responsibilities**

- Own recurring business reporting cadences and deliver high-quality, on-time reporting materials for leadership reviews, performance reporting, and operational planning
- Conduct a thorough first pass of the data for each deliverable by identifying meaningful trend changes, anomalies, open questions, and areas that warrant deeper follow-up, so reporting is paired with insight rather than just raw metrics
- Drive analyses of Technical Services business processes, service performance, pricing models, deal structures, and other operational topics; highlight actionable insights and communicate trends that help the business grow and scale
- Support recurring financial, forecast, and capacity-related analysis in partnership with Finance and cross-functional stakeholders
- Partner closely with Analytics, Data Engineering, and Data Architecture teams to ensure data is ingested, cleaned, configured, and documented in a consistent and accurate manner
- Consult with stakeholders on what data and reporting they need to measure performance and evaluate initiatives; design and build dashboards that empower stakeholders to self-serve according to business requirements
- Translate analyses into concise narratives, recommendations, and reporting that can be consumed by both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Balance recurring reporting commitments with scoped strategic and ad-hoc analyses as priorities require

#### **Skills & Attributes**

- 5+ years of hands-on analytics and business reporting experience (or 3+ years with an MBA or equivalent degree), ideally within or partnering with customer-facing organizations
- Skilled at cleaning, transforming, and blending data via programmatic methods such as Python and/or SQL
- Strong understanding of sales and services processes, especially in SaaS or subscription-based businesses, and experience applying data analysis techniques to business performance questions
- Experience reporting on Salesforce data
- Experience working with senior management and presenting to senior or executive leadership
- Ability to query, transform, and analyze raw data, draw conclusions, and develop actionable recommendations
- Strong instinct for identifying data signals, trend changes, and potential anomalies, and for turning those observations into focused follow-up questions or recommendations
- Experience creating automated dashboards designed for stakeholder self-service in Tableau
- Effective at communicating technical concepts and data stories to non-technical audiences
- Able to evaluate competing priorities and tradeoffs within own responsibilities, manage workload effectively, and meet deadlines
- Experience with Technical Support businesses and/or products is a major plus

#### About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our [Leadership Commitment,](https://www.mongodb.com/company) guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. [From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy](https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb), we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. [Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture), and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: FinOps Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a FinOps Engineer to help drive cost optimization and cloud financial governance across our AWS infrastructure and GCP footprint. You'll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Finance, and Product to find and ship savings, build the tooling necessary to maximize efficiency of every dollar spent in the cloud, and cultivate a culture of cost awareness across engineering teams.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not an analyst seat. You'll do the schlep work other teams don't have time for, digging into a bucket's access pattern, writing the Terraform or Lambda that ships the fix, working on a product feature chasing a number until it reconciles, and influencing product decisions when cost to reliability tradeoffs hit. Strong communication matters as much as technical depth, you'll regularly explain a savings case to an engineering team, a finance stakeholder, and a leadership audience in the same week.

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

In this role, you'll:

- **Find and ship savings across AWS and GCP:** Analyze billing, usage, and cost trends to identify opportunities, rightsizing, storage lifecycle policies, data transfer, and spot/auto-scaling. Take ideas from identification through to a realized dollar figure, not just a recommendation.

- **Build and maintain cost attribution:** Tagging policies, cost allocation, and chargeback/showback so engineering teams can see and own their own spend. This is foundational work other savings work depends on.

- **Automate cost governance:** Build automated cost reporting, anomaly detection, and alerting. Write the scripts and infrastructure-as-code (Python, Terraform, Lambda) that enforce cost policy rather than relying on manual review.

- **Partner with engineering on architecture decisions:** Bring cost into the room early, cost-efficiencies are cheaper to get right at design than to retrofit.

- **Work with Finance on forecasting and reporting:** Support budget tracking and financial KPIs; build dashboards engineering and finance can both read.


**You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

- Have strong AWS expertise and working GCP knowledge, including pricing models, billing structures, and cost optimization mechanics.

- Have automation and scripting skills: Python, Terraform/ pulumi, Lambda, or Bash

- Are comfortable with cost/billing tooling: AWS Cost Explorer, Cost & Usage Reports, GCP Billing Reports, and BI/dashboarding (we use Hex).

- Have experience with, or are comfortable picking up, Linear and Notion as the system of record for tracking and documenting FinOps work.

- Experience with a dedicated cloud cost management platform (e.g. CloudZero, Vantage, or similar) is a plus, not required.

- Can analyze cost data and present it clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Have prior experience in a FinOps, cloud cost management, or cloud governance role.

- Are energized by doing the unglamorous, high-leverage work (the schlep) that unblocks other teams, and by working cross-functionally without positional authority.


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.description:
**Fingerprint** empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence.  We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com.

**Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company.** We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies.

[We have raised $77M](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/fingerprintjs) and are backed by Craft Ventures ( [Tesla,](https://www.tesla.com/) [Facebook,](https://facebook.com/) [Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.com/)), Nexus Venture Partners ( [Postman](https://www.postman.com/), [Apollo.io,](https://www.apollo.io/) [MinIO](https://min.io/), Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( [Redis,](https://redis.io/) [Rollbar,](https://rollbar.com/) [Gradle](https://gradle.org/)).

* * *

At Fingerprint, we’re redefining online security and identity verification through cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. As a **Senior Data Warehouse Engineer**, you’ll play a key role in shaping the data backbone that powers our industry-leading platform.

We’re looking for a collaborative, self-starter with a passion for data engineering and a knack for building efficient, scalable data pipelines and warehouses. In this role, you’ll work closely with data scientists, analysts, and engineers to design and implement robust solutions that drive smarter decision-making and fuel innovation.

**Responsibilities:**

- Architect and build scalable, high-performance data warehouse solutions that empower analytics and operational excellence across our platform.
- Develop and maintain reliable, well-documented data pipelines and ELT processes, ensuring data quality and consistency.
- Continuously tune and optimize data warehouse performance—partitioning, indexing, and query optimization are your bread and butter.
- Partner with data analysts and scientists to transform raw data into insightful, actionable analytics and machine learning models.
- Troubleshoot, monitor, and refine our data warehouse infrastructure, balancing speed and cost efficiency.
- Foster a data-driven culture by sharing best practices and championing clean, well-structured data.
- Work with modern cloud-based data warehouses like ClickHouse and ensure seamless integration with our services.
- Contribute to the development of new developer-facing data tools that empower teams across the company.

**Qualifications:**

- A team player who loves collaborating in a tight-knit, cross-functional team.
- A high degree of ownership and autonomy, with a proven ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.
- Strong communication skills in English to navigate our global, remote team.
- Extensive experience designing, implementing, and optimizing data warehouses in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, etc.).
- Hands-on expertise with data modeling and transformation tools like dbt.
- Excellent SQL skills and familiarity with modern columnar storage data warehouses (e.g., ClickHouse, Databricks, BigQuery, or Snowflake).
- Experience with data pipeline orchestration tools like Prefect or Airflow.
- Familiarity with BI tools (e.g., Apache Superset, Sigma, Tableau, Looker) is a plus.
- A solid foundation in software engineering best practices: version control, code reviews, testing, and automation.
- Exposure to infrastructure-as-code tools (like Terraform) and a DevOps mindset is a bonus.
- Bonus points for scripting/automation experience in Bash, Python, or Go.

**Technologies You’ll Work With:**

- **Data Warehouses:** ClickHouse, Redshift
- **Data Streaming:** Confluent Kafka
- **Data Transformation:** dbt, SQL
- **Data Orchestration:** Prefect
- **Infrastructure:** AWS, Terraform
- **Visualization:** Apache Superset, Sigma

We set standard ranges for all US roles based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. To comply with local legislation and provide greater transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
**Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Cloud Security Engineer** for the **InfoSec** team in **Brazil**!

We are looking for an experienced security engineer to lead our cloud security strategy across multi-cloud environments (AWS & GCP). You will drive our Zero Trust architecture, embed a Shift-Left security culture within engineering teams, secure containerized and serverless workloads, and pioneer security controls for emerging Artificial Intelligence deployments—including Agentic AI systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, AI guardrails, and mitigations against OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and MITRE ATLAS framework threats.

This position is for the **Cloud Security team.** The Cloud Security Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing security measures in cloud computing environments to protect data, applications, infrastructure, and services against potential threats and vulnerabilities.

**YOUR IMPACT**

- Architect and govern cloud security controls across AWS and GCP environments following Zero Trust principles;
- Embed automated security testing and threat modeling directly into CI/CD pipelines to champion a Shift-Left culture across development teams;
- Define and execute runtime security, posture management, and compliance for containerized (Kubernetes/EKS/GKE) and serverless architectures;
- Design and enforce security boundaries and guardrails for AI/LLM deployments, covering RAG architectures, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Agentic AI workflows;
- Evaluate and mitigate risks aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and the MITRE ATLAS framework for AI systems;
- You will help to keep our threat intelligence initiatives at a high level;
- You will be responsible for the security of the cloud platform, ensuring security controls provided by cloud service providers;
- You need to ensure controls are configured correctly and integrated into the security strategy;
- You will be responsible for identifying, analyzing and reporting vulnerabilities found in the ecosystem;
- You will also be responsible for configuring vulnerability management tools;
- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- Solid experience with multi-cloud architecture and security controls in both AWS and GCP;
- Proven experience implementing Zero Trust posture, least-privilege identity architecture, and micro-segmentation;
- Strong background in securing containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker) and serverless technologies (AWS Lambda, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions);
- Demonstrated expertise in driving Shift-Left initiatives using SAST, DAST, SCA, and IaC security tooling integrated into DevSecOps pipelines;
- In-depth practical understanding of AI security risks, including OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS framework, prompt injection defense, AI guardrails, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and securing RAG data pipelines and Agentic AI interactions.
- You have great communication skills, you are able to communicate with your teammates and stakeholders synchronously and asynchronously, and use English when needed.
- You know and worked with  Identity Provider Platforms (IDPs) such as Azure AD, Keyclock, and Okta and with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM);
- You have a wide understanding of cybersecurity frameworks such as OWASP and  Mitre’s ATT&CK.You got the ability to create scripts for automating security tasks.
- Familiarity with IT service management processes such as incident management and change management.
- You help your team to collaborate within and with other teams.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Cloud Security and Infrastructure are mandatory requirements.

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and [many more](https://www.riskified.com/customers/).

We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a Digital Experience Specialist to support the day-to-day management of Riskified's global digital experience. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys organization, technology, and creating exceptional web experiences.

Working closely with the Digital Experience Manager, you'll help maintain our seven multilingual websites, publish content, coordinate website updates, and ensure our digital properties remain accurate, consistent, and optimized.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to grow a career in digital marketing, website operations, or digital experience.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

#### **Website Management**

- Publish and update content in WordPress across seven multilingual websites.
- Build and format landing pages using existing page templates and components.
- Maintain page layouts, navigation, and website content.
- Ensure content is accurate, consistent, and follows brand guidelines.
- Coordinate multilingual content updates with translation teams.
- Perform routine website quality assurance (QA) before pages go live.

#### **Digital Operations**

- Execute recurring website requests from global and regional Marketing stakeholders.
- Support marketing campaign launches by publishing webpages, lead generation forms, banners, and CTAs.
- Update resource libraries, blog posts, events, webinars, and customer stories.
- Manage redirects, SEO metadata, and content housekeeping.
- Help maintain website documentation and processes.
- Monitor website health and report issues to the development team.

#### **Quality Assurance**

- Test webpages across devices and browsers.
- Check links, images, forms, and page functionality.
- Review pages for accessibility and content quality.
- Ensure multilingual sites remain synchronized after updates.

#### **Cross-Functional Support**

- Partner with Marketing, Product Marketing, Design, Content, and Web Development.
- Coordinate website requests and track progress.
- Help improve operational workflows and identify opportunities for automation.

### **Qualifications**

- 1–2+ years of experience working with websites or digital marketing.
- **Fluency speaking and writing in English required.**
- Experience using WordPress CMS.
- Strong attention to detail required.
- Excellent organizational skills required.
- Familiar with basic SEO principles required.
- Comfortable managing multiple priorities.
- Familiarity with Google Analytics or similar analytics tools required.
- Experience working with multilingual websites.
- Basic understanding of HTML and CSS
- Experience with AEO/GEO
- Familiarity with project management tools, including Jira, AirTable, Asana, or [Monday.com](http://monday.com).
- Experience working directly with web developers
- Experience working with Figma
- Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve productivity.
- Experience working with marketing automation or CRM platforms.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

**About The Role**

The Security Engineer plays a critical role in protecting our technology infrastructure and maintaining the security posture of our gaming platform. This position exists to proactively identify, assess, and mitigate security vulnerabilities while serving as a trusted security advisor to engineering teams across the organization. The role directly impacts our ability to safeguard user data, maintain platform integrity, and ensure secure development practices are embedded throughout our product development lifecycle.

This position is essential for building and maintaining robust security defenses in a fast-paced, remote-first technology environment where security expertise must be seamlessly integrated into daily engineering operations and strategic decision-making processes.

**What you'll do**

- **Lead vulnerability management program** by triaging, reproducing, and assessing security vulnerabilities submitted through Bug Bounty programs, working directly with engineering teams to prioritize and remediate discovered security gaps
- **Conduct comprehensive threat modeling** by collaborating with engineering teams to analyze proposed solutions, ensuring designs meet security industry standards and identifying potential attack vectors before implementation
- **Manage security incident response** by reviewing penetration testing results and SIEM reports, translating technical findings into actionable remediation tasks, and tracking resolution progress through completion
- **Optimize security infrastructure** by applying updates to Web Application Firewalls (WAF) and other security systems, ensuring configurations align with current threat landscape and organizational needs
- **Drive security tool evaluation and implementation** by researching, evaluating, and recommending security software solutions, attending vendor demonstrations, and leading procurement processes from requirements gathering through deployment
- **Provide security consultation and guidance** by serving as subject matter expert to development teams, ensuring security best practices are integrated into software development lifecycle and architectural decisions
- **Maintain security awareness and documentation** by communicating security updates, progress reports, and recommendations to stakeholders through established channels and maintaining current security policies and procedures

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
- Minimum 3+ years of professional experience specifically in web application security
- Demonstrated expertise with security testing tools such as Burp Suite or equivalent web request analysis and tampering tools
- Strong written communication skills in English with ability to clearly explain technical security concepts to diverse audiences
- Experience working effectively in fully distributed/remote team environments
- Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering and development teams

**Preferred Skills and Qualifications**

- Previous hands-on experience managing or participating in Bug Bounty programs
- Programming experience in PHP or JavaScript
- Experience with penetration testing methodologies and tools
- Knowledge of SIEM platforms and security monitoring systems
- Familiarity with Web Application Firewall (WAF) configuration and management
- Understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices
- Experience with Jira or similar project management and issue tracking systems
- Strong sense of ownership and accountability in a flat organizational structure
- Passion for continuous learning and staying current with evolving security threats and technologies

**About the Opportunity**

- This is a full-time opportunity
- We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!)

---

You can learn more about us here:

- [Chess Is For Everyone!](https://www.chess.com/everyone)
- [Our Values](https://www.chess.com/jobs#values)

jobs.title: Platform Engineer, Edge & Networking
Engineering Manager, Billing
jobs.description:
### **About Supabase**

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for an **Engineering Manager** to lead the Billing team at Supabase. Billing owns the monetization and revenue systems that turn platform usage into accurate customer charges and finance-ready revenue data. The team’s scope includes plans, subscriptions, usage-based billing, invoices, payments, credits, coupons, taxation, dunning, collections, pricing mechanics, entitlements, marketplace and partner billing paths, and integrations with providers such as Stripe and Orb.

Billing sits at the intersection of engineering, product, finance, data, support, and partnerships. The systems are revenue-critical and trust-critical: they must remain correct, predictable, supportable, observable, and extensible as Supabase grows and introduces new products, pricing models, and partner channels.

This is a people, delivery, and technical leadership role. We don’t expect managers to contribute production code directly, but we do expect you to participate in architecture and design discussions, challenge plans with sound technical reasoning, and set a high bar for correctness, reliability, and operational maturity.

### **What You'll Be Responsible For**

**Team & People**

- Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

- Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

- Coach engineers working across backend application code, data pipelines, external integrations, and operational workflows.

- Build durable ownership across the team so critical billing knowledge, access, and incident response do not depend on one person.

- Handle people administration, including leave and time off, for your team.


**Hiring**

- Own the hiring plan for the Billing team and act as Hiring Manager and first-round interviewer for roles on the team.

- Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates with the right mix of billing-domain depth and engineering judgment.

- Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.


**Delivery, Roadmap & Partnerships**

- Own the Billing roadmap and project management in Linear, driving accountability, clear milestones, and predictable delivery.

- Balance new pricing and product capabilities with investments in system correctness, resilience, supportability, and technical debt.

- Manage workflow intake and Slack triage, deciding what should be routed, prioritized, sequenced, or pushed back on.

- Own weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating unnecessary overhead.

- Surface risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and revenue or customer-impact concerns early and clearly to leadership.


**Incident Commander**

- Train as an Incident Commander and lead coordination, resolution, customer-impact assessment, and post-incident follow-up.

- Lead blameless post-incident reviews.


### **You Might Be a Good Fit If You**

- Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

- Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

- Have managed a billing engineering team at a cloud, SaaS, or developer tools company. Experience with developer tools or databases is a strong preference, but we'll consider any sufficiently technical background where you can demonstrate the ability to ramp on a new domain.

- Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones.

- Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but **genuinely passionate about people management.** This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for.

- Build psychological safety and a feedback culture: you give feedback often and in the moment, ask for it back, and create space for the team to do the same.

- Operate as a **multiplier.** Focused on helping individuals achieve more than they could alone, not on being the best technical voice in the room.

- Coach rather than direct. Remove blockers, connect people to context and resources, and trust your engineers to own how the work gets done.

- Have a real track record of **performance management** and can speak to specific examples of difficult conversations and how you navigated them.

- Are comfortable with ambiguity and capable of building structure where there isn't much.

- Communicate clearly and write well. You're default async, default written, set context proactively, and surface risks early.

- Are collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable. You thrive working with high-autonomy, senior ICs who have strong technical opinions and don't need to be the smartest person in the room.


#### **Relevant Billing Domain & Technical Expertise**

You should bring experience across most of the following areas:

- **Subscription lifecycle and monetization mechanics:** plans and packaging, billing cycles, upgrades and downgrades, proration, upfront and in-arrears charges, add-ons, credits, coupons, discounts, refunds, taxes, dunning, collections, disputes, and chargebacks.

- **Usage-based billing at scale:** converting raw product and infrastructure telemetry into billable usage; defining meters and dimensions; applying quotas and pricing; handling late-arriving data; and supporting deterministic reruns, backfills, and reconciliation.

- **Payments and billing-provider integrations:** production experience with Stripe, Orb, or comparable providers, including APIs, webhooks, invoice lifecycle, payment failures, event ingestion, sync engines, rate limits, provider SLAs, and graceful degradation during outages.

- **Entitlements and pricing enforcement:** separating feature access from charging, managing plan defaults and customer-specific overrides, and designing auditable controls that keep product behaviour consistent with commercial agreements.

- **Cross-functional billing operations:** working effectively with Finance, Data, Product, Support, Sales/RevOps, and Partnerships on revenue reporting, customer support, fraud and payment risk, marketplace billing, and new pricing launches.


#### **What We Offer**

- **Fully Remote**

  We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- **ESOP**

  Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- **Tech Allowance**

  Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- **Health Benefits**

  Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- **Annual Off-Sites**

  Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- **Flexible Work**

  We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- **Professional Development**

  Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.


#### **About the Team**

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members


We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

**Who we are**

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to [hundreds of thousands of businesses](https://customers.twilio.com/) and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to [remote-first work](https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work), and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

**Hiring and how we work**

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

**See yourself at Twilio**

Join the team as Twilio’s next Director, LATAM Carrier Relations.

**About the job**

Twilio is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director to spearhead our Carrier Relations team across Latin America. This role is pivotal in ensuring seamless communication services, driving a localized supply strategy, and fostering strategic partnerships with regional carriers. Working closely with cross-functional partners—such as Sales, Product, Commercial Legal, Regulatory— you will align market demand with local carrier capabilities to power Twilio’s growth in the region. The ideal candidate brings a robust background in telecommunications, deep expertise in LATAM regulatory environments, and a track record of building high-performing teams.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

- **Team Leadership:** Lead and mentor a team of carrier relations specialists across LATAM, fostering a collaborative, high-performance, and region-aware culture.
- **Sales Alignment & Demand Strategy:** Partner closely with Sales and Product teams to analyze market trends, understand customer demand, and co-develop country-specific supply strategies tailored to individual LATAM markets.
- **Carrier/Supply Partnerships & Negotiation:** Develop and maintain strong, strategic relationships with regional and local carriers and other suppliers to secure cost-effective solutions, expand coverage, and optimize service delivery.
- **Regulatory & Market Intelligence:** Navigate complex local telecommunications regulations and upcoming policy changes to proactively adapt Twilio's supply strategy and maintain strict compliance across all LATAM territories.
- **Performance & KPI Management:** Implement and monitor localized KPIs to assess supplier performance, route quality, and cost efficiency in alignment with regional business goals.

**Qualifications**

If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

***Required:**

- Minimum of 10 years in the telecommunications services industry, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing carrier relations.
- Deep expertise in LATAM telecommunications markets, local carrier ecosystems, and regional regulatory environments.
- Proven experience collaborating with Sales and Go-To-Market teams to align infrastructure/supply strategy with revenue demand.
- Strong negotiation, influence, and communication skills in complex multi-country environments.
- Data-driven, analytical approach to decision-making and route optimization.

**Desired:**

- Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Business Administration, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
- Familiarity with core communication protocols and standards (e.g., SS7, ISUP, MAP, SIP).

**Location**

This role will be remote, and based in Colombia or Brazil.

**Travel**

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 30% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

**What We Offer**

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

**Twilio thinks big. Do you?**

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call [Twilio Magic](https://www.twilio.com/company/values). Additionally, we empower employees to build [positive change in their communities](https://twilio.org/support-and-resources/impact-fund) by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, [please consider other open positions.](https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions)

.

jobs.title: Program Manager (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
#### **About us**

OpenZeppelin is the security standard onchain finance is built on. Founded in 2015, our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to an open financial system, built on open standards and secured by rigorous research.

Our open-source Contract Libraries have facilitated over $35 trillion in onchain value and are used by 10 of the top 10 tokenized money market funds and 9 of the top 10 stablecoins by market cap.

We combine AI-native security tooling with deep research and a decade of audit expertise to support leading institutions and crypto-native teams shaping the next generation of digital assets like DTCC, Fidelity, Coinbase, Uniswap, Aave, the Ethereum Foundation, and many more across the full secure development lifecycle.

**Please note:** Always refer to OpenZeppelin's official job page for the most accurate information about our open roles, as we have seen multiple third party job sites posting inaccurate information.

#### **The Customer Success Team**

The Customer Success Team owns full project lifecycles and client deliveries end-to-end; keeping Security Research, Secure Development, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, Executive team and clients aligned on a shared plan throughout the entire delivery. Core responsibility of the Customer Success team is client satisfaction as well as supporting any renewal discussions and ongoing partnership. The type of deliveries span across the security services work (audits, reviews, applied research), smart contract library development, web3 tooling as well as marketing and developer relationship engagements.

#### **What you'll be doing**

- **Own the Engagement:** Own the full lifecycle of strategic ecosystem accounts, from kickoff through delivery, renewal, and expansion. Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for each client.
- **Drive Delivery:** Lead client kickoffs, manage scope through a structured change-order process, oversee end-to-end audit delivery, coordinate quality review and publishing, and proactively escalate risks to internal leadership.
- **Administer Program Governance:** Operate the day-to-day governance framework for each engagement — RASCI matrices, workstream structures, and engagement models — and keep the program's working cadence and reporting metrics current. Maintain core program artifacts (milestone plans, scope/MVP definitions, RAID logs) as the definitive source of truth, and formulate executive-level status reports for client and internal leadership.
- **Orchestrate Technical Delivery:** Coordinate architecture and requirements sessions with client engineering teams and translate outcomes into actionable delivery milestones. Oversee delivery across audit and engineering teams — backlogs, sprints, and stage gates — to ensure high-quality, on-time releases, and provide formal go/no-go recommendations at key milestones. Manage technical dependencies including repository access, audit cycles, and vendor onboarding, collaborating with legal on contractual or SOW-related blockers.
- **Coordinate Third-Party Infrastructure:** Synchronize delivery timelines and technical specifications with third-party infrastructure providers and partners, supporting senior leadership in commercial and contractual decision-making where needed.
- **Facilitate Dependency Mapping & Risk Management:** Facilitate stakeholder coordination and dependency mapping across cross-functional teams, resolving operational blockers at the working level and escalating critical decisions to senior stakeholders. Maintain the program's risk and compliance register and drive a regular cadence for regulatory-readiness governance and mitigation.
- **Build Account Intelligence:** Maintain deep, current knowledge of each ecosystem's goals, tech stack, governance, roadmap, and funding landscape. Anticipate client needs and surface opportunities before they are asked for.
- **Grow the Account:** Partner with Sales, Secure Development, Security Services, and Growth to identify upsell opportunities, build compelling renewal narratives tied to value delivered, and contribute directly to the business unit's recurring revenue and subscription targets. Coordinate on target-state and go-to-market use cases, monitoring GTM execution and flagging slippage to program leadership.
- **Engage Technically:** Review codebases at a high level for estimation purposes, hold meaningful technical conversations with client engineering teams, and translate between the client's technical context and OpenZeppelin's delivery teams.
- **Operate with Rigor:** Monitor team performance against key delivery metrics including resource utilization, allocation, and on-time delivery. Use our internal tooling (GitHub, Notion, Slack, HubSpot, and our internal automation system) to streamline workflows and reduce operational overhead.
- **Deliver Unreasonable Hospitality:** Every interaction should exceed expectations. You set the standard for exceptional client care across all account touchpoints, and the judgment calls that AI tooling cannot replicate are yours to make.

#### **You have**

- 5+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Engagement Management, Solutions Architecture, or a closely related customer-facing technical role.
- Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical delivery on time and within scope, and managing a book of business with renewal and expansion responsibility.
- Technical background sufficient to review code at a high level for estimation and to hold credible conversations about smart contract architecture. You do not need to write Solidity, but you should not be lost in a code review.
- Deep understanding of blockchain ecosystems, L1/L2 infrastructure, and the dynamics of open-source business models. Genuine passion for the space.
- Solidity or Rust reading proficiency, or hands-on cybersecurity experience.
- Exceptional relationship-building skills. Clients call you first because they want to, not because they have to.
- Strong commercial instincts: experience managing renewal cycles, negotiating change orders, and building account expansion narratives.
- Superb organization and the ability to manage multiple complex engagements concurrently across many stakeholders and time zones.
- Advanced English; excellent written and verbal communication. Comfortable presenting to a CTO and a CFO in the same meeting.
- Advanced knowledge of project management and collaboration tools including GitHub, Notion, Linear, Slack, and HubSpot.
- Comfort working in a fully remote, async-first, globally distributed environment.

#### **Nice to have**

- Prior experience working directly with protocol teams, L2 ecosystems, or blockchain foundations.
- Familiarity with OpenZeppelin's product suite (Contracts, Open-Source Tools, Audits, AI Auditor).
- Project management certification (PMP, Scrum Master, or equivalent).
- Background in solutions consulting, technical pre-sales, or professional services delivery.
- Experience in a high-growth startup building processes from scratch.
- PMO or people management experience.

#### **Logistics:**

Our interview process takes place on Zoom and tends to consist of the following stages:

- Recruiter Call (30 minutes)
- Hiring Manager Call (30 minutes)
- Team Interview (30 minutes)
- Paid work test (up to 20 hours of paid work)
- Reference checks

#### **Benefits**

- Meet your teammates at company gatherings around the world 😎
- Enjoy the flexibility of fully remote work 🌎
- Take the time you need with flexible time off 🏝
- Grow your family with 8 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks for secondary caregivers, and a one-time $3,600 baby bonus 💙
- Build your ideal home office with up to $500 in equipment support 🪑
- Stay covered with medical insurance 🏥
- Keep growing with learning and development opportunities 🧠
- Get a monthly stipend for your preferred co-working space 💻

At **OpenZeppelin**, we are an equal opportunity employer and we value different perspectives. We are committed to building a diverse workforce. This includes but is not limited to gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, national origin and other characteristics that make each one of us unique. In this uniqueness, we find the most value. Come join us!

#### Use of AI as part of the recruiting process

As part of OpenZeppelin’s recruitment process, we may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence, to assist in reviewing applications and assessing candidate qualifications. These tools are used to support our People team by identifying relevant skills and experience, and are not used to make decisions solely by automated means. All hiring decisions involve human review. Any personal data provided as part of your application will be processed in accordance with OpenZeppelin’s [Data Privacy Notice](https://www.openzeppelin.com/privacy).

If you have questions about this recruitment process or would like to request human review of your application, please contact us at talent@openzeppelin.com.

jobs.title: Unity Technical Artist, Event Pipeline
jobs.description:
Help us ship new 3D immersive events and content to the VRChat community, reliably, efficiently, and with a high quality bar.
Join the VRChat team!
We’re building the future of immersive, user-generated worlds, where anyone, anywhere, can connect, play, explore, and express themselves.
We’re looking for a Unity Technical Artist to support VRChat’s live ops events and content pipeline. This role sits at the intersection of art and engineering: you’ll be hands-on in Unity, you’ll write scripts/tools to make publishing more efficient, and you’ll help our events and content ship smoothly across platforms.
You’ll partner closely with artists, designers, and engineers, so creative work moves from “done” to “shipped” without surprises.

What You'll Do
Own and evolve the end-to-end Unity content pipeline for live ops assets, helping us ship 3D props and content updates with consistency and speed.


Implement and validate 3D assets in Unity: prefabs, materials, shaders, collisions, LODs, lighting setups, and import settings, with an eye toward performance and reliability.


Build and maintain tools, scripts, and automation (primarily in C# and Udon) that reduce manual work, prevent common errors, and make publishing repeatable.


Create lightweight quality gates for content: asset validation checks, naming/structure conventions, performance budgets, and “ready to ship” checklists.


Debug content and pipeline issues across disciplines, working with engineers on technical constraints and with artists on asset readiness.


Collaborate with Product Design and Creators partners to ensure content supports the intended user experience and meets our quality bar.


Document workflows so the whole team can move faster as we scale content volume in 2026.

Who You Are
You have 3+ years experience as a Technical Artist, Tools Artist, or similar role (or equivalent shipped work).


You’re deeply comfortable in Unity and understand what it takes to ship real-time 3D content that performs well.


You can write scripts  (most likely C#) and you’ve built tools or automation that helped teams move faster or reduced production risk.


You understand 3D fundamentals (meshes, materials, textures, lighting, optimization) and can collaborate effectively with artists on asset quality.


You think in systems and pipelines: you notice recurring failure modes, then design guardrails that prevent them.


You communicate clearly across disciplines and enjoy being the person who turns ambiguity into a reliable workflow.


You have a strong ownership mindset: you care about shipping, not just “building a perfect tool someday.”

Bonus Points (Not required, but we’d be excited if you bring any of the following!)
Experience building editor tooling, import automation, or asset validation pipelines in Unity.


Familiarity with the VRChat creator toolchain: Unity + VRChat SDK (Worlds/Avatars) + Creator Companion (VCC/VPM)


Experience building interactivity in VRChat worlds using Udon / UdonSharp (C# that compiles to Udon)


Familiarity with common VRChat avatar components like PhysBones/Contacts and performance best practices.


Experience optimizing content for multiple hardware tiers and platforms (PC + mobile constraints, etc.).


Experience supporting live ops or high-cadence content publishing.

Not sure if you meet every single requirement?
We’d still love to hear from you. We know technical artists come from all kinds of backgrounds. If you’re excited to help ship a steady stream of 3D content to a global community, and you like making pipelines fast, safe, and human-friendly, please apply.

Where You’ll Be
This is a remote-first role. Work from wherever you do your best thinking. We’re a fully distributed company with team members across the globe. While we work asynchronously, overlap with U.S. time zones is needed for team collaboration.

Benefits
100% Remote – work from anywhere in the world


Health benefits for U.S. and Canadian employees


401K (U.S.) and RRSP (Canada) retirement plans


Stock options


Unlimited/flexible vacation policy


Paid parental leave


Generous holiday schedule

VRChat is an equal-opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. VRChat fosters a diverse, creative, and collaborative environment where anyone can contribute to any of the ongoing projects or direction of the roadmap at any time.  If you’re a passionate team player who wants to have an impact on a dynamic team, we’d love to hear from you! 
All job offers are subject to early stage ID checks, satisfactory referencing and background checks.

jobs.title: VP of Trust & Safety
jobs.description:
Job Overview
We are seeking a VP, Trust & Safety to lead our Trust and Safety team and guide the platform's operations and product strategy to maintain a safe and respectful environment for our global community. This leader will have strong product and operational experience and will be responsible for driving excellence and a best-in-class T&S function. The VP, Trust & Safety is accountable for managing and mentoring VRChat’s team of Trust & Safety Agents and establishing a “Safety by Design” mindset across the organization. The VP, Trust & Safety will lead the Product and Operational functions to build safety by design into our products. They will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and the broader Operations team to drive continuous improvement of our internal tools and operational workflows. This is a critical leadership role that combines a passion for user safety with a strategic mindset, enabling the VP, Trust & Safety to have a significant impact on VRChat’s mission to foster a safe and welcoming virtual space. This role reports to the VP of Product and will work closely with leadership across various functions, providing insight and direction to enhance the overall trust and safety framework at VRChat.

Responsibilities
Lead and develop a high-performing Trust & Safety team, ensuring a culture of empathy, integrity, and commitment to user safety


Lead the Product function that will set the strategy for Trust and Safety within the product, while providing the tooling and support for operational functions.


Drive VRChat's trust and safety strategy, setting clear goals and metrics aligned with company objectives


Collaboration across the product to ensure trust and safety is how we design and build our product, not just an afterthought.


Oversee moderation of content and user behavior reports to ensure platform compliance with community guidelines and policies


Develop and implement policies, processes, and training programs that ensure a scalable, consistent approach to moderation and user safety


Engage with the broader trust and safety ecosystem, including other tech companies, NPO’s and government agencies.


Act as a key point of contact with executive leadership, providing regular updates and strategic insight on trust and safety initiatives


Stay informed of industry trends and regulatory developments in online safety to help VRChat stay at the forefront of digital trust and safety

Experience, Skills & Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Social Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Proven experience (5+ years) in trust and safety leadership (with management experience) within a consumer-facing tech company, preferably in a fast-paced start-up environment. Experience in online gaming, social media and/or community-focused platforms is a plus


Strong understanding of content moderation practices, digital safety frameworks, and policy development


Demonstrated success in leading and managing high-performing teams with a focus on safety, well-being, and efficiency


Ability to collaborate across departments and advocate for trust and safety needs with key stakeholders


Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex safety concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences


Familiarity with data analysis and KPI tracking, with a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence


Passion for VR, online communities, and fostering safe and inclusive digital spaces.

Benefits
Work from anywhere! VRChat is a 100% remote company


Health Benefits


401K for US & RRSP for Canadian Employees


Stock Options


Generous paid holiday schedule


Unlimited/Flexible vacation time


Paid parental leave benefits

jobs.title: Website Experience Sr. Director
jobs.description:
**Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Website Experience Sr. Director** in our **Marketing Operations** area in **Brazil or the US (Remote accepted)**!

Reporting to the VP of Marketing Operations, this role owns the evolution of Wellhub's website — from a traditionally-managed site to an Agentic Website Experience and Operations model, where AI agents increasingly handle content assembly, personalization, identity resolution, and optimization, freeing the team to focus on strategy, judgment calls, and the exceptions that matter. This is a hands-on strategic role: owning the roadmap, design, testing, data, and execution, and leading product managers, UX designers, web analytics, and developers to deliver on that vision. You're expected to have a real point of view on where agentic AI creates leverage on a website versus where it introduces risk, and to be able to defend that point of view to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

**YOUR IMPACT**

- Lead the vision, roadmap, and strategy for Wellhub's website experience, driving its evolution toward an Agentic Website Experience and Operations model — where AI agents increasingly handle content assembly, personalization, and optimization.
- Own conversion rate optimization end-to-end: define experimentation strategy, size and prioritize A/B tests, lead qualitative research and behavioral surveys, and translate results into optimization decisions.
- Own website performance measurement and automated reporting (traffic, MQLs, sign-ups, conversions), analyzing visitor behavior through data synthesis, heat mapping, and tools like Amplitude + Looker.
- Partner with stakeholders across the organization to shape the website experience for product launches, content, campaigns, and the broader roadmap.
- Lead the website design and UX function, including the Mantra design system and the end-to-end design-to-code operating model (Figma to Mantra to Strapi), owning the quality bar for both human- and agent-generated work.
- Evaluate, pilot, and scale agentic AI and AI orchestration tools for the website — defining human-in-the-loop boundaries, guardrails, and escalation paths — and identify, procure, and roll out best-in-class website technology and platforms.
- Own the site's readiness for AI-driven discovery and personalization: architect content and information architecture for SEO, GEO/AEO, and Web MCP, lead the rollout of AI-powered personalization and predictive experimentation, and ensure conversational/AI-assisted website interactions align with the broader company AI architecture.
- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

**WHO YOU ARE**

- A seasoned digital/website leader with proven experience and ownership of a website and hands-on experience running experimentation programs.
- Deep expertise across web tech stacks — analytics platforms, headless CMS, and web design systems — with a track record of managing them end-to-end.
- Concrete, hands-on experience applying AI/agentic technology to marketing or web workflows (agent frameworks, AI personalization/CRO, conversational content tooling, or GEO/AEO strategy), including AI-assisted design-to-code workflows in production.
- A clear, defensible point of view on where agentic AI creates leverage versus risk in B2B contexts, with the ability to bridge marketing, martech/engineering, and data teams on AI implementation.
- Experience leading design and/or research functions, or credibly managing senior design ICs and design system owners, including owning a design system as shared infrastructure rather than a component library.
- A strong cross-functional leader who thrives in matrixed, fast-paced, hyper-growth environments, balancing internal business needs with a customer-centric mindset.
- Analytically rigorous, with strong critical thinking to translate complex AI topics into actionable insights and a sharp focus on KPIs and conversion metrics.
- Quick to adapt to new domain contexts, AI trends, and vendor tools, with experience working across global companies and website localization.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in B2B website management and hands-on application of agentic AI/experimentation are mandatory requirements.

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

**WELLZ:** A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTHCARE:** Health, dental, and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

**PAID TIME OFF:** It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

**CAREER GROWTH:** Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

**CULTURE:** You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. [Learn more about our shared culture and values here.](https://wellhub.com/en-us/careers/our-values/)

**Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on** [**Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/lifeatwellhub/) **@lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on** [**YouTube**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgIPiszTVm4) **!**
